[EP01_EL042 | 01:03.00-01:06.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up on Juliana's furious, weeping face.
[EP01_EL043 | 01:03.40-01:05.60] **LADY JULIANA (Betrayed, Piercing):** "You swore you loved me!"
[EP01_EL044 | 01:06.00-01:08.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown smiling condescendingly.
[EP01_EL045 | 01:06.50-01:08.80] **LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Mocking):** "People change their minds, sister."
[EP01_EL046 | 01:08.80-01:12.40] **CAMERA:** Medium profile shot of the Lady in Gold Gown turning her head subtly toward Gerald with satisfied malice.
[EP01_EL047 | 01:09.10-01:10.40] **LADY JULIANA (Horrified):** "And you knew?"
[EP01_EL048 | 01:10.60-01:12.10] **LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Unapologetic, Cheerful):** "Of course I knew."
[EP01_EL049 | 01:12.40-01:14.60] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Juliana, stunned by the callous depth of the conspiracy.
[EP01_EL050 | 01:13.10-01:14.30] **LADY JULIANA (Trembling):** "How long?"
[EP01_EL051 | 01:14.60-01:19.00] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot of the Lady in Gold Gown and Gerald looking together down at Juliana.
[EP01_EL052 | 01:15.00-01:18.50] **LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Cruel, Poised):** "Long enough to know he was never going to marry you."

narrative_moments.summary: Juliana stands tall in the cathedral aisle and publicly proclaims that Gerald's abandonment proves the worthlessness of his word.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP02_EL055 | 01:14.40-01:16.40] **LADY JULIANA (Bitter, Defiant):** "Dignity?"
[EP02_EL056 | 01:16.50-01:19.00] **CAMERA:** Full shot of Juliana standing tall, her posture completely transforming into regal composure before the seated guests.
[EP02_EL057 | 01:16.50-01:19.00] **LADY JULIANA (Clear, Accusing):** "You abandoned a woman who trusted you..."
[EP02_EL058 | 01:19.00-01:21.80] **CAMERA:** Medium profile close-up on Gerald's hardening jawline, Clarissa blurred in the background.
[EP02_EL059 | 01:19.20-01:22.50] **LADY JULIANA (Off-screen) (Sharp, Piercing):** "...because another woman promised you greater beauty and wealth."
[EP02_EL060 | 01:21.80-01:22.80] **CAMERA:** Closer angle on Gerald's uneasy expression as Juliana's voice commands the room.
[EP02_EL061 | 01:22.80-01:26.70] **CAMERA:** Medium wide shot framing Juliana confronting Gerald from the foot of the altar stairs.
[EP02_EL062 | 01:23.00-01:26.50] **LADY JULIANA (Steely, Resolute):** "Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald."
[EP02_EL063 | 01:26.70-01:30.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up push-in on Juliana, her blue eyes shining with fierce conviction.
[EP02_EL064 | 01:26.80-01:33.00] **LADY JULIANA (Powerful, Unyielding):** "You wanted this entire chapel to believe that I was not worthy of you. But you have shown them something far more valuable."
[EP02_EL065 | 01:30.80-01:33.20] **CAMERA:** Medium profile on Juliana looking up at Gerald, holding the entire hall spellbound.
[EP02_EL066 | 01:33.20-01:36.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Juliana's face, calm, dignified, and unwavering.
[EP02_EL067 | 01:33.40-01:36.60] **LADY JULIANA (Decisive, Scathing):** "You have shown them exactly what your word is worth."
[EP02_EL068 | 01:36.80-01:38.20] **CAMERA:** Medium shot on Gerald standing frozen on the altar steps, stunned and speechless under her public rebuke.
[EP02_EL069 | 01:38.20-01:42.80] **CAMERA:** Low-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral nave, framing Juliana in pristine white at the center of the vaulted aisle.
[EP02_EL070 | 01:38.20-01:42.80] **ACTION:** Juliana lifts her chin high, commanding the space with unassailable dignity.
[EP02_EL071 | 01:38.50-01:42.40] **LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Proud):** "I may leave this chapel without a husband..."
[EP02_EL072 | 01:42.80-01:50.00] **CAMERA:** Dramatic medium close-up holding steadily on Juliana's radiant, proud face as she delivers her final proclamation.
[EP02_EL073 | 01:43.00-01:47.40] **LADY JULIANA (Defiant, Triumphant in Spirit):** "...but I will not leave it believing I was the one who should be ashamed."

narrative_moments.summary: A scarred stranger knocks out a royal guard, steps forward with a silver ring, and proposes to Lady Juliana before the congregation.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP03_EL056 | 01:06.00-01:08.10] **CAMERA:** Wide eye-level shot looking down the petal-strewn marble aisle. A tall, rugged man in a worn dark trench coat—The Bearded Stranger—emerges into the center of the nave.
[EP03_EL057 | 01:06.00-01:08.10] **ACTION:** The Bearded Stranger steps deliberately into the aisle, his heavy boots echoing.
[EP03_EL058 | 01:08.10-01:10.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up on the Noble Matriarch freezing in utter shock and outrage.
[EP03_EL059 | 01:09.90-01:12.10] **THE BEARDED STRANGER (Low, Thunderous, Imposing):** "Take your hands off her."
[EP03_EL060 | 01:10.50-01:12.80] **CAMERA:** Medium tracking shot front-on as The Bearded Stranger marches down the flower-strewn aisle with resolute purpose.
[EP03_EL061 | 01:12.80-01:15.10] **CAMERA:** Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch stepping forward on the altar steps, furiously pointing a finger at him.
[EP03_EL062 | 01:13.00-01:16.80] **NOBLE MATRIARCH (Indignant, Screeching):** "And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!"
[EP03_EL063 | 01:15.10-01:17.00] **CAMERA:** High wide shot of the magnificent vaulted hall as The Bearded Stranger walks steadily forward, dwarfing the aisle.
[EP03_EL064 | 01:17.00-01:19.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot on the lead royal guard squaring his shoulders, barring the stranger's advance while Juliana stands behind him.
[EP03_EL065 | 01:17.20-01:18.90] **ROYAL GUARD (Aggressive, Threatening):** "Stand aside, stranger!"
[EP03_EL066 | 01:19.00-01:21.00] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up profile on The Bearded Stranger, eyes burning with quiet, lethal resolve.
[EP03_EL067 | 01:19.30-01:20.90] **THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Deadly):** "I said..."
[EP03_EL068 | 01:21.00-01:24.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's intense, scarred face.
[EP03_EL069 | 01:21.80-01:23.90] **THE BEARDED STRANGER (Dangerous, Uncompromising):** "...let her go."
[EP03_EL070 | 01:24.00-01:25.50] **CAMERA:** Medium action shot as the guard charges toward The Bearded Stranger.
[EP03_EL071 | 01:24.00-01:25.50] **ACTION:** The Bearded Stranger effortlessly blocks the guard's strike and drives a devastating strike into him, dropping the armed guard instantly to the floor.
[EP03_EL072 | 01:24.50-01:25.40] **SOUND FX:** A heavy, bone-rattling punch followed by the clatter and thud of the guard collapsing onto the stone floor.
[EP03_EL073 | 01:25.50-01:28.10] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Gerald turning frantically to the remaining guards and congregation, panicking.
[EP03_EL074 | 01:25.60-01:28.00] **THE FORMER GROOM (Frantic, Shouting):** "What are you waiting for?! He's only one man!"
[EP03_EL075 | 01:28.10-01:29.30] **CAMERA:** Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger standing unmoved over the fallen guard, turning his gaze toward Juliana.
[EP03_EL076 | 01:29.30-01:31.70] **CAMERA:** Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger stepping up to Lady Juliana, who gazes up at him in stunned breathlessness.
[EP03_EL077 | 01:30.40-01:31.60] **THE BEARDED STRANGER (Gentle, Protective):** "Are you hurt?"
[EP03_EL078 | 01:31.70-01:34.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes her head gently, overwhelmed with wonder.
[EP03_EL079 | 01:31.80-01:33.60] **ACTION:** Juliana softly shakes her head 'no', her wide blue eyes locked onto him.
[EP03_EL080 | 01:34.00-01:36.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up profile of The Bearded Stranger casting a sharp, menacing glance toward the other guard.
[EP03_EL081 | 01:34.10-01:36.30] **THE BEARDED STRANGER (Firm, Menacing):** "Good. Then don't touch her again."
[EP03_EL082 | 01:36.50-01:38.40] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up on the Noble Matriarch shrieking in exasperation from the altar steps.
[EP03_EL083 | 01:36.50-01:38.50] **NOBLE MATRIARCH (Furious, Hysterical):** "You cannot interfere in a family matter!"
[EP03_EL084 | 01:38.40-01:40.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana's elderly father looking down, gripping his hands nervously with profound guilt.
[EP03_EL085 | 01:38.80-01:40.80] **THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Deep, Resonant):** "I can..."
[EP03_EL086 | 01:40.80-01:43.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of guests in the pews whispering and reacting in hushed shock.
[EP03_EL087 | 01:40.80-01:43.80] **THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Stern, Accusing):** "...when your family is dragging a defenseless woman from a church."
[EP03_EL088 | 01:43.00-01:45.90] **CAMERA:** Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger and Lady Juliana framed against the illuminated stained-glass rose window.
[EP03_EL089 | 01:44.20-01:47.40] **THE BEARDED STRANGER (Solemn, Gentle):** "You shouldn't have to beg anybody..."
[EP03_EL090 | 01:45.90-01:48.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Juliana looking up into his eyes, moved to the core.
[EP03_EL091 | 01:47.40-01:49.00] **THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Affirming, Sincere):** "...to remember your worth."
[EP03_EL092 | 01:48.80-01:50.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's rugged, bearded face looking down at her with tender reverence.
[EP03_EL093 | 01:50.80-01:52.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Juliana, her lips parting in quiet astonishment.
[EP03_EL094 | 01:50.90-01:52.50] **LADY JULIANA (Whispering, Bewildered):** "Why are you doing this?"
[EP03_EL095 | 01:52.50-01:54.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up on The Bearded Stranger, completely unfazed.
[EP03_EL096 | 01:52.80-01:54.10] **THE BEARDED STRANGER (Simple, Certain):** "Because I want to."
[EP03_EL097 | 01:54.20-01:56.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Juliana's father wringing his gold ring, eyes heavy with regret.
[EP03_EL098 | 01:56.00-01:57.90] **CAMERA:** Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger slipping his hand into his coat pocket.
[EP03_EL099 | 01:57.90-01:59.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana watching him with rapt, trembling anticipation.
[EP03_EL100 | 01:59.20-02:01.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of The Bearded Stranger's rugged fingers holding up a simple, polished silver band.
[EP03_EL101 | 01:59.80-02:02.10] **THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Honorable, Earnest):** "You came here to become a wife."
[EP03_EL102 | 02:01.00-02:03.20] **CAMERA:** Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger extending the ring toward Juliana.
[EP03_EL103 | 02:02.50-02:04.20] **THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Resolute):** "They took that from you."
[EP03_EL104 | 02:03.20-02:05.10] **CAMERA:** Over-the-shoulder medium shot past The Bearded Stranger onto Gerald standing petrified and humiliated in the aisle.
[EP03_EL105 | 02:05.10-02:07.40] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up on The Bearded Stranger presenting the ring directly to Juliana.
[EP03_EL106 | 02:05.30-02:07.30] **THE BEARDED STRANGER (Earnest, Sincere):** "I am offering it back."
[EP03_EL107 | 02:07.40-02:10.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Juliana glancing down at the ring, breathless and overwhelmed.
[EP03_EL108 | 02:07.70-02:09.90] **LADY JULIANA (Soft, Hesitant):** "You don't even know me."
[EP03_EL109 | 02:10.20-02:12.70] **CAMERA:** Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's warm, piercing gaze.
[EP03_EL110 | 02:10.40-02:12.00] **THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Steady):** "I know enough."
[EP03_EL111 | 02:12.70-02:15.50] **CAMERA:** Full wide profile shot as The Bearded Stranger slowly and respectfully drops onto one knee before Lady Juliana.
[EP03_EL112 | 02:13.20-02:15.50] **ACTION:** The Bearded Stranger sinks to one knee on the cathedral aisle, offering the silver ring up to Juliana.
[EP03_EL113 | 02:14.80-02:16.20] **SOUND FX:** A collective, stunned gasp rippling across the entire congregation.
[EP03_EL114 | 02:15.50-02:17.30] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Noble Matriarch, Gerald, and the Lady in Gold Gown frozen in sheer, jaw-dropped bewilderment.
[EP03_EL115 | 02:17.30-02:20.50] **CAMERA:** Low-angle medium close-up of The Bearded Stranger on his knee, holding the silver ring high with steady dignity.
[EP03_EL116 | 02:17.50-02:20.30] **THE BEARDED STRANGER (Solemn, Devoted):** "Lady Juliana... accept my hand."

narrative_moments.summary: Juliana marries the scarred warrior in the cathedral, prompting her stepmother to officially disown and banish her from the Ashcroft estate.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP04_EL054 | 01:12.80-01:14.50] **JULIANA (Resolved):** "Then I accept."
[EP04_EL055 | 01:14.80-01:16.20] **CAMERA:** Wide shot of the altar with the high cathedral stained glass overhead as the Priest looks on between them.
[EP04_EL056 | 01:16.20-01:19.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man rising smoothly to his feet before Juliana.
[EP04_EL057 | 01:16.20-01:19.00] **ACTION:** The Mysterious Bearded Man stands tall, extending his scarred hand toward Juliana.
[EP04_EL058 | 01:19.00-01:21.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana's slender hand resting gently into his large, weathered palm.
[EP04_EL059 | 01:19.20-01:21.50] **ACTION:** He folds his fingers over hers, holding her hand with protective firmness.
[EP04_EL060 | 01:21.80-01:24.00] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of the Priest holding his open liturgical book, bewildered and trembling.
[EP04_EL061 | 01:22.00-01:23.80] **THE PRIEST (Hesitant, Anxious):** "My- My Lady..."
[EP04_EL062 | 01:24.00-01:26.00] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of the Priest's alarmed, questioning eyes.
[EP04_EL063 | 01:24.00-01:25.80] **THE PRIEST (Tentative):** "Are you certain?"
[EP04_EL064 | 01:26.00-01:28.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft seated in his pew, gripping his cane, bowed in grim silence.
[EP04_EL065 | 01:28.80-01:31.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up profile of Juliana, her expression clear and unshakable.
[EP04_EL066 | 01:29.80-01:31.00] **JULIANA (Unwavering):** "I am."
[EP04_EL067 | 01:31.50-01:34.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of the Priest swallowing hard and looking down at his book.
[EP04_EL068 | 01:32.00-01:34.50] **THE PRIEST (Resigned, Solemn):** "Then... let us proceed."
[EP04_EL069 | 01:34.80-01:37.80] **CAMERA:** Close two-shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man and Juliana gazing intimately into each other's eyes.
[EP04_EL070 | 01:35.80-01:38.00] **MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Low, Reassuring):** "You need not say anything you do not mean."
[EP04_EL071 | 01:37.80-01:40.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana smiling softly up at him.
[EP04_EL072 | 01:38.20-01:40.00] **JULIANA (Warm, Sincere):** "I truly mean it."
[EP04_EL073 | 01:40.20-01:42.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up shot of his hands sliding the silver ring over her ring finger.
[EP04_EL074 | 01:40.20-01:42.20] **ACTION:** The Mysterious Bearded Man carefully slides the band onto Juliana's finger.
[EP04_EL075 | 01:42.20-01:45.00] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her hands tenderly.
[EP04_EL076 | 01:42.50-01:44.20] **MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Solemn):** "You have my protection."
[EP04_EL077 | 01:45.00-01:47.80] **CAMERA:** Tight shot of the warrior's face, his eyes full of devotion.
[EP04_EL078 | 01:45.20-01:47.00] **MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Steadfast):** "You have my respect."
[EP04_EL079 | 01:47.80-01:50.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of his intense gaze.
[EP04_EL080 | 01:47.80-01:49.80] **MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave):** "And you have my word."
[EP04_EL081 | 01:50.00-01:52.80] **CAMERA:** Medium three-shot with the Priest standing between them, raising both hands in blessing over their joined hands.
[EP04_EL082 | 01:50.00-01:53.00] **THE PRIEST (Ceremonial):** "By the authority entrusted to me, I now pronounce you..."
[EP04_EL083 | 01:52.80-01:54.80] **CAMERA:** High wide establishing shot looking down from the ceiling vaults of the cathedral onto the altar.
[EP04_EL084 | 01:53.00-01:54.80] **THE PRIEST (Off-Screen, Booming):** "...husband and wife!"
[EP04_EL085 | 01:54.00-01:55.20] **SOUND FX:** Dramatic musical chord swelling.
[EP04_EL086 | 01:54.80-01:56.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Gerald lunging forward, pointing an enraged finger.
[EP04_EL087 | 01:55.00-01:56.80] **GERALD (Furious, Shouting):** "You have thrown yourself away!"
[EP04_EL088 | 01:56.80-01:59.00] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of Gerald, face contorted in rage.
[EP04_EL089 | 01:57.00-01:59.00] **GERALD (Livid):** "For a penniless nobody!"
[EP04_EL090 | 01:59.00-02:02.80] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot of Juliana standing tall before Gerald in the chapel aisle, her husband standing guard behind her.
[EP04_EL091 | 02:00.50-02:02.80] **JULIANA (Calm, Cutting):** "I would rather choose my own life..."
[EP04_EL092 | 02:02.80-02:05.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana, her jaw set with unshakable pride.
[EP04_EL093 | 02:03.00-02:05.50] **JULIANA (Firm, Final):** "...than spend another moment begging for yours."
[EP04_EL094 | 02:05.80-02:07.40] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of Gerald, eyes wide with speechless shock and wounded pride.
[EP04_EL095 | 02:06.00-02:07.40] **ACTION:** Gerald recoils slightly, mouth agape.
[EP04_EL096 | 02:07.40-02:11.50] **CAMERA:** Wide shot of Lady Ashcroft rising abruptly from the front pew, pointing an accusatory hand toward the doors.
[EP04_EL097 | 02:07.50-02:11.50] **LADY ASHCROFT (Imperious, Shouting):** "Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!"
[EP04_EL098 | 02:11.50-02:14.80] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of Lady Ashcroft, eyes blazing with cold malice.
[EP04_EL099 | 02:12.00-02:14.50] **LADY ASHCROFT (Venomous):** "You are disowned!"

narrative_moments.summary: Lady Ashcroft throws Juliana's late mother's herbal ledger into the mud, but Alexander kneels down and tenderly retrieves it for her.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP05_EL023 | 00:41.50-00:46.00] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Lady Ashcroft, resplendent in navy velvet and jewels, stepping forward with a smirk of malicious authority.
[EP05_EL024 | 00:42.50-00:44.20] **LADY ASHCROFT (Sharply Dismissive):** "Enough sentiment."
[EP05_EL025 | 00:44.30-00:45.80] **LADY ASHCROFT (Cold, Demanding):** "And the ledger..."
[EP05_EL026 | 00:46.00-00:48.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot as Lady Ashcroft approaches Juliana menacingly.
[EP05_EL027 | 00:46.80-00:48.80] **LADY ASHCROFT (Venomous):** "...that belongs to this family."
[EP05_EL028 | 00:49.00-00:51.80] **JULIANA (Alarmed, Protective):** "It belonged to my mother! It is all I have left of her."
[EP05_EL029 | 00:51.80-00:54.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Lady Ashcroft laying a jeweled hand firmly on the bound book.
[EP05_EL030 | 00:52.00-00:54.00] **LADY ASHCROFT (Cruel):** "Then you should have guarded it better."
[EP05_EL031 | 00:54.00-00:57.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up on the ledger as Lady Ashcroft violently wrenches it out of Juliana's grip.
[EP05_EL032 | 00:54.50-00:57.50] **ACTION:** Lady Ashcroft snatches the heavy book away and flings it disdainfully into the rain-soaked courtyard.
[EP05_EL033 | 00:55.50-00:56.80] **JULIANA (Screaming, Desperate):** "Barbara, don't!"
[EP05_EL034 | 00:57.00-00:58.20] **SOUND FX:** A heavy wet slap as the leather-bound book crashes into the puddle-slicked stone pavement.

[EP05_EL035 | 00:57.80-01:03.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Clarissa and Gerald standing together on the cathedral steps. Clarissa clasps a gloved hand to her mouth in mock shock before bursting into gleeful laughter.
[EP05_EL036 | 00:59.00-01:02.50] **CLARISSA (Gleeful, Mocking):** "Even your mother's precious legacy has been cast into the dirt!"
[EP05_EL037 | 01:02.40-01:04.60] **GERALD (Smug, Cruel):** "Perhaps that is where it belongs."
[EP05_EL038 | 01:03.00-01:06.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana looking down at the ground, tears streaming down her pale cheeks.
[EP05_EL039 | 01:05.50-01:08.50] **ACTION:** Juliana drops to her knees onto the wet courtyard pavement, oblivious to the dirt soaking through her white bridal gown.
[EP05_EL040 | 01:06.50-01:09.00] **CAMERA:** Low-angle close-up of Juliana's trembling hand reaching toward the leather ledger resting in the puddle.
[EP05_EL041 | 01:09.00-01:12.50] **CAMERA:** Wide shot of Juliana kneeling on the damp ground as the tall Mysterious Bearded Man strides purposefully into frame toward her.
[EP05_EL042 | 01:10.50-01:14.50] **ACTION:** The Mysterious Bearded Man bends his knees and kneels down beside Juliana, extending his scarred hand to retrieve the fallen ledger.
[EP05_EL043 | 01:14.50-01:16.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of his large, weathered hands gently lifting the wet, embossed leather book from the ground.
[EP05_EL044 | 01:16.00-01:20.00] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot as he holds out the retrieved ledger and places it into Juliana's trembling hands.
[EP05_EL045 | 01:17.80-01:19.00] **MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Low, Gentle):** "Here you go."
[EP05_EL046 | 01:20.00-01:25.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man looking warmly down at Juliana, his rugged face full of quiet sincerity.
[EP05_EL047 | 01:20.50-01:22.00] **JULIANA (Choked, Weeping):** "They destroyed it."
[EP05_EL048 | 01:22.50-01:25.40] **MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Calm, Grounded):** "They dirtied it. That is not the same thing."
[EP05_EL049 | 01:25.50-01:31.00] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot of Juliana pressing the soiled book tightly against her chest, weeping softly.
[EP05_EL050 | 01:26.50-01:27.80] **JULIANA (Broken):** "It was my mother's."
[EP05_EL051 | 01:27.90-01:29.00] **MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Gentle, Protective):** "Then keep it."
[EP05_EL052 | 01:28.50-01:31.00] **ACTION:** The Mysterious Bearded Man reaches out with both hands, clasping his strong hands tenderly over hers and the book.
[EP05_EL053 | 01:29.40-01:31.00] **MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Firm, Comforting):** "Let them keep everything else."

narrative_moments.summary: Juliana cleans their modest stone cottage and finds unexpected peace and safety beside the hearth fire with Alexander.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP06_EL036 | 00:40.00-00:42.00] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man standing in the dim light by the door.
[EP06_EL037 | 00:40.70-00:41.90] **MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Humble, Apologetic):** "I am sorry."
[EP06_EL038 | 00:42.00-00:43.30] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana gazing around the rustic interior, taking in the sparse surroundings.
[EP06_EL039 | 00:43.30-00:46.40] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man looking at her with somber honesty.
[EP06_EL040 | 00:43.60-00:45.00] **MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave, Sincere):** "You came from comfort."
[EP06_EL041 | 00:45.10-00:47.30] **MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave, Sincere):** "This is all I can give you now."
[EP06_EL042 | 00:46.40-00:48.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana undoing the ribbon tie of her black cloak and letting it slide off her shoulders.
[EP06_EL043 | 00:46.60-00:49.00] **ACTION:** Juliana removes her dark cloak, revealing her damp white bridal dress underneath.
[EP06_EL044 | 00:48.80-00:51.10] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana's hand pressing against the cold, condensation-fogged windowpane.
[EP06_EL045 | 00:51.10-00:54.80] **CAMERA:** Side profile shot of Juliana looking out the rain-streaked window into the quiet forest.
[EP06_EL046 | 00:51.30-00:52.70] **JULIANA (Gentle, Peaceful):** "It is quiet."
[EP06_EL047 | 00:53.30-00:54.60] **JULIANA (Gentle, Peaceful):** "Very quiet."
[EP06_EL048 | 00:54.80-00:56.20] **CAMERA:** Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Juliana looking at the Mysterious Bearded Man watching her attentively.
[EP06_EL049 | 00:56.20-00:58.20] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana turning back toward him, a soft, genuine smile illuminating her face.
[EP06_EL050 | 00:56.40-00:58.00] **JULIANA (Earnest, Content):** "I think I like that."
[EP06_EL051 | 00:58.20-00:59.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, slightly surprised by her reaction.
[EP06_EL052 | 00:58.40-01:00.00] **MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Incredulous):** "You are not disappointed?"
[EP06_EL053 | 00:59.80-01:01.30] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana meeting his gaze honestly.
[EP06_EL055 | 01:01.30-01:04.10] **CAMERA:** Over-the-shoulder shot behind Juliana as the Mysterious Bearded Man listens intently.
[EP06_EL056 | 01:01.90-01:04.10] **JULIANA (Warm, Reassuring):** "But not because of you."
[EP06_EL057 | 01:04.10-01:06.60] **CAMERA:** Medium shot as Juliana grabs a rag from the rustic wooden table and begins briskly scrubbing the damp surface.
[EP06_EL058 | 01:04.30-01:06.80] **JULIANA (Determined, Practical):** "If this is our home, I want it clean."
[EP06_EL059 | 01:06.60-01:07.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man stepping forward to intervene gently.
[EP06_EL060 | 01:06.70-01:08.70] **MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Caring, Tender):** "You don't have to do that tonight."
[EP06_EL061 | 01:07.80-01:09.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Juliana's hands vigorously scrubbing grime from the wooden tabletop.
[EP06_EL062 | 01:09.50-01:12.10] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana's face, her voice catching with raw, suppressed emotion as she scrubs.
[EP06_EL063 | 01:10.10-01:13.20] **JULIANA (Vulnerable, Trembling):** "If I stop now, I will think about everything I lost."
[EP06_EL064 | 01:12.10-01:14.30] **CAMERA:** Full shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man standing motionless, his gaze filled with empathy and understanding.
[EP06_EL065 | 01:14.30-01:16.80] **ACTION:** Instead of stopping her, the Mysterious Bearded Man kneels beside the table and begins inspecting and adjusting the wobbly table leg to help.
[EP06_EL066 | 01:14.30-01:16.80] **CAMERA:** Medium low shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man kneeling beside Juliana as she wipes the table.
[EP06_EL067 | 01:16.80-01:17.80] **ACTION:** Juliana picks up a straw broom and sweeps the stone floor in front of the stone hearth.
[EP06_EL068 | 01:16.80-01:17.80] **CAMERA:** Wide shot of Juliana sweeping dust toward the large stone fireplace.
[EP06_EL069 | 01:17.80-01:21.00] **ACTION:** The Mysterious Bearded Man carries a heavy wooden log across the room and places it onto the iron grate in the hearth.
[EP06_EL070 | 01:17.80-01:21.00] **CAMERA:** Tracking shot following the Mysterious Bearded Man as he sets the firewood into the stone fireplace.
[EP06_EL071 | 01:21.00-01:23.80] **ACTION:** He strikes flint and steel together over dry kindling, igniting bright sparks that catch into a flickering flame.
[EP06_EL072 | 01:21.00-01:23.80] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up on hands striking flint, sparks showering onto the twigs and catching fire.
[EP06_EL073 | 01:23.80-01:25.00] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of vibrant orange flames rapidly spreading across the dry logs, crackling warmly.
[EP06_EL074 | 01:23.80-01:30.00] **SOUND FX:** Crisp crackling and snapping of dry wood catching fire in the hearth.
[EP06_EL075 | 01:25.00-01:27.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana standing by the table, broom resting against her hip, bathed in the amber firelight.
[EP06_EL076 | 01:27.50-01:29.80] **ACTION:** The Mysterious Bearded Man stands up from the hearth, dusting his hands on his coat.
[EP06_EL077 | 01:27.50-01:29.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man rising before the blazing fireplace.
[EP06_EL078 | 01:29.00-01:29.80] **MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Relieved):** "There."
[EP06_EL079 | 01:29.80-01:31.70] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana looking at him with radiant gratitude and a gentle smile.
[EP06_EL080 | 01:31.70-01:33.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man gesturing faintly to the modest room.
[EP06_EL081 | 01:32.10-01:33.60] **MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Quiet, Modest):** "It is not much."
[EP06_EL082 | 01:33.80-01:35.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the stone floor before the blazing hearth, wrapping her dark cloak around her shoulders.
[EP06_EL083 | 01:34.20-01:36.20] **JULIANA (Soft, Comforted):** "It is enough for tonight."
[EP06_EL084 | 01:35.80-01:38.20] **CAMERA:** Wide shot framing the roaring hearth fire between them as the Mysterious Bearded Man crouches down beside her on the stone floor.
[EP06_EL085 | 01:38.20-01:41.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana pulling her cloak tighter, her face glowing warmly in the firelight.
[EP06_EL086 | 01:38.40-01:40.40] **JULIANA (V.O.) (Reflective, Vulnerable):** "I lost my home today."
[EP06_EL087 | 01:40.60-01:41.80] **JULIANA (V.O.) (Reflective, Vulnerable):** "My family."
[EP06_EL088 | 01:41.00-01:43.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the glowing embers and dancing flames inside the fireplace.
[EP06_EL089 | 01:42.00-01:44.80] **JULIANA (V.O.) (Reflective, Vulnerable):** "Everything I thought my life would be."
[EP06_EL090 | 01:43.00-01:44.30] **CAMERA:** Close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred, work-worn hands resting quietly on his knees.
[EP06_EL091 | 01:44.30-01:46.00] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana looking down into the flames, a peaceful serenity washing over her features.
[EP06_EL092 | 01:45.00-01:46.00] **JULIANA (V.O.) (Gentle, Surprised):** "And yet..."
[EP06_EL093 | 01:46.00-01:49.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's profile, his scarred cheek illuminated by the amber glow as he watches over her protectively.
[EP06_EL094 | 01:46.20-01:49.00] **JULIANA (V.O.) (Tender, Safe):** "Sitting here with him, I don't feel afraid."

narrative_moments.summary: Gerald arrives at the cottage to mock Juliana's peasant life, but flees in terror when Alexander silently confronts him.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP07_EL010 | 00:24.50-00:29.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Gerald standing beside Aristocratic Woman, sneering disdainfully.
[EP07_EL011 | 00:25.00-00:29.80] **GERALD (Arrogant, Scornful):** "A fitting home for a woman who threw away everything for a penniless soldier."
[EP07_EL012 | 00:29.80-00:32.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana, defiant and unflinching despite her soiled dress and damp hair.
[EP07_EL013 | 00:30.00-00:32.60] **JULIANA (Sharp, Unintimidated):** "You came all this way just to insult my home?"
[EP07_EL014 | 00:32.80-00:37.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Aristocratic Woman erupting into high-pitched, malicious laughter beneath her parasol.
[EP07_EL015 | 00:33.20-00:37.80] **ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (Gloating, Mocking):** "Home? Look at your hands, Juliana."
[EP07_EL016 | 00:37.80-00:39.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana's mud-stained palms held open against her apron.
[EP07_EL017 | 00:38.20-00:39.80] **ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (O.S.) (Cruel):** "You look like a servant."
[EP07_EL018 | 00:39.80-00:41.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Gerald's smug expression watching Juliana.
[EP07_EL019 | 00:41.00-00:45.00] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering dignity.
[EP07_EL020 | 00:41.20-00:44.80] **JULIANA (Proud, Resolute):** "I work with my hands. There is no shame in that."
[EP07_EL021 | 00:45.00-00:47.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Gerald's tightening jaw.
[EP07_EL022 | 00:45.20-00:46.80] **GERALD (Biting, Condescending):** "You were born a lady."
[EP07_EL023 | 00:47.00-00:50.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with unbroken pride.
[EP07_EL024 | 00:48.80-00:50.40] **JULIANA (Firm, Unapologetic):** "And I remain one."
[EP07_EL025 | 00:50.80-00:54.80] **CAMERA:** Wide shot framing Juliana facing off against Gerald and Aristocratic Woman in the bleak courtyard.
[EP07_EL026 | 00:51.50-00:54.60] **GERALD (Bitter, Sneering):** "You chose that scarred beggar over a life of comfort."
[EP07_EL027 | 00:54.80-01:01.50] **CAMERA:** Two-shot profile of Juliana looking straight into Gerald's eyes without flinching.
[EP07_EL028 | 00:57.80-01:01.00] **JULIANA (Passionate, Defiant):** "I chose a man who stood beside me when you walked away."
[EP07_EL029 | 01:01.50-01:05.20] **CAMERA:** Intense close-up of Juliana dismissing him with utter contempt.
[EP07_EL030 | 01:01.80-01:04.80] **JULIANA (Cold, Commanding):** "You have no authority here. Leave."
[EP07_EL031 | 01:05.20-01:09.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Gerald lunging forward, aggressively pointing his finger into Juliana's face.
[EP07_EL032 | 01:05.60-01:08.50] **GERALD (Furious, Threatening):** "I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear."
[EP07_EL033 | 01:08.60-01:09.50] **GERALD (Spiteful, Boastful):** "And your husband?"
[EP07_EL034 | 01:09.50-01:14.00] **CAMERA:** Wide shot down a dark, fog-drenched forest path. A towering, shadowed figure walks steadily forward through the mist.
[EP07_EL035 | 01:09.50-01:11.20] **GERALD (V.O.) (Snarl):** "Where is that beggar husband?"
[EP07_EL036 | 01:10.00-01:15.50] **ACTION:** The Scarred Bearded Man marches purposefully toward the cottage, carrying a heavy bundle of chopped firewood bound tightly with hemp cord.
[EP07_EL037 | 01:14.00-01:15.50] **CAMERA:** Medium tracking shot pushing in on the Scarred Bearded Man's stern, rugged face as he approaches the gate.
[EP07_EL038 | 01:15.50-01:18.50] **CAMERA:** Low shot of the Scarred Bearded Man bending down and dropping the bundle of logs by the stone wall.
[EP07_EL039 | 01:16.20-01:17.50] **SOUND FX:** A dull, heavy thud of timber striking the mud.
[EP07_EL040 | 01:18.50-01:21.00] **CAMERA:** Medium full shot as the Scarred Bearded Man straightens to his full imposing height and steps directly toward Gerald.
[EP07_EL041 | 01:21.00-01:23.50] **CAMERA:** Two-shot framing the Scarred Bearded Man towering menacingly over Gerald, staring down at him with unyielding intensity.
[EP07_EL042 | 01:21.50-01:24.00] **ACTION:** Gerald freezes, his arrogant bravado instantly vanishing as cold dread overtakes his face.
[EP07_EL043 | 01:23.50-01:28.00] **CAMERA:** Low-angle close-up of Gerald looking up in sheer terror, his adam's apple bobbing nervously.
[EP07_EL044 | 01:26.50-01:28.50] **ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (O.S.) (Urgent, Annoyed):** "Gerald, don't let him frighten you."
[EP07_EL045 | 01:28.60-01:30.00] **GERALD (Trembling, Trying to Save Face):** "What are you staring at?"
[EP07_EL046 | 01:30.00-01:31.50] **ACTION:** Gerald rapidly turns on his heel toward the carriage, unwilling to face another second of the silent glare.
[EP07_EL047 | 01:30.10-01:31.40] **GERALD (Nervous, Hurried):** "We are leaving."
[EP07_EL048 | 01:31.50-01:33.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Aristocratic Woman, shocked and indignant as Gerald flees past her.
[EP07_EL049 | 01:32.00-01:33.80] **ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (Outraged, Flustered):** "Leaving? Gerald!"
[EP07_EL050 | 01:33.80-01:36.50] **ACTION:** Aristocratic Woman scrambles back into the carriage, hiking up her gown in a fluster before slamming the door shut.
[EP07_EL051 | 01:35.00-01:36.00] **SOUND FX:** Carriage door slamming shut.
[EP07_EL052 | 01:36.00-01:39.00] **CAMERA:** Wide shot of the carriage rapidly jolting forward and disappearing down the misty road away from the cottage.

narrative_moments.summary: Alexander and Juliana bond over her mother's herbal book, revealing Alexander's extensive knowledge of healing war wounds.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP08_EL001 | 00:00.00-00:03.20] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana seated at a rustic wooden table beside a daylight-lit window, gently touching an aged leather-bound book.
[EP08_EL002 | 00:00.00-00:03.20] **ACTION:** Juliana delicately runs her fingertips across the embossed leather cover of the worn botanical volume, noticing its weathered state.
[EP08_EL003 | 00:00.20-00:03.20] **JULIANA (Gentle, Somber):** "Some of the pages are ruined. Careful."
[EP08_EL004 | 00:03.20-00:05.10] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Juliana's hands carefully unlatching the metal clasp on the leather book.
[EP08_EL005 | 00:03.40-00:04.50] **SOUND FX:** Soft metallic click of the book clasp loosening.
[EP08_EL006 | 00:05.10-00:07.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana tenderly opening the cover and turning the brittle parchment pages.
[EP08_EL007 | 00:05.10-00:07.80] **JULIANA (Reflective, Reverent):** "Mother spent years writing this."
[EP08_EL008 | 00:07.80-00:10.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot as Alexander enters the dim room behind Juliana, quietly stepping up to the rustic table.
[EP08_EL009 | 00:08.50-00:10.50] **ACTION:** Alexander gently sets down a fresh bundle of small white herbal flowers tied with twine beside the open book.
[EP08_EL010 | 00:10.50-00:11.90] **CAMERA:** Low-angle medium close-up of Juliana looking up toward Alexander in pleasant surprise.
[EP08_EL011 | 00:10.50-00:11.80] **JULIANA (Curious, Recognizing):** "Yarrow."
[EP08_EL012 | 00:11.90-00:15.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Alexander looking down at her, the firelight catching the rugged scar across his face.
[EP08_EL013 | 00:12.00-00:14.60] **ALEXANDER (Calm, Knowledgeable):** "Good for wounds. Fever, too."
[EP08_EL014 | 00:15.00-00:16.30] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at him with genuine curiosity.
[EP08_EL015 | 00:15.10-00:16.10] **JULIANA (Inquiring, Soft):** "How do you know that?"
[EP08_EL016 | 00:16.30-00:19.30] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Alexander speaking in a steady, measured tone.
[EP08_EL017 | 00:16.30-00:18.90] **ALEXANDER (Somber, Matter-of-Fact):** "Soldiers learn quickly which plants keep a man alive."
[EP08_EL018 | 00:19.30-00:21.50] **CAMERA:** Insert shot of Juliana's hands gently arranging several tied bundles of dried yarrow sprigs on the tabletop.
[EP08_EL019 | 00:19.40-00:21.80] **JULIANA (Observant, Lightly Teasing):** "You know more about healing than you let on."
[EP08_EL020 | 00:21.50-00:24.30] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Alexander, bathed in warm hearth embers, offering a subtle, knowing half-smile.
[EP08_EL021 | 00:22.80-00:24.20] **ALEXANDER (Quiet, Gritty):** "Enough to survive."
[EP08_EL022 | 00:24.30-00:26.50] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana setting down a bunch of flowers and looking intently at his rugged visage.
[EP08_EL023 | 00:25.00-00:26.80] **JULIANA (Hesitant, Soft):** "Your hair and beard..."
[EP08_EL024 | 00:26.50-00:28.10] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Alexander standing tall over her, looking down patiently.
[EP08_EL025 | 00:28.10-00:31.90] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot as Juliana rises from her stool to stand close in front of him, reaching an affectionate hand toward his temple.
[EP08_EL026 | 00:30.10-00:31.90] **JULIANA (Gentle, Tender):** "I could trim them for you."
[EP08_EL027 | 00:31.90-00:33.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Alexander's large, rough hand firmly but gently catching Juliana's wrist in midair.
[EP08_EL028 | 00:33.20-00:35.50] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot profile of Alexander holding her wrist, his piercing gaze locked onto hers.
[EP08_EL029 | 00:33.20-00:34.50] **ALEXANDER (Firm, Low):** "Not yet."
[EP08_EL030 | 00:35.50-00:37.30] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana looking into his eyes, her brow lightly furrowed in bemused question.
[EP08_EL031 | 00:35.80-00:36.90] **JULIANA (Puzzled, Curious):** "Not yet?"
[EP08_EL032 | 00:37.30-00:39.60] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Alexander, still maintaining his gentle hold on her arm.
[EP08_EL033 | 00:37.70-00:38.90] **ALEXANDER (Grounded, Steady):** "Let them grow."
[EP08_EL034 | 00:39.60-00:42.30] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana smiling with playful warmth.
[EP08_EL035 | 00:39.90-00:42.00] **JULIANA (Playful, Amused):** "You prefer looking like a forest hermit?"
[EP08_EL036 | 00:42.30-00:44.90] **CAMERA:** Intimate two-shot as Alexander slowly lowers her hand, his expression softening.
[EP08_EL037 | 00:43.70-00:44.90] **ALEXANDER (Dry, Droll):** "It has advantages."
[EP08_EL038 | 00:44.90-00:46.90] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana chuckling quietly as she steps back toward the table.
[EP08_EL039 | 00:45.50-00:46.80] **JULIANA (Fond, Resigned):** "Very well."
[EP08_EL040 | 00:46.90-00:48.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Alexander watching her with deep, affectionate attention.
[EP08_EL041 | 00:48.00-00:50.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana grinning with sparkling eyes.
[EP08_EL042 | 00:48.10-00:49.60] **JULIANA (Teasing, Determined):** "But one day, I am trimming that beard."
[EP08_EL043 | 00:50.00-00:51.30] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Alexander lowering his head slightly with a faint smirk.
[EP08_EL044 | 00:50.10-00:51.20] **ALEXANDER (Low, Amused):** "We'll see."
[EP08_EL045 | 00:51.30-00:53.30] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot of both sitting back down at the table together, Alexander turning a brittle page of the herb book.
[EP08_EL046 | 00:53.30-00:57.10] **CAMERA:** Close-up insert of Alexander's weathered finger pointing directly at a delicate botanical illustration of a flowering stem.
[EP08_EL047 | 00:53.30-00:57.00] **ALEXANDER (Instructional, Calm):** "That one grows near the northern stream. Crushed leaves ease swelling."

narrative_moments.summary: Gerald brings word to the Blond Nobleman that the scarred veteran in the woods matches the description of the presumed-dead Duke.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP09_EL070 | 01:28.00-01:30.20] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of The Former Groom, damp dark hair plastered to his forehead.
[EP09_EL071 | 01:28.00-01:30.30] **THE FORMER GROOM (Hesitant, Deferential):** "There is a rumor going around, my Lord."
[EP09_EL072 | 01:30.20-01:32.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.
[EP09_EL073 | 01:30.60-01:31.40] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Coldly Curious):** "What rumor?"
[EP09_EL074 | 01:32.00-01:35.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of The Former Groom speaking cautiously.
[EP09_EL075 | 01:32.10-01:35.10] **THE FORMER GROOM (Uneasy):** "About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke."
[EP09_EL076 | 01:35.00-01:37.20] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman scoffing dismissively as he closes the book.
[EP09_EL077 | 01:35.30-01:37.30] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Mocking, Arrogant):** "People see ghosts whenever they want a story."
[EP09_EL078 | 01:37.20-01:41.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of The Former Groom's eyes widening with urgent dread.
[EP09_EL079 | 01:37.50-01:41.20] **THE FORMER GROOM (Tense, Solemn):** "The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war."
[EP09_EL080 | 01:41.00-01:42.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Blond Nobleman snapping his head around, his smug expression freezing into sudden alarm.
[EP09_EL081 | 01:41.40-01:41.90] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sharp, Demanding):** "Where?"
[EP09_EL082 | 01:42.20-01:44.00] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of The Former Groom shifting uncomfortably.
[EP09_EL083 | 01:42.30-01:43.60] **THE FORMER GROOM (Cautious):** "No one seems certain."
[EP09_EL084 | 01:44.00-01:46.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Blond Nobleman composing his features into cold disdain, though tension trembles beneath his tone.
[EP09_EL085 | 01:44.20-01:45.90] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Dismissive, Masking Panic):** "Then let it remain a rumor."
[EP09_EL086 | 01:46.00-01:48.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot as The Former Groom turns and retreats silently out of the study, leaving the doors closed.
[EP09_EL087 | 01:48.00-01:52.00] **CAMERA:** Side profile shot of the Blond Nobleman seated alone before the roaring fire, staring blankly into the flames in creeping paranoia.
[EP09_EL088 | 01:49.80-01:51.20] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Whispering, Shaken):** "Impossible."

[EP09_EL089 | 01:52.00-01:55.50] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up macro shot of the Blond Nobleman's eye, the flickering fireplace flames dancing across his widening iris as dark dread paralyzes him, holding until the screen cuts to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: Juliana tends to Alexander's battle lacerations and scars, prompting an intimate confession of devotion over his heartbeat.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP10_EL027 | 00:33.20-00:36.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up shot of Alexander pulling his dark shirt over his head, revealing his muscular torso crisscrossed with jagged battle scars and fresh bleeding lacerations.
[EP10_EL028 | 00:36.50-00:38.00] **CAMERA:** Tight pan over the scarred, wounded flesh along his chest and ribs.
[EP10_EL029 | 00:38.00-00:39.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in horror and deep pity.
[EP10_EL030 | 00:38.10-00:38.90] **JULIANA (Whispering, Distressed):** "Dear God."
[EP10_EL031 | 00:39.20-00:43.00] **CAMERA:** Medium wide shot as Alexander sinks back into the chair, exhausted, while Juliana slowly kneels before him on the stone floor.
[EP10_EL032 | 00:43.00-00:45.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up macro shot of Juliana's trembling fingers hovering tenderly over the raised, jagged scar across Alexander's chest.
[EP10_EL033 | 00:45.00-00:47.30] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her eyes softened with profound empathy.
[EP10_EL034 | 00:45.30-00:47.10] **JULIANA (Soft, Sorrowful):** "You have suffered terribly."
[EP10_EL035 | 00:47.30-00:49.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Alexander's weathered, scarred face gazing down at her with quiet stoicism.
[EP10_EL036 | 00:47.80-00:49.00] **ALEXANDER (Quiet, Somber):** "It is over."
[EP10_EL037 | 00:49.50-00:51.50] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana dipping a linen cloth into the water bowl.
[EP10_EL038 | 00:49.70-00:51.30] **JULIANA (Gentle):** "Your scars disagree."
[EP10_EL039 | 00:51.50-00:54.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up shot of Juliana carefully dabbing the damp cloth against the bloody cut on Alexander's shoulder.
[EP10_EL040 | 00:52.00-00:53.30] **JULIANA (Tender):** "Does it hurt?"
[EP10_EL041 | 00:54.00-00:55.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Alexander trying not to wince under her touch.
[EP10_EL042 | 00:54.00-00:55.20] **ALEXANDER (Gruff):** "Not much."
[EP10_EL043 | 00:55.50-00:58.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, amused by his stubborn pride.
[EP10_EL044 | 00:55.60-00:57.60] **JULIANA (Playful, Whispering):** "You are a terrible liar."
[EP10_EL045 | 00:58.00-01:00.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Juliana's fingers taking a dollop of green herbal salve and smoothing it gently over his shoulder wound.
[EP10_EL046 | 01:00.00-01:03.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up over Juliana's shoulder looking at Alexander, who stares intently into her face, oblivious to the wound.
[EP10_EL047 | 01:03.00-01:06.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana looking up from his shoulder into his eyes, sensing the intensity of his gaze.
[EP10_EL048 | 01:03.90-01:06.10] **JULIANA (Soft, Breathless):** "Why do you look at me like that?"
[EP10_EL049 | 01:06.20-01:08.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Alexander, his voice deep and laden with restrained emotion.
[EP10_EL050 | 01:06.50-01:08.40] **ALEXANDER (Intense, Sincere):** "Because you are looking at me."
[EP10_EL051 | 01:08.80-01:11.50] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana looking back down at his shoulder to hide her growing fluster, applying the salve carefully.
[EP10_EL052 | 01:09.60-01:10.90] **JULIANA (Flustered, Whispering):** "Hold still."
[EP10_EL053 | 01:11.50-01:14.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Alexander leaning closer to her, his breathing heavy.
[EP10_EL054 | 01:12.10-01:14.20] **ALEXANDER (Low, Husky):** "I am holding still."
[EP10_EL055 | 01:14.50-01:17.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up two-shot of their faces drawing mere inches apart in the warm firelight.
[EP10_EL056 | 01:16.80-01:19.00] **ALEXANDER (Whispering, Vulnerable):** "Perhaps it is your hand."

[EP10_EL057 | 01:19.00-01:22.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Alexander's large, rough hands reaching up and gently enveloping Juliana's slender hands, bringing them against his bare chest over his racing heart.
[EP10_EL058 | 01:22.50-01:26.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up shot of Alexander gazing into Juliana's eyes with raw, unmasked devotion.
[EP10_EL059 | 01:22.60-01:25.90] **ALEXANDER (Deep, Emotional):** "Your touch is the only medicine that has ever eased my pain."

[EP10_EL060 | 01:26.50-01:34.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up shot holding on Juliana's wide, luminous blue eyes, completely captivated and overwhelmed by his confession, the firelight dancing across their intertwined hands as the scene lingers and fades.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: Gerald arrives with an armed constable to accuse Alexander of stealing his gold pocket watch.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP11_EL015 | 00:16.80-00:18.50] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Gerald pointing an accusatory finger, his composure snapping into hostile anger.
[EP11_EL016 | 00:16.80-00:18.70] **GERALD (Aggressive, Snarl):** "Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!"
[EP11_EL017 | 00:18.50-00:20.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana recoiling in utter disbelief.
[EP11_EL018 | 00:19.00-00:20.00] **JULIANA (Incredulous, Gasping):** "What? When?"
[EP11_EL019 | 00:20.00-00:22.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Gerald narrowing his eyes vindictively.
[EP11_EL020 | 00:20.90-00:22.30] **GERALD (Cold, Certain):** "The last time I came here."
[EP11_EL021 | 00:22.00-00:24.60] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana scoffing, stepping forward as Alexander stands motionless behind her.
[EP11_EL022 | 00:23.00-00:24.80] **JULIANA (Contemptuous, Outraged):** "You never even entered the cottage!"
[EP11_EL023 | 00:24.60-00:26.90] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Gerald smirking with condescending amusement.
[EP11_EL024 | 00:25.20-00:27.00] **GERALD (Smug, Threatening):** "Then you should have nothing to fear from a search."
[EP11_EL025 | 00:26.90-00:28.90] **CAMERA:** Three-shot of Alexander, Juliana, and Gerald in the bleak drizzle.
[EP11_EL026 | 00:27.30-00:29.00] **JULIANA (Adamant, Protective):** "Alexander would never steal from you."
[EP11_EL027 | 00:28.90-00:32.40] **CAMERA:** Low-angle shot of Gerald throwing his head back in arrogant, mocking laughter.
[EP11_EL028 | 00:29.30-00:32.80] **GERALD (Mocking, Spiteful):** "Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!"
[EP11_EL029 | 00:32.40-00:34.90] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Alexander stepping past Juliana, his gaze murderous and jaw rigid.
[EP11_EL030 | 00:33.00-00:34.90] **ALEXANDER (Low, Menacing):** "Choose your next words carefully."
[EP11_EL031 | 00:34.90-00:37.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Gerald pointing back toward the approaching Constable, feigning alarm.
[EP11_EL032 | 00:35.10-00:37.10] **GERALD (Shouting, Dramatic):** "You hear that? He threatens me again!"
[EP11_EL033 | 00:37.00-00:39.10] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Constable marching into frame between them, holding his truncheon horizontally.
[EP11_EL034 | 00:37.40-00:39.20] **CONSTABLE (Authoritative, Stern):** "I have received a complaint of theft."
[EP11_EL035 | 00:39.10-00:41.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Juliana, defiant and resolute.
[EP11_EL036 | 00:39.70-00:41.10] **JULIANA (Fierce):** "A complaint is not proof."
[EP11_EL037 | 00:41.00-00:43.30] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Constable gesturing with his truncheon toward the cottage door.
[EP11_EL038 | 00:41.40-00:43.30] **CONSTABLE (Cold, Procedural):** "Then a search will settle the matter."
[EP11_EL039 | 00:43.30-00:46.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana backing up to the doorway, spreading her arms wide to block the entrance.
[EP11_EL040 | 00:43.50-00:46.30] **JULIANA (Desperate, Shouting):** "You cannot simply invade our home because this man makes an accusation!"
[EP11_EL041 | 00:46.00-00:47.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Gerald crossing his arms smugly.
[EP11_EL042 | 00:46.80-00:48.30] **GERALD (Taunting):** "If he has nothing to hide..."
[EP11_EL043 | 00:47.80-00:50.80] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up push-in on Alexander's scarred face, his eyes smoldering with lethal restraint.
[EP11_EL044 | 00:48.40-00:50.00] **GERALD (O.S.) (Smug):** "...let the constable search."
[EP11_EL045 | 00:50.10-00:51.00] **ALEXANDER (Dark, Grated):** "Search it."
[EP11_EL046 | 00:50.80-00:53.60] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot of Juliana looking up at Alexander in panicked confusion.
[EP11_EL047 | 00:52.80-00:53.60] **ALEXANDER (Resigned, Calm):** "Let them."

narrative_moments.summary: The constable discovers Gerald's planted gold pocket watch hidden inside Alexander's trench coat.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP11_EL075 | 01:29.80-01:32.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Constable turning to Alexander's heavy trench coat hanging on an iron wall hook by the fireplace.
[EP11_EL076 | 01:31.00-01:32.20] **ACTION:** The Constable grabs the coat by the collar and begins rummaging through its deep pockets.
[EP11_EL077 | 01:32.10-01:33.20] **JULIANA (Startled, Shouting):** "That is his coat!"
[EP11_EL078 | 01:33.20-01:36.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Constable's hand sliding deep inside the inner coat lining and withdrawing a gleaming gold pocket watch with an attached chain.
[EP11_EL079 | 01:35.80-01:37.00] **SOUND FX:** Metallic clinking of the gold chain sliding against fabric.
[EP11_EL080 | 01:36.80-01:39.20] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Juliana gasping in sheer horror, her eyes welling with shock and shattered disbelief.
[EP11_EL081 | 01:37.20-01:39.00] **ACTION:** Juliana draws a sharp, terrified breath as her face pales completely.
[EP11_EL082 | 01:39.20-01:42.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Alexander's face hardening into lethal, icy comprehension, realizing the depth of the frame-up.
[EP11_EL083 | 01:42.00-01:46.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up push-in on Gerald's face erupting into an ecstatic, wicked grin, bursting into triumphant laughter.
[EP11_EL084 | 01:44.20-01:46.60] **GERALD (Gloating, Victorious):** "There it is. Ha!"

[EP11_EL085 | 01:46.80-01:52.75] **CAMERA:** Tight macro shot of the gold pocket watch dangling and swaying gently from the Constable's fingers on its long chain, with Gerald blurred in the background grinning with sinister triumph as the scene hangs in a devastating freeze-frame.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: Clarissa offers a sadistic bargain demanding Juliana retrieve an emerald signet ring from frozen briars to save Alexander from the gallows.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP12_EL032 | 00:44.00-00:46.40] **CLARISSA (Cruel, Savoring):** "I want to see you crawl, sister."
[EP12_EL033 | 00:46.60-00:52.40] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up profile tracking shot of Clarissa pacing slowly as she spins her sadistic tale.
[EP12_EL034 | 00:46.70-00:52.30] **CLARISSA (Theatrical, Vindictive):** "My emerald signet ring fell deep into the frozen blackthorn briars at Ashworth Manor. The thorns have grown over it..."
[EP12_EL035 | 00:52.40-00:56.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Clarissa flexing her gloved fingers theatrically in front of her face.
[EP12_EL036 | 00:52.40-00:56.70] **CLARISSA (Chilling, Sarcastic):** "...sharp as steel. The ground is frozen, like pure ice."
[EP12_EL037 | 00:56.80-00:58.00] **ACTION:** Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.
[EP12_EL038 | 00:56.80-01:00.80] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot of Clarissa stepping closer to Juliana, peering down into her eyes with a predatory smile.
[EP12_EL039 | 00:57.30-01:00.60] **CLARISSA (Demanding, Brutal):** "You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives."
[EP12_EL040 | 01:00.80-01:03.20] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Gerald tapping his whip against his palm and laughing heartily beside the Constable.
[EP12_EL041 | 01:00.80-01:03.10] **GERALD (Gleeful, Derisive):** "A lady's hands will be shredded to ribbons!"
[EP12_EL042 | 01:03.20-01:05.20] **CAMERA:** Medium three-shot of Clarissa stepping behind Juliana, as Alexander watches helplessly with dark fury.
[EP12_EL043 | 01:03.30-01:05.10] **CLARISSA (Cold, Transactional):** "Do it, and we withdraw the charges."
[EP12_EL044 | 01:05.20-01:09.50] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Clarissa's mouth leaning directly into Juliana's ear, whispering venomously.
[EP12_EL045 | 01:05.40-01:09.20] **CLARISSA (Whispering, Menacing):** "Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows."
[EP12_EL046 | 01:09.50-01:14.00] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Alexander stepping up beside Juliana, tenderly placing his large hand on her shoulder.
[EP12_EL047 | 01:09.60-01:11.20] **ACTION:** Alexander rests his scarred hand reassuringly on Juliana's shoulder, leaning in toward her.
[EP12_EL048 | 01:09.80-01:13.80] **ALEXANDER (Desperate, Protective, Urgent):** "Juliana, no. Do not let them hurt you. I can handle the law."
[EP12_EL049 | 01:14.00-01:21.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, her hand gripping the fabric over her heart in agony and resolve.
[EP12_EL050 | 01:14.20-01:16.00] **ACTION:** Juliana clutches the front of her rustic grey dress, her breathing trembling.
[EP12_EL051 | 01:15.30-01:18.20] **JULIANA (Fierce, Emotional, Sacrificial):** "I am not letting them take you."
[EP12_EL052 | 01:21.50-01:23.00] **ACTION:** Juliana turns her head sharply back toward Clarissa, her expression hardening with fierce resolution.
[EP12_EL053 | 01:21.80-01:27.21] **CAMERA:** Over-the-shoulder shot past Clarissa onto Juliana's determined face, holding on her fierce, defiant stare as the tension peaks.
[EP12_EL054 | 01:22.80-01:24.70] **JULIANA (Steely, Resolute):** "Tell me where the garden is."

[EP12_EL055 | 01:24.70-01:27.21] **ACTION:** Juliana locks eyes with Clarissa without flinching as the scene freezes on her brave, sacrificial defiance.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: Juliana suffers severe lacerations crawling barehanded through frozen thorns to unearth the emerald signet ring.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP13_EL026 | 00:45.80-00:47.00] **ACTION:** Juliana drops to her knees in front of the frozen blackthorn branches, steadying her trembling breath.
[EP13_EL027 | 00:45.80-00:47.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the frozen soil at the edge of the briars.
[EP13_EL028 | 00:47.00-00:50.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Alexander lunging forward with chained hands raised high, roaring in fury as the Constable grabs him.
[EP13_EL029 | 00:47.20-00:48.80] **ALEXANDER (Screaming, Panicked):** "Juliana, stop!"
[EP13_EL030 | 00:47.80-00:49.20] **SOUND FX:** Rattling of heavy iron chains.
[EP13_EL031 | 00:50.00-00:53.00] **ACTION:** Juliana crawls forward on all fours, lowering her head under the jagged, arching thorns.
[EP13_EL032 | 00:50.00-00:52.00] **CAMERA:** Eye-level shot looking through the thorny thicket at Juliana crawling deeper into the briars.
[EP13_EL033 | 00:51.50-00:52.60] **ALEXANDER (Strangled, Weeping):** "Please..."
[EP13_EL034 | 00:52.00-00:53.50] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Alexander's anguished face as he strains furiously against his handcuffs.
[EP13_EL035 | 00:53.50-00:56.00] **CAMERA:** Ground-level shot of Juliana's bare hands reaching out onto the cracked, frozen ground.
[EP13_EL036 | 00:54.00-00:56.50] **ACTION:** Sharp blackthorn spines rake across Juliana's fingers and knuckles, carving bloody gashes across her skin.
[EP13_EL037 | 00:54.50-00:55.80] **JULIANA (Gasping in Pain):** "No..."
[EP13_EL038 | 00:56.00-00:58.20] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Juliana's hand scraping against the frost-covered stone, bright red blood welling from deep puncture wounds.
[EP13_EL039 | 00:57.20-00:58.60] **CLARISSA (O.S.) (Gleeful, Derisive):** "Look at her hands."
[EP13_EL040 | 00:58.20-01:02.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot on the balcony as Clarissa gleefully points down at Juliana, Gerald chuckling beside her.
[EP13_EL041 | 00:58.80-01:01.80] **CLARISSA (Mocking, Spiteful):** "The lady has finally found something worthy of her."
[EP13_EL042 | 01:02.00-01:04.00] **ACTION:** Gerald leans his hands on the terrace railing, sneering callously.
[EP13_EL043 | 01:02.00-01:07.50] **CAMERA:** Low-angle medium close-up of Gerald shouting down into the garden.
[EP13_EL044 | 01:02.20-01:07.00] **GERALD (Taunting, Cruel):** "Keep searching, Juliana. Your husband's freedom is somewhere in that garden."
[EP13_EL045 | 01:07.50-01:11.20] **CAMERA:** Macro close-up of a massive blackthorn needle stabbing deep into the back of Juliana's bleeding hand.
[EP13_EL046 | 01:08.50-01:10.20] **SOUND FX:** Sickening crunch and scrape of thorns slicing through flesh.
[EP13_EL047 | 01:11.20-01:14.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Alexander struggling in agony, tears forming in his eyes.
[EP13_EL048 | 01:11.40-01:13.80] **ALEXANDER (Desperate, Choked):** "Please... enough!"
[EP13_EL049 | 01:14.00-01:18.00] **CAMERA:** Wide tunnel shot through the briars as Juliana crawls deeper into the dark, frozen tangle.
[EP13_EL050 | 01:14.50-01:18.00] **ACTION:** Juliana drags her body across the frozen, cracked soil beneath the dense roof of briars.
[EP13_EL051 | 01:18.00-01:20.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana's hand getting snagged between two vicious thorns, tearing her sleeve and flesh.
[EP13_EL052 | 01:18.50-01:20.50] **JULIANA (Screaming in Pain):** "Ah!"
[EP13_EL053 | 01:20.50-01:23.00] **ACTION:** Alexander loses control, violently lunging past the Constable toward the briars.
[EP13_EL054 | 01:20.50-01:23.00] **CAMERA:** Medium tracking shot of Alexander breaking into a desperate charge.
[EP13_EL055 | 01:20.80-01:22.20] **ALEXANDER (Furious, Booming):** "Stop!"
[EP13_EL056 | 01:23.00-01:26.00] **ACTION:** Juliana continues clawing forward, branches lacerating her arm and cheek.
[EP13_EL057 | 01:23.00-01:26.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana wincing in agony and screaming through clenched teeth.
[EP13_EL058 | 01:23.80-01:25.80] **JULIANA (Agonized Scream):** "Ahhh!"
[EP13_EL059 | 01:26.00-01:29.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Constable forcefully grappling Alexander by his coat collar, slamming him back against the gate.
[EP13_EL060 | 01:26.50-01:28.80] **ALEXANDER (Roaring in Torment):** "Juliana!"
[EP13_EL061 | 01:29.00-01:34.00] **CAMERA:** Ground-level shot of Juliana frantically digging and scraping at the frozen dirt and dried bramble pods with both bloody hands.
[EP13_EL062 | 01:29.20-01:34.00] **ACTION:** Juliana digs her torn fingers into the frost-hardened earth, turning over rocks and dead vegetation.
[EP13_EL063 | 01:34.00-01:37.00] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Alexander struggling against the Constable, his face twisted in grief and rage.
[EP13_EL064 | 01:34.80-01:36.40] **ALEXANDER (Desperate Shout):** "Juliana!"
[EP13_EL065 | 01:37.00-01:43.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana lying on her stomach among the thorns, bleeding cuts running down her forehead, cheeks, and bare arms.
[EP13_EL066 | 01:38.20-01:42.50] **JULIANA (Panting, Praying):** "Please, ring... you have to be here."
[EP13_EL067 | 01:43.00-01:46.50] **ACTION:** Her blood-smeared index finger brushes against a solid metallic object half-buried in the frozen dirt beneath a thorny branch.
[EP13_EL068 | 01:43.00-01:47.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up macro shot of an ornate antique gold ring set with a massive, radiant emerald resting in the frosted soil.
[EP13_EL069 | 01:47.00-01:49.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana's wide, disbelieving blue eyes as breath catches in her throat.
[EP13_EL070 | 01:49.00-01:52.00] **ACTION:** Juliana reaches out her torn, bloodied hand and wraps her fingers tightly around the emerald ring.
[EP13_EL071 | 01:49.00-01:52.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of her bloody hand closing around the emerald signet ring.
[EP13_EL072 | 01:52.00-01:53.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana grimacing in fierce triumph and intense pain as thorns catch her knuckles.
[EP13_EL073 | 01:53.00-01:54.00] **CAMERA:** Brief cut to Alexander staring into the briar patch in suspended terror.
[EP13_EL074 | 01:54.00-01:57.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Juliana's sweat- and frost-streaked face as she grinds her teeth, tears pooling in her eyes, fighting through the blinding pain.

[EP13_EL075 | 01:57.20-01:58.88] **CAMERA:** Macro close-up holding on Juliana's bloodied fist firmly gripping the emerald ring against the frozen ground as the episode cuts to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: After bandaging Juliana's mangled hands, Alexander vows that no one will ever hurt her for protecting him again.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP14_EL044 | 01:10.50-01:16.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot as Juliana rests her cheek against Alexander's chest; he embraces her tightly against him, cradling her head under his chin.
[EP14_EL045 | 01:11.00-01:16.00] **ACTION:** Juliana closes her eyes in exhausted relief, sinking into Alexander's warmth as his broad arm encloses her safely.
[EP14_EL046 | 01:16.00-01:23.50] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of Alexander holding Juliana against his bearded cheek, kissing the crown of her head before gently cradling her jaw in his scarred hand.
[EP14_EL047 | 01:16.50-01:21.00] **ALEXANDER (Dark, Solemn Vow):** "No one will ever hurt you for protecting me again."
[EP14_EL048 | 01:21.20-01:23.50] **ACTION:** Alexander strokes her cheek with his thumb, his gaze hardening into deadly, protective conviction.

[EP15_EL036 | 00:49.50-00:53.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up tracking down to Juliana's hand hitting the mud next to the crushed chamomile flowers.
[EP15_EL037 | 00:50.00-00:53.50] **ACTION:** Juliana crawls forward on her elbows; fresh crimson blood seeps profusely through her white gauze bandages as she reaches for the ruined blossoms.
[EP15_EL038 | 00:53.50-00:56.50] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up on Juliana's mud-streaked, tear-stained face trembling in heartbreaking agony.
[EP15_EL039 | 00:53.50-00:55.70] **JULIANA (Broken, Sobbing):** "My mother's plants..."

[EP15_EL041 | 00:57.30-00:59.80] **BALD THUG (Cruel, Laughing):** "Look at her! Crying over weeds!"

[EP15_EL044 | 01:02.00-01:03.20] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap suddenly stiffening, his smug smile dropping as footsteps pound in the darkness.

[EP15_EL048 | 01:10.50-01:12.60] **JULIANA (Whispered Breath, Stunned):** "Alexander..."
