[EP22_EL028 | 00:46.00-00:49.00] **PRUDENCE (Submissive):** "Julian, ma'am. New help for the winter cleaning."
[EP22_EL029 | 00:49.20-00:52.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up profile of the Housekeeper sizing up Juliana critically.
[EP22_EL030 | 00:49.50-00:51.80] **HOUSEKEEPER (Cold, Skeptical):** "She looks soft."
[EP22_EL031 | 00:51.80-00:53.00] **ACTION:** Close-up on Lady Juliana's hands gripping the iron handle of the wooden wash bucket firmly.
[EP22_EL032 | 00:52.80-00:55.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Lady Juliana keeping her eyes dutifully lowered.
[EP22_EL033 | 00:52.80-00:54.80] **LADY JULIANA (Humble, Steady):** "I can work, ma'am."
[EP22_EL034 | 00:55.20-00:58.50] **CAMERA:** Low-angle shot of the Housekeeper staring down coldly.
[EP22_EL035 | 00:56.00-00:58.00] **HOUSEKEEPER (Demanding):** "Can you scrub stone?"
[EP22_EL036 | 00:58.50-01:00.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Lady Juliana nodding slightly.
[EP22_EL037 | 00:58.50-00:59.80] **LADY JULIANA (Subdued):** "Yes, ma'am."
[EP22_EL038 | 01:00.20-01:01.80] **HOUSEKEEPER (Harsh, O.S.):** "Carry coal?"
[EP22_EL039 | 01:00.20-01:02.30] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Housekeeper's stern face.
[EP22_EL040 | 01:02.30-01:04.20] **CAMERA:** Cut back to Lady Juliana maintaining her meek posture.
[EP22_EL041 | 01:02.50-01:03.80] **LADY JULIANA (Polite):** "Yes, ma'am."
[EP22_EL042 | 01:04.20-01:09.80] **CAMERA:** Profile medium two-shot as the Housekeeper steps right up into Lady Juliana's face, staring intently into her downcast eyes.
[EP22_EL043 | 01:06.00-01:09.50] **HOUSEKEEPER (Menacing, Threatening):** "And can you keep your eyes and ears where they belong?"
[EP22_EL044 | 01:09.80-01:13.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up on Lady Juliana's composed, lowered face.
[EP22_EL045 | 01:11.20-01:12.60] **LADY JULIANA (Subdued, Steady):** "Yes, ma'am."
[EP22_EL046 | 01:13.00-01:18.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Housekeeper turning and pointing a bony finger toward the servant corridor stairs.
[EP22_EL047 | 01:13.20-01:17.50] **HOUSEKEEPER (Stern, Dismissive):** "Then prove it. The manor has no use for useless girls."
[EP22_EL048 | 01:17.50-01:21.00] **ACTION:** The Housekeeper turns and stalks away down the corridor. Prudence exhales a trembling breath of relief.

narrative_moments.summary: Juliana sneaks into the West Wing bedchamber and discovers the Dowager Duchess convulsing from unnatural fever.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP22_EL067 | 01:48.50-01:53.80] **CAMERA:** Slow tracking shot into the cavernous, shadowy bedchamber. In the center stands an ornate four-poster canopy bed draped in pale silk where a frail, silver-haired figure lies motionless.
[EP22_EL068 | 01:49.00-01:54.00] **SOUND FX:** Labored, raspy, shallow breathing echoing in the quiet room.
[EP22_EL069 | 01:53.80-01:56.00] **ACTION:** Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.
[EP22_EL070 | 01:54.00-01:55.50] **LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Concerned):** "Your Grace?"
[EP22_EL071 | 01:55.50-01:58.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped on pillows, her face gaunt, ashen, and drenched in cold sweat, her eyes half-fluttering.
[EP22_EL072 | 01:58.20-02:00.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Lady Juliana taking the Duchess's fragile, cold hands into her own.
[EP22_EL073 | 01:58.20-01:59.80] **LADY JULIANA (Soft, Comforting):** "Do not speak."

[EP22_EL074 | 02:00.80-02:05.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Lady Juliana checking the Duchess's pulse and gently pressing her fingertips against the Duchess's chest and neck, her herbalist instincts taking over.
[EP22_EL075 | 02:03.00-02:05.80] **ACTION:** Lady Juliana's eyes widen with sudden, horrifying realization.
[EP22_EL076 | 02:03.50-02:05.80] **LADY JULIANA (Shocked, Murmuring):** "This isn't ordinary fever."
[EP22_EL077 | 02:05.80-02:07.00] **ACTION:** The Dowager Duchess suddenly gasps violently for breath, convulsing weakly as her eyes snap open in agony.
[EP22_EL078 | 02:05.80-02:07.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Duchess gasping in sudden spasms.
[EP22_EL079 | 02:07.00-02:08.80] **CAMERA:** Intense two-shot as Lady Juliana leans in close, gripping the Duchess's shoulder with urgent desperation.
[EP22_EL080 | 02:07.20-02:08.80] **LADY JULIANA (Urgent, Alarmed):** "Who has been treating you?"

[EP22_EL081 | 02:08.80-02:11.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up on the Dowager Duchess's terrified, wide eyes staring up as she chokes for air, the haunting realization of poison lingering as dramatic music hits an abrupt, suspenseful cliffhanger.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: Juliana inspects the Duchess's blackened fingernails against her mother's journal and identifies arsenic poisoning.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP23_EL024 | 00:48.00-00:53.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana sitting at the foot of the bed, carefully opening the leather journal across her lap and flipping through hand-annotated botanical pages.

[EP23_EL025 | 00:53.50-00:57.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up overhead of the yellowed parchment, showing botanical sketches of toxic herbs and handwritten diagnostic notes as Juliana's finger traces along the script.
[EP23_EL026 | 00:57.50-00:58.50] **ACTION:** Juliana draws in a sharp, startled breath, her eyes widening in horror.
[EP23_EL027 | 00:58.50-01:00.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana looking up from the page, stunned by her mother's written words.
[EP23_EL028 | 00:58.50-01:00.00] **LADY JULIANA (Breathless, Reverent):** "Mother."
[EP23_EL029 | 01:00.80-01:02.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Prudence leaning in, candle trembling.
[EP23_EL030 | 01:00.80-01:02.00] **PRUDENCE (Urgent, Baffled):** "What is it?"
[EP23_EL031 | 01:02.00-01:09.50] **CAMERA:** Two-shot of Juliana holding the open journal, reciting the matching symptoms to Prudence while the Duchess lies motionless in the background.
[EP23_EL032 | 01:02.00-01:08.50] **LADY JULIANA (Shocked, Deliberate):** "Weakness. Dry mouth. The discoloration beneath the nails. The slow wasting."
[EP23_EL033 | 01:09.50-01:10.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Prudence staring back in stunned disbelief.
[EP23_EL034 | 01:10.50-01:13.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana speaking with absolute certainty.
[EP23_EL035 | 01:10.50-01:13.50] **LADY JULIANA (Serious, Chilled):** "I have seen these symptoms before."
[EP23_EL036 | 01:13.80-01:16.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Prudence's terrified face.
[EP23_EL037 | 01:13.80-01:15.80] **PRUDENCE (Panicked, Shaken):** "What are you saying?"
[EP23_EL038 | 01:16.00-01:18.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana's hands snapping the leather journal shut on the bedside table beside an oil lamp.
[EP23_EL039 | 01:18.50-01:21.50] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana resting her hands on the closed journal, looking squarely at Prudence.
[EP23_EL040 | 01:19.00-01:21.50] **LADY JULIANA (Cold, Deadly Serious):** "Someone is poisoning her."
[EP23_EL041 | 01:21.50-01:24.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Prudence gasping sharply and clamping both hands over her mouth in sheer horror.
[EP23_EL042 | 01:21.50-01:22.50] **SOUND FX:** Sharp intake of breath from Prudence.
[EP23_EL043 | 01:22.00-01:24.00] **PRUDENCE (Muffled, Horrified):** "Poison?"
[EP23_EL044 | 01:24.50-01:28.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up pushing in tight on Lady Juliana's eyes as her expression hardens into fury and righteous disgust.
[EP23_EL045 | 01:26.00-01:28.00] **LADY JULIANA (Venomous, Resolute):** "Arsenic."

narrative_moments.summary: While Juliana frantically grinds charcoal antidote in a stone mortar, an unknown person turns the chamber door handle.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP23_EL056 | 01:47.00-01:52.50] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana grinding intensely, her brow furrowed as she speaks with urgent authority.
[EP23_EL057 | 01:47.50-01:52.00] **LADY JULIANA (Urgent, Focused):** "The charcoal may help remove what is still inside her. We must act quickly."
[EP23_EL058 | 01:52.20-01:54.00] **SOUND FX:** Sudden muffled thump and heavy footsteps echoing from the hallway outside the door!
[EP23_EL059 | 01:52.50-01:55.00] **CAMERA:** Wide shot of the bedroom door framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess gasps in the bed.
[EP23_EL060 | 01:55.00-01:56.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana freezing mid-motion, turning her head sharply toward the chamber door.
[EP23_EL061 | 01:56.50-01:58.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the ornate brass door handle on the dark carved wooden door.
[EP23_EL062 | 01:58.50-02:04.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Prudence staring at the door in utter terror, her face drained of all color.
[EP23_EL063 | 01:58.80-02:04.00] **PRUDENCE (Terrified, Hoarse Whisper):** "Juliana... someone is coming."
[EP23_EL064 | 02:04.50-02:07.50] **CAMERA:** Quick cut to Juliana looking back toward the bed and then toward the door, trapped with an unfinished cure.
[EP23_EL065 | 02:07.50-02:09.50] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of Juliana's charcoal-blackened hand clutching the glass medicine vial firmly.
[EP23_EL066 | 02:09.20-02:11.20] **SOUND FX:** Loud, metallic clack of the door latch turning, followed by the slow creak of wood hinges.

[EP23_EL067 | 02:09.50-02:11.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up on the brass door lever as it slowly rotates downward, and the heavy door cracks open inward into the room—cutting to an intense, heart-stopping cliffhanger.

narrative_moments.summary: Lady Catherine strikes Juliana with a riding crop across the torso to reinforce her subservient status as a maid.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP24_EL020 | 00:28.80-00:30.80] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of the noblewoman's face twisting into a malicious sneer.
[EP24_EL021 | 00:29.00-00:30.80] **NOBLEWOMAN (Vicious, Venomous):** "Then let her suffer."
[EP24_EL022 | 00:30.80-00:32.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana recoiling slightly in shock at the blatant cruelty.
[EP24_EL023 | 00:31.00-00:32.50] **LADY JULIANA (Steely, Steadfast):** "I cannot do that."

[EP24_EL025 | 00:32.80-00:33.80] **SOUND FX:** A sharp, stinging whip crack as the riding crop makes harsh contact.
[EP24_EL026 | 00:33.80-00:36.50] **ACTION:** Juliana gasps in pain, clutching her stomach and bending over as she absorbs the brutal strike.
[EP24_EL027 | 00:33.80-00:36.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana hunched over in pain, clutching her abdomen.
[EP24_EL028 | 00:35.00-00:36.80] **NOBLEWOMAN (Cold, Threatening):** "You are a maid."
[EP24_EL029 | 00:36.80-00:38.80] **CAMERA:** Low-angle shot looking past the bedpost toward the Duchess, whose trembling hand reaches out limply.
[EP24_EL030 | 00:37.00-00:38.80] **NOBLEWOMAN (Cold, Continuing):** "Not a physician. Not a lady."
[EP24_EL031 | 00:38.80-00:43.00] **CAMERA:** Dramatic low-angle wide shot of the noblewoman standing imperiously over the doubled-over Juliana.
[EP24_EL032 | 00:39.00-00:42.80] **NOBLEWOMAN (Disdainful, Final):** "And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters."
[EP24_EL033 | 00:43.00-00:45.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana looking down, enduring the humiliation while stifling her breath.
[EP24_EL034 | 00:43.20-00:44.80] **LADY JULIANA (Subdued, Controlled):** "Yes, my lady."
[EP24_EL035 | 00:45.50-00:48.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the noblewoman turning the crop in her white-gloved hands with smug satisfaction.
[EP24_EL036 | 00:45.50-00:48.00] **NOBLEWOMAN (Smug, Condescending):** "Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place."

narrative_moments.summary: Condemned to scrub the soot-caked hearthstones, Juliana conceals the antidote bottle and vows to save the Duchess.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP24_EL047 | 01:03.80-01:06.00] **ACTION:** Juliana slowly drops to her knees on the cold flagstones before the soot-filled fireplace.
[EP24_EL048 | 01:03.80-01:06.20] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana sinking to her knees, her face grim and composed.
[EP24_EL049 | 01:06.00-01:07.50] **ACTION:** Prudence steps toward the noblewoman in distress, her hands clasped tightly.
[EP24_EL050 | 01:06.20-01:07.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Prudence's anxious, trembling face.
[EP24_EL051 | 01:06.20-01:07.50] **PRUDENCE (Desperate, Pleading):** "My lady—"
[EP24_EL052 | 01:07.50-01:09.50] **ACTION:** The noblewoman whips around sharply, thrusting the tip of her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.

[EP24_EL054 | 01:08.00-01:10.50] **NOBLEWOMAN (Furious, Threatening):** "Do you want the same punishment?"
[EP24_EL055 | 01:10.50-01:12.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Prudence flinching in terror, lowering her eyes immediately.
[EP24_EL056 | 01:10.60-01:12.40] **PRUDENCE (Terrified, Murmuring):** "No, my lady."
[EP24_EL057 | 01:12.50-01:14.50] **ACTION:** Juliana grips a coarse scrubbing brush with both hands and begins vigorously scraping the thick black ash across the hearthstones.
[EP24_EL058 | 01:12.80-01:14.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up shot of Juliana's soot-covered hands fiercely scrubbing the black ash along the stone floor.
[EP24_EL059 | 01:13.00-01:21.00] **SOUND FX:** Rhythmic, harsh rasping sound of bristles scraping against stone.
[EP24_EL060 | 01:14.80-01:18.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the noblewoman leaning casually against the wooden doorframe, watching Juliana toil with smug condescension.
[EP24_EL061 | 01:15.00-01:18.00] **NOBLEWOMAN (Smug, Gleeful):** "That is where clever little servants belong."
[EP24_EL062 | 01:18.50-01:21.20] **CAMERA:** Medium profile shot of Juliana kneeling by the hearth in the dim window light, scrubbing steadily.

[EP24_EL067 | 01:25.20-01:31.50] **ACTION:** Juliana raises her head. Smudges of dark soot stain her fair cheek, but her piercing blue eyes burn with unwavering defiance and unyielding resolve as she stares toward the hallway.

[EP24_EL069 | 01:25.60-01:29.80] **LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Steely, Unstoppable):** "I will return. You cannot stop the healer."

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: Alexander inspects Juliana's bleeding shoulder wound in the forest and learns Lady Catherine whipped her.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP25_EL009 | 00:13.20-00:16.00] **ACTION:** Alexander steps forward and reaches out, his gloved hand firmly grasping her left shoulder. Juliana winces sharply and gasps in sudden pain.
[EP25_EL010 | 00:13.20-00:16.20] **CAMERA:** Two-shot profile of Alexander grabbing Juliana's shoulder as she recoils.
[EP25_EL011 | 00:14.90-00:16.10] **ALEXANDER (Sharp, Alarmed):** "You're hurt."
[EP25_EL012 | 00:16.20-00:18.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana gritting her teeth against the pain, shaking her head.
[EP25_EL013 | 00:16.80-00:18.50] **JULIANA (Strained, Minimizing):** "It is nothing."
[EP25_EL014 | 00:18.80-00:22.50] **ACTION:** Alexander's gloved fingers pull back the torn fabric of her cloak and sleeve, revealing a raw, bloody welt slashing across her bare shoulder.

[EP25_EL016 | 00:22.80-00:25.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Alexander's scarred face darkening with volatile fury, his jaw tightening.
[EP25_EL017 | 00:24.00-00:25.50] **ALEXANDER (Seething, Dangerous):** "Who did this?"

[EP25_EL019 | 00:27.50-00:29.30] **JULIANA (Subdued, Weary):** "It does not matter."
[EP25_EL020 | 00:29.80-00:32.80] **CAMERA:** Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes burning with intense anger.
[EP25_EL021 | 00:32.80-00:34.50] **ACTION:** Alexander steps directly into her space, firmly taking her hand in his.
[EP25_EL022 | 00:32.80-00:33.80] **ALEXANDER (Demanding, Stern):** "Who?"
[EP25_EL023 | 00:34.50-00:38.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes, whispering the truth.
[EP25_EL024 | 00:36.00-00:37.80] **JULIANA (Quiet, Apprehensive):** "Lady Catherine."

narrative_moments.summary: Juliana reveals to an enraged Alexander that the Dowager Duchess is being systematically murdered with repeated arsenic doses.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP25_EL037 | 00:55.60-00:57.20] **JULIANA (Solemn):** "The Dowager Duchess."
[EP25_EL038 | 00:57.50-01:03.50] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of Alexander's face freezing in shock, his eyes widening as the revelation hits him.
[EP25_EL039 | 01:00.80-01:02.50] **ALEXANDER (Stunned, Disbelieving):** "The Dowager?"
[EP25_EL040 | 01:03.50-01:08.50] **CAMERA:** Medium profile tracking shot as Juliana begins walking slowly along the trail, Alexander following closely by her side.
[EP25_EL041 | 01:06.20-01:08.50] **JULIANA (Urgent):** "Prudence told me she was dying."
[EP25_EL042 | 01:08.50-01:13.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana turning toward him, recounting the scene in the bedchamber.
[EP25_EL043 | 01:08.80-01:13.80] **JULIANA (Fervent):** "She was barely breathing when I found her. The doctor said she was simply growing old."
[EP25_EL044 | 01:13.80-01:16.80] **CAMERA:** Two-shot as Juliana stops and looks up into Alexander's grim expression.
[EP25_EL045 | 01:14.20-01:15.80] **JULIANA (Chilling, Definite):** "But it wasn't age."
[EP25_EL046 | 01:16.80-01:19.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Alexander staring down at her, waiting for the dark truth.
[EP25_EL047 | 01:17.40-01:18.90] **ALEXANDER (Grim, Low):** "What did you find?"
[EP25_EL048 | 01:19.50-01:22.50] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up on Juliana's trembling lips.
[EP25_EL049 | 01:20.20-01:21.80] **JULIANA (Hushed, Horrified):** "Poison."
[EP25_EL050 | 01:22.50-01:26.20] **CAMERA:** Slightly wider close-up as Juliana's eyes well with distress.
[EP25_EL052 | 01:26.20-01:30.00] **ACTION:** Alexander's hand drops to his side and clenches into a white-knuckled fist, the thick scar across his hand tightening with intense restraint.
[EP25_EL053 | 01:26.20-01:30.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Alexander's fist clenching tightly in fury.
[EP25_EL054 | 01:30.20-01:37.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana, her voice filled with mounting dread.
[EP25_EL055 | 01:30.20-01:37.40] **JULIANA (Pained, Troubled):** "Someone has been giving it to her again and again. Small amounts. Enough to make her weaker without killing her quickly."

narrative_moments.summary: Dowager Duchess spots a distinctive signet ring bearing her lost son's family crest on Juliana's hand while receiving the charcoal antidote.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP26_EL034 | 01:26.50-01:30.80] **CAMERA:** Medium tracking down Juliana's apron to her hand as she rests it against the bed linens, revealing a distinctive engraved signet ring on her finger.
[EP26_EL035 | 01:27.00-01:30.50] **ACTION:** Juliana rests her right hand against the edge of the bedcover, unwittingly placing the unique ring directly within the Duchess's line of sight.
[EP26_EL036 | 01:30.20-01:32.00] **SOUND FX:** A sharp, stunned gasp.
[EP26_EL037 | 01:30.80-01:35.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of the Dowager Duchess gasping sharply, her eyes widening in profound shock as all color drains from her face.
[EP26_EL038 | 01:30.80-01:35.00] **ACTION:** The Duchess's mouth hangs open in pure disbelief as she stares fixedly at Juliana's hand.
[EP26_EL039 | 01:35.00-01:40.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Duchess pushing herself up against the headboard, trembling as she stretches out her frail hand.
[EP26_EL040 | 01:36.00-01:39.80] **DOWAGER DUCHESS (Breathless, Shaken):** "Your hand... Let me see your hand."
[EP26_EL041 | 01:40.00-01:45.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana reacting with confusion and growing concern at the elder woman's sudden frenzy.
[EP26_EL042 | 01:40.50-01:45.00] **JULIANA (Confused, Alarmed):** "Your Grace? What is wrong? You look as though you've seen a ghost."
[EP26_EL043 | 01:45.50-01:49.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up shot of the Duchess's withered, shaking hand reaching across the blanket toward Juliana's arm.
[EP26_EL044 | 01:46.00-01:49.00] **ACTION:** The Duchess reaches outward with trembling fingers, grasping frantically for Juliana.
[EP26_EL045 | 01:48.80-01:50.00] **SOUND FX:** A sudden sharp rustle of fabric as her fingers snap tight.
[EP26_EL046 | 01:49.00-01:50.80] **CAMERA:** Tight shot of the Duchess's frail hand clamping down with fierce, unexpected strength onto Juliana's dark sleeve.
[EP26_EL047 | 01:49.20-01:50.60] **DOWAGER DUCHESS (Stern, Desperate):** "Do not move!"
[EP26_EL048 | 01:50.80-01:55.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Dowager Duchess looking up at Juliana with overwhelming urgency and tears brimming in her wide eyes.
[EP26_EL049 | 01:51.00-01:55.50] **DOWAGER DUCHESS (Intense, Demanding):** "Where... where... Where did you get this ring? Speak to me!"
[EP26_EL050 | 01:55.80-01:59.50] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana frozen in shock, her breath catching as the Duchess's desperate words echo in the silence of the room.

[EP26_EL051 | 01:59.50-02:00.88] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of the Dowager Duchess's two weathered hands tightly clasping Juliana's hand, holding the signet ring between them as a dramatic orchestral cliffhanger chord swells, cutting sharply to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: Rupert and Catherine ambush Juliana at the Duchess's bedside, seize her antidote dropper bottle, and frame her for poisoning Her Grace.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP27_EL040 | 01:06.50-01:10.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman stepping forward beside Lady Catherine, clad in a dark tailored coat with black leather gloves.
[EP27_EL041 | 01:06.60-01:10.10] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Authoritative):** "Girl. Show me what you are holding."
[EP27_EL042 | 01:10.50-01:13.80] **CAMERA:** Two-shot of Juliana facing the Blond Nobleman as she slowly extends her palm, revealing the small amber glass dropper bottle.
[EP27_EL043 | 01:12.60-01:13.70] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Skeptical):** "What is this?"
[EP27_EL044 | 01:13.80-01:14.80] **JULIANA (Steady):** "Medicine."
[EP27_EL045 | 01:14.80-01:17.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Lady Catherine tapping her gloved finger to her lip, letting out a mocking scoff.
[EP27_EL046 | 01:15.20-01:17.80] **LADY CATHERINE (Mocking, Condescending):** "Medicine? You are a new maid."
[EP27_EL047 | 01:17.80-01:20.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman staring down at the vial, as Catherine sneers from his side.
[EP27_EL048 | 01:18.10-01:20.50] **LADY CATHERINE (Incredulous, Accusing):** "Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?"
[EP27_EL049 | 01:20.80-01:23.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana holding her ground.
[EP27_EL050 | 01:21.00-01:22.00] **JULIANA (Quiet, Resolute):** "No one."
[EP27_EL051 | 01:23.00-01:26.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Lady Catherine turning fiercely triumphant.
[EP27_EL052 | 01:23.60-01:26.40] **LADY CATHERINE (Spiteful, Indignant):** "Then you administered it without permission."
[EP27_EL053 | 01:26.50-01:28.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana, her voice rising passionately.
[EP27_EL054 | 01:26.50-01:27.80] **JULIANA (Passionate, Urgent):** "Because she was dying!"
[EP27_EL055 | 01:28.00-01:32.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman pacing forward with calculating malice.
[EP27_EL056 | 01:28.20-01:32.40] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Interrogating):** "And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?"
[EP27_EL057 | 01:32.80-01:35.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana retorting without hesitation.
[EP27_EL058 | 01:33.30-01:34.90] **JULIANA (Fierce):** "The physicians were not saving her!"
[EP27_EL059 | 01:35.00-01:37.80] **CAMERA:** Over-the-shoulder shot past the Blond Nobleman looking toward the frail Duchess watching helplessly from the bed.
[EP27_EL060 | 01:35.30-01:37.70] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Measured, Menacing):** "My aunt has been wasting away for months."
[EP27_EL061 | 01:37.80-01:43.60] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman turning slowly back toward Juliana, building his trap.
[EP27_EL062 | 01:38.80-01:43.40] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Smooth, Threatening):** "And now we find an unknown maid alone beside her bed..."
[EP27_EL063 | 01:43.60-01:47.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up shot of his gloved black leather finger reaching down to tap against the glass dropper bottle in Juliana's open palm.
[EP27_EL064 | 01:44.20-01:47.50] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Contemptuous):** "...holding a substance no one authorized her to give."
[EP27_EL065 | 01:47.80-01:50.20] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana raising the small bottle high for them to see.
[EP27_EL066 | 01:48.30-01:49.80] **JULIANA (Unyielding):** "It is an antidote."
[EP27_EL067 | 01:50.20-01:52.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Lady Catherine sneering sharply.
[EP27_EL068 | 01:50.30-01:51.80] **LADY CATHERINE (Sharp, Provocative):** "An antidote to what?"
[EP27_EL069 | 01:52.50-01:53.60] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Juliana's focused eyes.
[EP27_EL070 | 01:53.20-01:54.30] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Stern, Barked):** "Answer her."
[EP27_EL071 | 01:53.60-01:55.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up on the Blond Nobleman's impatient scowl.
[EP27_EL072 | 01:55.00-01:57.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana speaking the truth clearly.
[EP27_EL073 | 01:55.10-01:56.50] **JULIANA (Unyielding, Resolute):** "Poison."
[EP27_EL074 | 01:57.20-02:00.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up on the Blond Nobleman, his expression freezing into a dark scowl.
[EP27_EL075 | 01:58.70-01:59.80] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Whispering, Dangerous):** "Poison."
[EP27_EL076 | 02:00.00-02:02.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana stating the grim reality.
[EP27_EL077 | 02:00.40-02:02.60] **JULIANA (Urgent):** "Someone has been poisoning Her Grace."
[EP27_EL078 | 02:02.80-02:04.60] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Lady Catherine turning abruptly to the guard stationed by the open door, pointing with feigned outrage.
[EP27_EL079 | 02:03.10-02:04.50] **LADY CATHERINE (Shrieking, Feigning Horror):** "You hear that?!"
[EP27_EL080 | 02:04.60-02:08.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Lady Catherine twisting Juliana's words with malicious glee.
[EP27_EL081 | 02:04.80-02:08.40] **LADY CATHERINE (Venomous, Accusing):** "She admits she has been giving the Duchess poison in secret!"
[EP27_EL082 | 02:08.50-02:11.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana recoiling in shock at the blatant lie.
[EP27_EL083 | 02:08.70-02:10.80] **JULIANA (Desperate, Outraged):** "That is not what I said!"
[EP27_EL084 | 02:11.00-02:14.00] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman raising his black-gloved hand, silencing the room.
[EP27_EL085 | 02:11.20-02:12.60] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Authoritative, Icy):** "Enough."
[EP27_EL086 | 02:14.00-02:19.40] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot as the Blond Nobleman steps into Juliana's personal space and plucks the glass dropper vial from her hand.
[EP27_EL087 | 02:14.80-02:18.50] **ACTION:** The Blond Nobleman takes the medicine vial from Juliana's grasp, inspecting it under the candlelight.
[EP27_EL088 | 02:16.20-02:19.30] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Calculating):** "An unknown servant enters a restricted chamber."
[EP27_EL089 | 02:19.40-02:24.20] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of the Blond Nobleman holding the vial beside his temple, his blue eyes cold and triumphant.
[EP27_EL090 | 02:19.60-02:23.80] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Condemning, Vindictive):** "She secretly administers an unidentified substance to a helpless woman."
[EP27_EL091 | 02:24.00-02:24.90] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (To Guard, Stern):** "Take her."
[EP27_EL092 | 02:24.20-02:27.50] **CAMERA:** Wide shot as the armed guard storms forward, seizing Juliana roughly by both arms.
[EP27_EL093 | 02:25.00-02:28.00] **ACTION:** The guard twists Juliana around and drags her forcibly toward the doorway as she struggles against his grip.
[EP27_EL094 | 02:27.50-02:29.20] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana being pulled backward, casting a frantic glance back toward the bedridden Duchess.

[EP27_EL095 | 02:29.20-02:30.50] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, terrified eyes as she realizes the deadly trap closing around her, cutting abruptly to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: Catherine finds the fallen herbarium journal and triumphantly reveals Juliana's true lineage as the disgraced Lady Juliana Ashcroft.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP28_EL065 | 01:26.50-01:31.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Catherine walking toward the fallen leather-bound book and kneeling gracefully to pick it up.
[EP28_EL066 | 01:28.00-01:31.00] **ACTION:** Catherine lifts the heavy herbarium, dusting off the cover before opening its aged parchment pages.
[EP28_EL067 | 01:31.00-01:33.80] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of Catherine reading the elegant cursive script inside the front cover.
[EP28_EL068 | 01:31.20-01:32.80] **CATHERINE (Intrigued, Murmuring):** "Juliana..."
[EP28_EL069 | 01:33.80-01:35.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up on the handwritten inscription: 'Juliana Ashcroft'.
[EP28_EL070 | 01:35.00-01:37.40] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana freezing in the doorway as she sees Catherine opening her mother's book.
[EP28_EL071 | 01:35.20-01:37.00] **ACTION:** Juliana gasps in horror, realizing her secret identity has been laid bare.
[EP28_EL072 | 01:37.40-01:41.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine raising her gaze slowly from the book, a wicked, triumphant grin spreading across her face.
[EP28_EL073 | 01:38.20-01:40.80] **CATHERINE (Triumphant, Venomous):** "Lady Juliana Ashcroft."
[EP28_EL074 | 01:41.20-01:47.80] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot as Catherine steps deliberately up to Juliana, circling her like a predator savoring its prey.
[EP28_EL075 | 01:41.50-01:43.70] **CATHERINE (Mocking, Reveling):** "I knew I had seen those eyes before."
[EP28_EL076 | 01:44.20-01:45.60] **CATHERINE (Cruel):** "The disgraced daughter..."
[EP28_EL077 | 01:45.60-01:47.80] **CATHERINE (Scornful):** "...the girl thrown out of her own family home."
[EP28_EL078 | 01:47.80-01:53.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up two-shot of Catherine leaning inches from Juliana's face, whispering her humiliating past.
[EP28_EL079 | 01:48.10-01:51.00] **CATHERINE (Taunting):** "The bride who married a penniless war veteran..."
[EP28_EL080 | 01:51.10-01:53.00] **CATHERINE (Vicious):** "...because no respectable man would have her."
[EP28_EL081 | 01:53.00-01:56.40] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of Juliana's eyes blazing with explosive fury and defensive loyalty.
[EP28_EL082 | 01:53.30-01:55.80] **JULIANA (Screaming, Wildly Defiant):** "Do not speak about my husband!"
[EP28_EL083 | 01:56.40-02:02.00] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot as Catherine throws her head back in derisive laughter, brandishing the herbarium book.
[EP28_EL084 | 01:56.40-01:59.10] **CATHERINE (Laughing, Scornful):** "And look at you now. Scrubbing fireplaces in my house."
[EP28_EL085 | 01:59.20-02:01.80] **CATHERINE (Mocking):** "What a magnificent fall, Lady Juliana."

narrative_moments.summary: Locked in the castle dungeon wet cells, Juliana breaks down before rising in defiant resolve, swearing they will never take Alexander from her.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP29_EL068 | 01:45.90-01:49.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana slumping down against the rough stone wall, pulling her knees to her chest while weeping softly.
[EP29_EL069 | 01:46.50-01:48.80] **JULIANA (V.O.) (Sorrowful, Wounded):** "They took my mother's ledger..."

[EP29_EL070 | 01:49.00-01:52.80] **CAMERA:** Front medium shot of Juliana slowly rising to her feet, crossing her arms firmly across her chest as her tears stop and her expression hardens into steely resolve.
[EP29_EL071 | 01:49.00-01:52.60] **JULIANA (V.O.) (Quiet Resolve, Unbreakable):** "They took her locket. But they will not take Alexander from me."
[EP29_EL072 | 01:52.80-01:55.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the dungeon's massive iron portcullis bars dropping down with finality.
[EP29_EL073 | 01:52.80-01:54.80] **SOUND FX:** A heavy iron portcullis crashes down with a massive echoing bang.

[EP29_EL074 | 01:55.50-01:56.69] **CAMERA:** Low-angle shot looking up at Juliana standing dignified in the center of the damp dungeon cell, gazing upward toward the overhead grate where faint beams of moonlight filter down, cutting sharply to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: The Elder Nobleman orchestrates a lethal conspiracy with Rupert and Catherine to try Juliana for witchcraft using her botanical ledger.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP30_EL044 | 01:28.50-01:31.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Rupert wide-eyed with shock at the severity of the plan.
[EP30_EL045 | 01:29.00-01:31.30] **RUPERT (Stunned):** "Witchcraft is a capital charge."
[EP30_EL046 | 01:31.80-01:34.50] **CAMERA:** Straight-on close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring back without a flicker of remorse.
[EP30_EL047 | 01:32.00-01:33.40] **ELDER NOBLEMAN (Unflinching):** "Precisely."
[EP30_EL048 | 01:34.50-01:41.90] **CAMERA:** Medium three-shot framing Rupert, the Elder Nobleman between them, and Catherine listening closely.

[EP30_EL049 | 01:34.60-01:41.80] **ELDER NOBLEMAN (Authoritative, Command):** "Do not hide the evidence, manufacture it. Drag her before the magistrate tomorrow, frame the trial, buy the jury, and let the State hang her."
[EP30_EL050 | 01:41.90-01:44.40] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine smiling with malicious satisfaction, fluttering her fan.
[EP30_EL051 | 01:42.20-01:43.90] **CATHERINE (Scheming):** "Her botanical ledger..."
[EP30_EL052 | 01:44.40-01:46.60] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Elder Nobleman nodding slowly.
[EP30_EL053 | 01:44.80-01:46.00] **ELDER NOBLEMAN (Confirming):** "Exactly."
[EP30_EL054 | 01:46.60-01:49.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward.
[EP30_EL055 | 01:47.30-01:48.80] **CATHERINE (Inquiring):** "And the Dowager?"
[EP30_EL056 | 01:49.00-01:56.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Elder Nobleman gesturing dismissively with one gloved hand.
[EP30_EL057 | 01:49.50-01:56.50] **ELDER NOBLEMAN (Dismissive):** "She is weak, confused. No magistrate will trust a dying woman's accusations against a respected household."
[EP30_EL058 | 01:56.80-02:01.90] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Rupert exhaling deeply, processing the horrifying certainty of their conspiracy.
[EP30_EL059 | 02:00.00-02:01.50] **RUPERT (Hesitant):** "And Juliana?"
[EP30_EL060 | 02:01.90-02:05.10] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring sternly across the desk.
[EP30_EL061 | 02:02.40-02:04.90] **ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Resolute):** "She goes before the magistrate tomorrow."
[EP30_EL062 | 02:05.10-02:13.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine beaming with venomous glee, spreading her red fan wide.
[EP30_EL063 | 02:05.50-02:13.00] **CATHERINE (Cruel, Exultant):** "She will hang. A perfect solution. The town will cheer as the witch's disgraced daughter faces the noose."
[EP30_EL064 | 02:13.50-02:16.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Rupert pulling out the desk chair and seating himself with dark resolve.
[EP30_EL065 | 02:14.10-02:16.20] **RUPERT (Resolute, Vengeful):** "I will write the arrest warrant myself."
[EP30_EL066 | 02:16.80-02:24.50] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of the Elder Nobleman's weathered face, his eyes cold and predatory in the firelight.
[EP30_EL067 | 02:17.50-02:23.50] **ELDER NOBLEMAN (Chilling, Decisive):** "Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch."

narrative_moments.summary: Catherine enters the wet dungeon with a red-hot branding iron and Juliana's mother's botanical book, tormenting Juliana until Juliana's pride provokes a near-blinding assault.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP31_EL005 | 00:04.20-00:09.50] **CAMERA:** Full shot framed through the arched doorway. Catherine stands imperiously in an ornate, gold-embroidered violet gown, holding a smoldering hot poker and a charred leather-bound book, flanked by two stone-faced guards with lanterns.
[EP31_EL006 | 00:06.90-00:08.80] **CATHERINE (Cruel, Condescending):** "Look at you."
[EP31_EL007 | 00:09.50-00:10.50] **CAMERA:** Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up from the stone floor, her gaze hardening despite her fear.
[EP31_EL008 | 00:10.50-00:13.80] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of Catherine's face, bathed in the orange flickering glow of the red-hot branding iron, smiling with pure malice.
[EP31_EL009 | 00:10.50-00:13.80] **CATHERINE (Mocking, Venomous):** "The great Lady Juliana Ashcroft."
[EP31_EL010 | 00:13.80-00:17.60] **CAMERA:** Over-the-shoulder wide shot past Catherine looking down at Juliana shackled helplessly on the wet stone floor.
[EP31_EL011 | 00:14.00-00:17.60] **CATHERINE (Taunting):** "Chained in a dungeon like a common criminal."
[EP31_EL012 | 00:17.60-00:20.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, speaking with quiet defiance.
[EP31_EL013 | 00:17.80-00:20.50] **JULIANA (Defiant, Steady):** "You seem very pleased."
[EP31_EL014 | 00:20.80-00:24.50] **CAMERA:** Low-angle shot looking up at Catherine towering over Juliana, holding the glowing poker at her side.
[EP31_EL015 | 00:21.00-00:23.50] **CATHERINE (Smug, Chilling):** "I am."

[EP31_EL016 | 00:24.50-00:29.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of the bent, white-hot tip of the poker radiating heat, with Catherine's face blurred in the background as she gazes down with predatory pleasure.
[EP31_EL017 | 00:25.00-00:28.90] **CATHERINE (Whispering, Sinister):** "Because this is what you were always meant to be."
[EP31_EL018 | 00:29.00-00:34.80] **CAMERA:** Over-the-shoulder medium shot focusing on Juliana as Catherine presents the charred, singed pages of the botanical book.
[EP31_EL019 | 00:29.30-00:34.80] **CATHERINE (Scornful):** "Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name."
[EP31_EL020 | 00:34.80-00:39.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine's face breaking into an arrogant, haughty laugh.
[EP31_EL021 | 00:35.00-00:38.90] **CATHERINE (Amused, Spiteful):** "[chuckles] And still you became a disgrace."
[EP31_EL022 | 00:39.00-00:43.00] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of Juliana's fierce, unwavering gaze as she retorts without hesitation.
[EP31_EL023 | 00:39.20-00:43.00] **JULIANA (Fierce, Unbroken):** "I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel."
[EP31_EL024 | 00:43.00-00:48.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.
[EP31_EL025 | 00:43.20-00:48.50] **CATHERINE (Cold, Bitter):** "No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar."
[EP31_EL026 | 00:48.50-00:54.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.
[EP31_EL027 | 00:48.90-00:50.80] **CATHERINE (Gloating):** "Do you remember?"
[EP31_EL028 | 00:49.00-00:52.00] **ACTION:** Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.
[EP31_EL029 | 00:51.00-00:54.80] **CATHERINE (Viciously Delighted):** "Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse."

[EP31_EL030 | 00:54.80-00:59.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the red-hot iron hovering over the damp stone floor, rising steam and heat waves warping the air, before cutting to Catherine's gloating expression.
[EP31_EL031 | 00:55.20-00:57.50] **SOUND FX:** Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.
[EP31_EL032 | 00:55.50-00:58.80] **CATHERINE (Quietly Venomous):** "And everyone watched you walk away alone."
[EP31_EL033 | 00:59.00-01:05.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up pushing in on Juliana's illuminated, dignified face.
[EP31_EL034 | 00:59.20-01:01.30] **JULIANA (Proud, Measured):** "Gerald chose money."
[EP31_EL035 | 01:01.50-01:03.50] **JULIANA (Resolute):** "Clarissa chose a coward."
[EP31_EL036 | 01:03.80-01:05.30] **JULIANA (Unyielding):** "I chose myself."
[EP31_EL037 | 01:05.50-01:07.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine's face tightening in disgust.
[EP31_EL038 | 01:05.60-01:07.40] **CATHERINE (Disgusted):** "You chose a beggar."
[EP31_EL039 | 01:07.50-01:10.50] **CAMERA:** Low-angle shot of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering pride.
[EP31_EL040 | 01:07.60-01:09.80] **JULIANA (Fierce, Proud):** "I chose a man."
[EP31_EL041 | 01:10.50-01:13.30] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Catherine sneering down at her.
[EP31_EL042 | 01:10.80-01:13.20] **CATHERINE (Contemptuous):** "A scarred nobody."
[EP31_EL043 | 01:13.30-01:17.60] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana sitting erect against the dungeon wall, her hands resting calmly in her lap.
[EP31_EL044 | 01:13.50-01:17.60] **JULIANA (Resolute, Dignified):** "A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon."
[EP31_EL045 | 01:17.60-01:20.50] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Catherine, holding the smoldering iron between them.
[EP31_EL046 | 01:17.80-01:20.20] **CATHERINE (Incredulous, Mocking):** "You call that marriage?"
[EP31_EL047 | 01:20.50-01:23.20] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with profound conviction.
[EP31_EL048 | 01:20.80-01:23.20] **JULIANA (Pure, Sincere):** "I call it love."
[EP31_EL049 | 01:23.20-01:28.00] **CAMERA:** High-angle wide shot looking straight down through the ceiling iron grating into the deep dungeon shaft where Catherine looms over Juliana.
[EP31_EL050 | 01:23.50-01:27.40] **CATHERINE (Mocking, Hysterical Laugh):** "[laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you."
[EP31_EL051 | 01:27.50-01:31.20] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana looking directly up past the glowing tip of the iron poker into Catherine's eyes.
[EP31_EL052 | 01:27.80-01:31.20] **JULIANA (Firm, Piercing):** "To a place where I can still look you in the eyes."
[EP31_EL053 | 01:31.20-01:34.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.
[EP31_EL054 | 01:31.40-01:34.20] **CATHERINE (Incredulous, Offended):** "You think love makes you better than me?"
[EP31_EL055 | 01:34.20-01:38.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.
[EP31_EL056 | 01:34.50-01:38.20] **JULIANA (Calm, Cutting):** "No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me."
[EP31_EL057 | 01:38.20-01:43.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.
[EP31_EL058 | 01:38.50-01:43.30] **CATHERINE (Incensed, Boastful):** "I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?"
[EP31_EL059 | 01:43.50-01:48.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.
[EP31_EL060 | 01:43.70-01:48.50] **JULIANA (Quiet, Powerful):** "Knowledge. Love. And people who need me."
[EP31_EL061 | 01:48.80-01:50.50] **CAMERA:** Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.
[EP31_EL062 | 01:50.20-01:51.40] **CATHERINE (Sneering, Derisive):** "[scoffs] Peasants? People?"
[EP31_EL063 | 01:51.50-01:58.20] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Catherine casually holding the ancient book while pacing slowly before Juliana.
[EP31_EL064 | 01:51.60-01:58.20] **CATHERINE (Arrogant, Elitist):** "That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve."
[EP31_EL065 | 01:58.20-02:02.50] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of Juliana's face, tilting her head with an insightful, knowing smirk.
[EP31_EL066 | 01:58.40-02:02.00] **JULIANA (Piercing, Provocative):** "Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?"
[EP31_EL067 | 02:02.00-02:04.00] **ACTION:** Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.
[EP31_EL068 | 02:04.00-02:10.80] **CAMERA:** Low-angle medium shot of Juliana, her voice ringing clearly through the subterranean chamber.
[EP31_EL069 | 02:04.20-02:10.50] **JULIANA (Accusatory, Commanding):** "If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow."
[EP31_EL070 | 02:10.80-02:13.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine completely losing control, her aristocratic facade shattering into sheer rage.
[EP31_EL071 | 02:11.00-02:12.80] **CATHERINE (Enraged Scream):** "Enough!"
[EP31_EL072 | 02:13.00-02:14.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the red-hot poker pressing directly down into the delicate open pages of the botanical book.
[EP31_EL073 | 02:13.20-02:14.50] **SOUND FX:** Hiss of scorched parchment and curling white smoke rising as paper blackens under extreme heat.
[EP31_EL074 | 02:14.50-02:18.00] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot. Catherine holds the smoldering book right before Juliana's face.
[EP31_EL075 | 02:14.50-02:18.00] **CATHERINE (Hateful, Malicious):** "This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother."
[EP31_EL076 | 02:18.00-02:20.50] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Juliana, her emotional composure breaking into pure grief and panic.
[EP31_EL077 | 02:18.00-02:20.50] **ACTION:** Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.
[EP31_EL078 | 02:18.40-02:20.40] **JULIANA (Desperate, Weeping):** "[gasping] Give it back!"
[EP31_EL079 | 02:20.50-02:23.80] **CAMERA:** Low-angle shot of Catherine grinning with sadistic triumph, looking down at Juliana's despair.
[EP31_EL080 | 02:20.70-02:23.80] **CATHERINE (Gloating, Sadistic):** "There. Finally. Something still hurts you."
[EP31_EL081 | 02:23.80-02:25.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana screaming out in absolute anguish.
[EP31_EL082 | 02:24.00-02:25.50] **JULIANA (Screaming, Agonized):** "No!"
[EP31_EL083 | 02:25.50-02:31.20] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Catherine slowly driving the glowing branding tip into the spine of the open book, watching the embers consume the pages.
[EP31_EL084 | 02:25.60-02:31.20] **CATHERINE (Vicious, Final):** "One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash."
[EP31_EL085 | 02:31.20-02:35.20] **CAMERA:** Low-angle medium shot. Catherine lowers the charred book and suddenly swings the glowing orange iron tip straight up toward Juliana's face.
[EP31_EL086 | 02:31.50-02:35.20] **ACTION:** Juliana recoils back against the hard dungeon wall, gasping for breath in raw terror as the searing iron stops inches from her eyes.

[EP31_EL087 | 02:35.20-02:40.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme macro close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eye. The brilliant orange ember of the hot poker reflects clearly in the center of her pupil, holding on the terrifying cliffhanger before an abrupt cut.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: Juliana tells Catherine to burn the book and declares her love for her scarred soldier husband, driving Catherine into a murderous fury with a glowing poker.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP32_EL017 | 00:20.20-00:22.00] **JULIANA (Defiant, Unbroken):** "Burn it."
[EP32_EL018 | 00:20.50-00:23.00] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.
[EP32_EL019 | 00:23.00-00:25.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.
[EP32_EL020 | 00:23.80-00:24.80] **CATHERINE (Disconcerted):** "What?"
[EP32_EL021 | 00:25.50-00:28.50] **CAMERA:** Low-angle close-up of Juliana staring straight up into Catherine's eyes without flinching.
[EP32_EL022 | 00:25.80-00:28.80] **JULIANA (Firm, Resolute):** "Burn the ledger. Burn every page."
[EP32_EL023 | 00:28.50-00:30.80] **CAMERA:** Wide shot of the wet dungeon floor, guards stationed by the heavy iron doorway in the background as Catherine holds the hot brand.
[EP32_EL024 | 00:29.80-00:32.80] **JULIANA (Steely, Proud):** "You may destroy the book..."
[EP32_EL025 | 00:30.80-00:33.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine's face darkening with irritation.
[EP32_EL026 | 00:33.50-00:36.50] **CAMERA:** Medium low-angle shot of Juliana sitting amidst chains beneath the barred ceiling grate.
[EP32_EL027 | 00:33.20-00:36.20] **JULIANA (Transcendent, Defiant):** "...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me."
[EP32_EL028 | 00:36.40-00:38.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine leaning down aggressively into Juliana's space, trembling with offended rage.
[EP32_EL029 | 00:36.40-00:39.10] **CATHERINE (Spiteful, Hissing):** "You think a few herbs make you better than me?"
[EP32_EL030 | 00:38.80-00:41.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana looking steadily up into Catherine's furious glare.
[EP32_EL031 | 00:39.20-00:42.80] **JULIANA (Calm, Cutting):** "No. Your cruelty does that for me."
[EP32_EL032 | 00:41.00-00:43.50] **CAMERA:** High-angle over-the-shoulder shot looking down at Juliana bound in heavy chains on the damp floor.
[EP32_EL033 | 00:43.50-00:45.50] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Catherine, baring her teeth in outrage.
[EP32_EL034 | 00:43.40-00:45.40] **CATHERINE (Furious, Shouting):** "You still think you are better?!"
[EP32_EL035 | 00:45.50-00:47.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana, her chained hands clasped together in her lap.
[EP32_EL036 | 00:45.60-00:47.40] **JULIANA (Serene, Grounded):** "I know what I am."
[EP32_EL037 | 00:47.80-00:49.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Catherine scoffing with forced, derisive laughter.
[EP32_EL038 | 00:47.80-00:49.00] **CATHERINE (Sneering, Mocking):** "A disgraced woman?"
[EP32_EL039 | 00:49.00-00:52.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana speaking with undeniable strength.
[EP32_EL040 | 00:49.20-00:52.40] **JULIANA (Unwavering):** "A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me."
[EP32_EL041 | 00:52.50-00:54.40] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine brandishing the glowing tong in Juliana's face, spittle flying from her lips.
[EP32_EL042 | 00:52.80-00:54.20] **CATHERINE (Screaming, Enraged):** "You are lying!"
[EP32_EL043 | 00:54.40-00:58.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana looking straight up, voice steady and clear.
[EP32_EL044 | 00:54.60-00:58.00] **JULIANA (Measured, Emphatic):** "Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me."
[EP32_EL045 | 00:58.00-01:00.80] **CAMERA:** Full shot of the dungeon cell. Catherine stands rigidly tall while Juliana sits shackled on the ground.
[EP32_EL046 | 00:58.20-01:01.00] **JULIANA (Contemplative, Scathing):** "He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth."
[EP32_EL047 | 01:00.80-01:04.50] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Juliana's expressive blue eyes and tear-stained cheek.
[EP32_EL048 | 01:01.10-01:06.80] **JULIANA (Passionate, Clear):** "He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him."
[EP32_EL049 | 01:04.50-01:07.00] **CAMERA:** Low-angle shot of Juliana leaning slightly forward against her chains.
[EP32_EL050 | 01:07.00-01:09.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine staring down, her eyes widening as Juliana's words pierce her facade.
[EP32_EL051 | 01:07.20-01:08.90] **JULIANA (Unapologetic, Victorious):** "Let him have Clarissa."
[EP32_EL052 | 01:09.00-01:11.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana smiling with genuine liberation.
[EP32_EL053 | 01:09.60-01:11.20] **JULIANA (Proud):** "He lost me."
[EP32_EL054 | 01:11.20-01:13.30] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Catherine's face contorting in sheer fury.
[EP32_EL055 | 01:11.30-01:13.20] **CATHERINE (Shrieking, Vicious):** "You were rejected!"
[EP32_EL056 | 01:13.30-01:15.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana's calm, resolute face.
[EP32_EL057 | 01:13.40-01:17.60] **JULIANA (Grounded, Powerful):** "I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth."
[EP32_EL058 | 01:15.50-01:17.50] **CAMERA:** Wide shot of the cell, steam rising faintly in the cold subterranean air.
[EP32_EL059 | 01:17.50-01:20.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine sneering with dripping condescension.
[EP32_EL060 | 01:17.80-01:19.40] **CATHERINE (Disdainful):** "Your soldier?"
[EP32_EL061 | 01:20.00-01:22.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glowing with genuine devotion.
[EP32_EL062 | 01:20.20-01:22.00] **JULIANA (Tender, Certain):** "My husband."
[EP32_EL063 | 01:22.50-01:24.10] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine scowling with deep disgust.
[EP32_EL064 | 01:22.50-01:24.00] **CATHERINE (Bitter):** "He is a nobody."
[EP32_EL065 | 01:24.10-01:26.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, totally untroubled.
[EP32_EL066 | 01:24.20-01:26.20] **JULIANA (Warm, Defiant):** "Then I love a nobody."
[EP32_EL067 | 01:26.50-01:29.80] **CAMERA:** Low-angle shot focusing on Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron on the stone floor.
[EP32_EL068 | 01:26.50-01:30.20] **JULIANA (Resonant, Moving):** "Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did."
[EP32_EL069 | 01:29.80-01:32.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Catherine gripping the branding rod tighter, her upper lip curling in fury.
[EP32_EL070 | 01:30.10-01:32.60] **CATHERINE (Indignant, Sharp):** "You know nothing about my world."
[EP32_EL071 | 01:32.80-01:37.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana sitting in her tattered apron and chains, looking composed.
[EP32_EL072 | 01:33.20-01:36.60] **JULIANA (Knowing, Sober):** "I know exactly what your world values."
[EP32_EL073 | 01:37.00-01:39.80] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Juliana's lips and eyes as she lists them with chilling precision.
[EP32_EL074 | 01:37.60-01:39.60] **JULIANA (Listing, Deliberate):** "Beauty. Money."
[EP32_EL075 | 01:39.80-01:41.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Catherine's wide, stunned eyes reacting to the naked truth.
[EP32_EL076 | 01:41.00-01:43.70] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana looking up unflinchingly.
[EP32_EL077 | 01:41.20-01:43.50] **JULIANA (Firm):** "Family. A perfect name."
[EP32_EL078 | 01:43.70-01:47.00] **CAMERA:** Low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her gold and purple gown, the guard standing sentinel behind her.
[EP32_EL079 | 01:43.80-01:47.20] **JULIANA (Continuing):** "And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her."
[EP32_EL080 | 01:47.00-01:48.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine throwing her hands up in explosive defensiveness.
[EP32_EL081 | 01:47.20-01:48.80] **CATHERINE (Shouting, Outraged):** "And what is wrong with that?!"
[EP32_EL082 | 01:48.80-01:49.40] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine's face twisting in absolute venom.
[EP32_EL083 | 01:49.40-01:52.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana looking serene.
[EP32_EL084 | 01:49.50-01:52.80] **JULIANA (Gentle, Penetrating):** "Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it."
[EP32_EL085 | 01:52.50-01:56.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Catherine standing motionless, holding the iron rod, struck to the core by the insult.
[EP32_EL086 | 01:52.80-01:56.00] **JULIANA (Unrelenting):** "You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow..."
[EP32_EL087 | 01:56.00-01:56.80] **CAMERA:** Low-angle shot of Juliana's chained hands folded peacefully in her lap.
[EP32_EL088 | 01:56.80-01:59.50] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Juliana looking up with quiet pity.
[EP32_EL089 | 01:56.90-01:59.50] **JULIANA (Piercing):** "...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you."
[EP32_EL090 | 01:59.50-02:01.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Catherine snapping entirely, raising the branding poker like a weapon and screaming.
[EP32_EL091 | 01:59.60-02:01.80] **CATHERINE (Hysterical, Screaming):** "Silence! Silence!"
[EP32_EL092 | 02:01.80-02:03.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine's crazed, gasping face.
[EP32_EL093 | 02:01.80-02:02.80] **CATHERINE (Shrieking):** "Why?!"
[EP32_EL094 | 02:02.80-02:05.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana crying out her defiance.
[EP32_EL095 | 02:03.00-02:05.20] **JULIANA (Forceful):** "Because I am right!"
[EP32_EL096 | 02:05.00-02:08.50] **CAMERA:** Low-angle tracking shot of the red-hot branding tip trailing across the wet dungeon floor, steaming.
[EP32_EL097 | 02:05.40-02:08.80] **JULIANA (Scathing, Direct):** "You want everyone to believe you are powerful."
[EP32_EL098 | 02:08.50-02:11.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana sitting under the cold skylight bars, her posture majestic despite her imprisonment.
[EP32_EL099 | 02:09.00-02:11.60] **JULIANA (Continuing):** "You want everyone to fear you."
[EP32_EL100 | 02:11.80-02:14.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana looking directly at Catherine, gestures restrained by the heavy iron chains.
[EP32_EL101 | 02:12.00-02:14.00] **JULIANA (Mocking, Direct):** "But look at you."
[EP32_EL102 | 02:14.80-02:18.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana, her eyes burning with fiery contempt.
[EP32_EL103 | 02:15.00-02:18.60] **JULIANA (Stripping Her Bare):** "You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!"
[EP32_EL104 | 02:18.50-02:20.40] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine trembling with uncontrollable rage, teeth bared.
[EP32_EL105 | 02:18.60-02:20.20] **CATHERINE (Choking with Rage):** "You insolent—!"
[EP32_EL106 | 02:20.40-02:22.40] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Catherine gripping the glowing tongs as Juliana continues speaking over her.
[EP32_EL107 | 02:20.40-02:22.30] **JULIANA (Steely, Triumphant):** "You may have the title you have always wanted..."
[EP32_EL108 | 02:22.40-02:26.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana delivering the final emotional blow.
[EP32_EL109 | 02:22.40-02:26.50] **JULIANA (Final, Condemning):** "...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else."
[EP32_EL110 | 02:26.50-02:28.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine's face twitching with sheer murderous madness.
[EP32_EL111 | 02:26.60-02:28.10] **CATHERINE (Enraged, Shouting):** "You think you can lecture me?!"
[EP32_EL112 | 02:28.00-02:30.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Catherine raising the branding iron high above her head with both hands.
[EP32_EL113 | 02:28.00-02:30.80] **ACTION:** Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.
[EP32_EL114 | 02:28.10-02:31.20] **CATHERINE (Screaming, Maniacal):** "Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!"
[EP32_EL115 | 02:30.80-02:32.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Catherine plunging the glowing orange poker straight toward Juliana's face.
[EP32_EL116 | 02:31.20-02:34.38] **ACTION:** Juliana gasps, freezing as the glowing tip of the iron thrusts forward, stopping mere millimeters from her right eye.

[EP32_EL117 | 02:32.00-02:34.38] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, unblinking blue eye. The intense, fiery orange glow of the iron poker radiates inches from her cornea, holding on the heart-stopping cliffhanger as the frame cuts to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: The calculating Lord threatens to send Prudence's seven-year-old brother to the county gaol unless she gives manufactured testimony accusing Juliana of witchcraft.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP33_EL036 | 00:59.00-01:04.20] **CAMERA:** Profile medium two-shot as the Lord looms inches from the maid's face.
[EP33_EL037 | 00:59.00-01:01.00] **LORD (Low, Menacing):** "Think carefully."
[EP33_EL038 | 01:01.20-01:03.50] **LORD (Ruthless):** "Your brother is still a pauper."
[EP33_EL039 | 01:04.20-01:08.80] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of the Lord's cold eyes and hawkish profile speaking with chilling finality.
[EP33_EL040 | 01:04.40-01:08.50] **LORD (Threatening):** "One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise."
[EP33_EL041 | 01:08.50-01:10.00] **ACTION:** The maid gasps in sheer terror, her chest heaving as tears stream.
[EP33_EL042 | 01:08.80-01:13.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the maid clutching her chest with trembling hands, crying desperately.
[EP33_EL043 | 01:09.50-01:13.00] **MAID (Begging, Heartbroken):** "Please, my Lord... he is only seven!"
[EP33_EL044 | 01:13.20-01:15.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Lord staring down without an ounce of pity.
[EP33_EL045 | 01:13.20-01:15.00] **LORD (Cold, Unwavering):** "Then help him."
[EP33_EL046 | 01:15.50-01:19.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the maid weeping profusely, cornered and helpless.
[EP33_EL047 | 01:16.80-01:19.00] **MAID (Crying, Shattered):** "What do you want me to say?!"
[EP33_EL048 | 01:19.50-01:24.80] **CAMERA:** Wide shot of the study as the Lord stands calmly before the trembling servant.
[EP33_EL049 | 01:19.60-01:20.50] **LORD (Deceptive):** "The truth."
[EP33_EL050 | 01:21.00-01:24.50] **LORD (Leading, Deliberate):** "She drew something around the bed, did she not?"
[EP33_EL051 | 01:24.80-01:29.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the maid stammering through her tears.
[EP33_EL052 | 01:25.50-01:28.80] **MAID (Trembling, Reluctant):** "She... placed dried herbs around him."
[EP33_EL053 | 01:29.00-01:34.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of the Lord standing right beside her shoulder, whispering in her ear like an insidious specter.
[EP33_EL054 | 01:29.00-01:30.50] **LORD (Hypnotic, Coercive):** "Around him."
[EP33_EL055 | 01:31.00-01:32.50] **LORD (Coercive):** "Like a circle?"
[EP33_EL057 | 01:34.80-01:38.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up from behind the maid as the Lord leans close to her ear.
[EP33_EL058 | 01:35.00-01:38.00] **LORD (Whispering, Trap Snapping):** "And she opened her mother's book..."
[EP33_EL059 | 01:38.50-01:40.80] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of the maid's tear-drenched eyes and quivering lips.
[EP33_EL061 | 01:40.80-01:44.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Lord delivering the final trap.
[EP33_EL062 | 01:41.00-01:44.00] **LORD (Sinister):** "...and spoke words you could not understand."
[EP33_EL063 | 01:44.20-01:47.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the maid gasping out in desperate agony.
[EP33_EL064 | 01:44.50-01:46.50] **MAID (Desperately Defending):** "She was praying!"
[EP33_EL065 | 01:47.50-01:51.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Lord grinning with sinister triumph.
[EP33_EL066 | 01:48.00-01:51.50] **LORD (Taunting):** "Praying... or chanting?"
[EP33_EL067 | 01:51.80-01:53.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the maid breaking down completely.
[EP33_EL068 | 01:52.00-01:53.50] **MAID (Hysterically Sobbing):** "I don't know!"
[EP33_EL069 | 01:53.80-01:59.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot as the Lord paces slowly, pointing his finger with clinical, legal precision.
[EP33_EL070 | 01:54.00-01:56.50] **LORD (Calculating, Relentless):** "You saw a woman draw a circle of herbs."
[EP33_EL071 | 01:56.80-01:59.50] **LORD (Relentless):** "You saw her use a forbidden book."
[EP33_EL072 | 01:59.50-02:03.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up profile of the Lord leaning in right in front of the sobbing maid.
[EP33_EL073 | 01:59.80-02:02.80] **LORD (Condemning):** "You heard words you could not understand."
[EP33_EL074 | 02:03.50-02:06.80] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of the Lord's mouth and calculating eyes as he pronounces the lethal word.
[EP33_EL075 | 02:04.50-02:06.50] **LORD (Deadly, Resolute):** "That is witchcraft."
[EP33_EL076 | 02:06.80-02:11.80] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot as the maid steps forward, pleading passionately against his chest.
[EP33_EL077 | 02:06.80-02:11.50] **MAID (Crying Out, Desperate):** "No! She saved Toby! She made him breathe again!"
[EP33_EL078 | 02:11.80-02:14.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Lord calmly watching her futile resistance.
[EP33_EL079 | 02:12.00-02:14.00] **LORD (Cold, Final):** "That will be your testimony."
[EP33_EL080 | 02:14.50-02:17.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the maid's face frozen in horrified realization.
[EP33_EL081 | 02:14.50-02:17.00] **MAID (Gasping, Shocked):** "My testimony?!"
[EP33_EL082 | 02:17.80-02:20.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Lord delivering the ultimatum without blinking.
[EP33_EL083 | 02:18.00-02:20.00] **LORD (Unyielding):** "Before the magistrate."
[EP33_EL084 | 02:20.50-02:24.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the maid grabbing both sides of her head, screaming out in utter grief and guilt.
[EP33_EL085 | 02:20.50-02:24.00] **MAID (Wailing, Tormented):** "I never said she was a witch!"
[EP33_EL086 | 02:24.80-02:29.20] **CAMERA:** Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning his back and walking back behind his desk.
[EP33_EL087 | 02:25.00-02:26.50] **LORD (Chillingly Detached):** "You do not need to."
[EP33_EL088 | 02:26.80-02:29.00] **LORD (Chillingly Detached):** "I have already written the story for you."
[EP33_EL089 | 02:29.20-02:32.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the maid clutching her cheeks, crying in heartbreak.
[EP33_EL090 | 02:29.50-02:32.00] **MAID (Sobbing):** "She saved my brother..."
[EP33_EL091 | 02:32.20-02:36.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Lord turning back, resting one hand upon the desk with cold finality.
[EP33_EL092 | 02:32.50-02:36.00] **LORD (Inexorable):** "And now... you will save your brother."
[EP33_EL093 | 02:36.20-02:39.50] **ACTION:** The maid's knees buckle completely. She collapses forward onto the polished dark wood floor, groveling in total despair.
[EP33_EL094 | 02:36.20-02:39.50] **CAMERA:** High angle looking down as the maid falls prostrate on the floor.
[EP33_EL095 | 02:39.00-02:41.50] **MAID (Weeping, Broken):** "I am sorry, Lady Juliana..."
[EP33_EL096 | 02:39.50-02:43.80] **CAMERA:** Low-angle shot of the Lord looking down dismissively at the prostrate maid.
[EP33_EL097 | 02:41.80-02:44.50] **LORD (Cold, Merciless):** "Save your tears for the trial."

[EP33_EL098 | 02:43.80-02:54.04] **CAMERA:** Side medium shot of the maid kneeling crumpled on the floor in the dimly lit study, her face buried in both hands, weeping uncontrollably as the scene slowly fades into the dark silence.

[EP33_EL099 | 02:44.50-02:54.04] **ACTION:** The heartbroken maid weeps silently in the shadow of the desk, consumed by guilt and powerlessness.
