narrative_moments.summary: Juliana stands trial for witchcraft and poisoning, refusing to renounce herbal healing even after Prudence is forced to testify against her.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP34_EL001 | 00:00.00-00:02.80] **CAMERA:** High wide establishing shot from behind the presiding judge looking down into the grand, sunlit courtroom filled with stern spectators, armed bailiffs, and Lady Juliana standing confined in the wooden prisoner's dock on the left.
[EP34_EL002 | 00:01.20-00:07.80] **JUDGE (Booming, Authoritative):** "Lady Juliana Ashcroft, you are accused of witchcraft, unlawful healing, and poisoning."
[EP34_EL003 | 00:02.80-00:07.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of the stern, elderly Judge seated at the high mahogany bench, resting both hands on the court documents.

[EP34_EL004 | 00:07.80-00:13.10] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the charred, ancient botanical grimoire resting on the bench, its scorched pages open to an illustration of a wild rose, as a finger firmly taps the text.
[EP34_EL005 | 00:09.00-00:11.20] **SOUND FX:** [A firm, hollow tap of a finger striking the parchment]
[EP34_EL006 | 00:09.10-00:12.60] **JUDGE (O.S.) (Inquisitive, Severe):** "Do you deny possessing this book?"
[EP34_EL007 | 00:13.10-00:15.50] **CAMERA:** Low-angle medium close-up of Lady Juliana standing erect in the dock, her prisoner label pinned to her rustic buttoned gown, her expression resolute.
[EP34_EL008 | 00:13.80-00:14.80] **LADY JULIANA (Calm, Unflinching):** "No."
[EP34_EL009 | 00:15.50-00:19.40] **CAMERA:** Low-angle medium shot of the Judge leaning over his elevated bench, staring down critically.
[EP34_EL010 | 00:15.60-00:19.20] **JUDGE (Stern, Accusatory):** "Do you deny using its remedies?"
[EP34_EL011 | 00:19.40-00:23.80] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of Lady Juliana's face, bruised cheekbone highlighting her calm defiance.
[EP34_EL013 | 00:23.80-00:27.40] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the aristocratic Lord standing at the railing in his tailored dark coat, turning slowly with a smirk of malicious satisfaction.
[EP34_EL014 | 00:27.40-00:31.70] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Judge leaning forward across his bench, eyes narrowing with grim conviction.
[EP34_EL015 | 00:27.50-00:31.20] **JUDGE (Hard, Pressing):** "Then you admit to practicing forbidden arts."
[EP34_EL016 | 00:31.70-00:35.30] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Lady Juliana looking upward with quiet dignity, her eyes luminous.
[EP34_EL017 | 00:33.20-00:35.10] **LADY JULIANA (Proud, Dignified):** "I admit to healing the sick."
[EP34_EL018 | 00:35.30-00:37.40] **ACTION:** The Judge furiously raises his wooden gavel and strikes the sound block with sharp force.
[EP34_EL019 | 00:35.40-00:36.60] **JUDGE (Furious, Shouting):** "Silence!"
[EP34_EL020 | 00:35.80-00:37.00] **SOUND FX:** [Sharp, echoing crack of the gavel slamming onto wood]
[EP34_EL021 | 00:35.80-00:37.40] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Judge slamming the gavel down on his bench.
[EP34_EL022 | 00:37.40-00:42.50] **CAMERA:** Tracking shot moving from the Judge on his bench as he points his outstretched arm across the courtroom floor toward the witness stand.
[EP34_EL023 | 00:37.50-00:41.20] **JUDGE (Commanding):** "Prudence. You served beside the accused?"
[EP34_EL024 | 00:41.00-00:43.00] **ACTION:** Prudence the young maid stands trembling in the center of the courtroom floor, her head bowed in deep shame, clutching the sides of her apron.
[EP34_EL025 | 00:42.50-00:44.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Prudence looking up with tears streaming down her pale face.
[EP34_EL026 | 00:43.20-00:44.60] **PRUDENCE (Trembling, Tearful):** "Yes, Your Honor."
[EP34_EL027 | 00:44.80-00:49.00] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of the Judge leaning forward with folded hands.
[EP34_EL028 | 00:45.30-00:48.80] **JUDGE (Probing, Formal):** "Did you witness Lady Juliana perform these treatments?"
[EP34_EL029 | 00:49.00-00:51.50] **CAMERA:** Profile over-the-shoulder shot from behind Prudence toward Lady Juliana standing bound in iron cuffs at the prisoner's dock.
[EP34_EL030 | 00:49.10-00:50.50] **LADY JULIANA (Softly, Urgent):** "Tell the truth."
[EP34_EL031 | 00:51.50-00:54.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Prudence breaking down in tears, squeezing her eyes shut as guilt overwhelms her.
[EP34_EL032 | 00:53.00-00:54.20] **PRUDENCE (Sobbing, Heartbroken):** "Yes."
[EP34_EL033 | 00:54.80-00:57.60] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Lady Juliana looking at her former maid, a momentary flicker of hurt passing through her eyes before settling into stoic composure.
[EP34_EL034 | 00:57.60-01:00.80] **CAMERA:** Medium profile shot of the Judge recording notes in the open court ledger with a feather quill.
[EP34_EL035 | 00:58.20-01:00.10] **JUDGE (Measured, Stern):** "What did you see?"
[EP34_EL036 | 01:00.80-01:04.60] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Prudence clutching both hands to her chest in anguish.
[EP34_EL037 | 01:01.30-01:04.40] **PRUDENCE (Choked with Tears):** "She used herbs... and her mother's book."
[EP34_EL038 | 01:04.60-01:06.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Judge leaning back slightly, pointing his hand accusingly.
[EP34_EL039 | 01:04.80-01:06.70] **JUDGE (Pressing, Sharp):** "Did she draw strange markings?"
[EP34_EL040 | 01:06.80-01:11.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Prudence's tear-streaked face as she hesitates, her breath hitching.
[EP34_EL041 | 01:08.20-01:11.70] **PRUDENCE (Faltering, Desperate):** "She... placed herbs around my brother's bed."
[EP34_EL042 | 01:11.80-01:15.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched index finger with piercing intensity.
[EP34_EL043 | 01:12.10-01:15.50] **JUDGE (Accusatory, Forceful):** "And did she speak words you could not understand?"
[EP34_EL044 | 01:15.80-01:21.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Prudence weeping uncontrollably, her face contorted in unbearable remorse.
[EP34_EL045 | 01:18.80-01:20.50] **PRUDENCE (Weeping, Shaken):** "Yes."
[EP34_EL046 | 01:21.00-01:25.20] **CAMERA:** Medium tracking shot of the Lord stepping into the open aisle of the courtroom with arms spread wide, turning triumphantly toward the Judge.
[EP34_EL047 | 01:21.30-01:24.90] **LORD (Triumphant, Smug):** "Your Honor... the witness has confirmed the ritual."
[EP34_EL048 | 01:25.00-01:27.20] **ACTION:** Lady Juliana slams her cuffed hands against the wooden railing of the dock, her voice ringing out in indignant fury.
[EP34_EL049 | 01:25.20-01:27.40] **CAMERA:** Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana gripping the railing, leaning forward.
[EP34_EL050 | 01:25.20-01:27.20] **LADY JULIANA (Passionate, Indignant):** "It was not a ritual!"
[EP34_EL051 | 01:27.20-01:30.20] **ACTION:** The Judge repeatedly hammers his gavel down onto the desk, roaring over her.
[EP34_EL052 | 01:27.40-01:30.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Judge striking the wooden block twice in rapid succession.
[EP34_EL053 | 01:27.80-01:29.20] **SOUND FX:** [Violent, resonant double bang of the wooden gavel]
[EP34_EL054 | 01:27.90-01:30.00] **JUDGE (Bellowing):** "You will speak when addressed!"
[EP34_EL055 | 01:30.50-01:33.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Lord extending his palm toward the gallery with theatrical composure.
[EP34_EL056 | 01:31.00-01:33.20] **LORD (Calm, Poisonous):** "We have further witnesses."
[EP34_EL057 | 01:33.80-01:38.20] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of an anxious townsman standing by the gallery pews, nervously wringing his woolen hat in his hands.
[EP34_EL058 | 01:34.20-01:38.00] **TOWNSMAN (Nervous, Fearful):** "My wife took one of Lady Juliana's mixtures..."
[EP34_EL059 | 01:38.20-01:39.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Judge glaring down expectantly.
[EP34_EL061 | 01:39.50-01:42.10] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the townsman's face tightening with coached distress.
[EP34_EL062 | 01:39.80-01:41.80] **TOWNSMAN (Agitated):** "She became violently ill."
[EP34_EL063 | 01:42.10-01:47.30] **CAMERA:** Medium shot among the spectators as an elderly peasant woman stands up from the wooden bench, pointing an accusatory finger across the courtroom.
[EP34_EL064 | 01:42.30-01:47.00] **OLD WOMAN (Shrill, Accusatory):** "My daughter drank one of her herbal preparations! She was sick for three days!"
[EP34_EL065 | 01:47.30-01:50.00] **CAMERA:** Side two-shot of the Lord stepping up to the dock, looming beside Lady Juliana as she looks him in the eye.
[EP34_EL066 | 01:48.00-01:49.80] **LORD (Mocking, Smug):** "She calls it healing."
[EP34_EL067 | 01:50.00-01:52.80] **ACTION:** The Lord turns dramatically to face the entire assembly, gesturing toward the spectators.
[EP34_EL068 | 01:50.00-01:52.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Lord addressing the courtroom.
[EP34_EL069 | 01:50.10-01:52.60] **LORD (Resonant, Vindicative):** "The people call it poisoning!"
[EP34_EL070 | 01:52.80-01:55.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Lady Juliana looking past him directly toward the gallery with sharp clarity.
[EP34_EL071 | 01:53.20-01:55.00] **LADY JULIANA (Incisive, Defiant):** "What were their illnesses?"
[EP34_EL072 | 01:55.20-01:57.20] **CAMERA:** Low-angle close-up of the Lord looking down arrogantly over his shoulder.
[EP34_EL073 | 01:55.30-01:56.50] **LORD (Dismissive):** "Irrelevant."
[EP34_EL074 | 01:57.20-01:59.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Lady Juliana gritting her teeth in fierce defiance.
[EP34_EL075 | 01:57.40-01:59.60] **LADY JULIANA (Fierce):** "It is not irrelevant!"

[EP34_EL076 | 01:59.80-02:03.40] **CAMERA:** Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana standing tall against the courtroom window light, her chained hands resting on the balustrade as she addresses the entire hall.
[EP34_EL077 | 01:59.90-02:03.20] **LADY JULIANA (Clear, Unyielding):** "Herbs are not magic! They are medicine!"
[EP34_EL078 | 02:03.40-02:06.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Judge sitting with steepled fingers upon his high bench.
[EP34_EL079 | 02:03.60-02:06.40] **JUDGE (Coldly Inquisitive):** "You admit you administered them?"
[EP34_EL080 | 02:06.80-02:09.10] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Lady Juliana looking straight forward.
[EP34_EL081 | 02:07.20-02:08.20] **LADY JULIANA (Direct):** "Yes."
[EP34_EL082 | 02:09.10-02:11.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Judge gesturing with an open hand.
[EP34_EL083 | 02:09.30-02:11.60] **JUDGE (Challenging):** "Without the approval of a licensed physician?"
[EP34_EL084 | 02:11.80-02:14.60] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Lady Juliana shaking her head slightly, truth ringing in her voice.
[EP34_EL085 | 02:12.10-02:14.40] **LADY JULIANA (Steely, Earnest):** "There was no physician willing to help them."
[EP34_EL086 | 02:14.60-02:19.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Lady Juliana's steady gaze.
[EP34_EL087 | 02:16.20-02:18.40] **LADY JULIANA (Calm, Resolute):** "So I helped them."
[EP34_EL088 | 02:19.20-02:22.20] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of the Lord smiling cynically as he turns back toward the magistrate.
[EP34_EL089 | 02:19.60-02:22.00] **LORD (Derisive):** "Even now, she refuses to repent."
[EP34_EL090 | 02:22.20-02:27.40] **CAMERA:** Low-angle medium shot of the Judge holding his hand over the open law book.
[EP34_EL091 | 02:22.40-02:27.00] **JUDGE (Grave, Stern):** "Lady Juliana, if you wish to save yourself, renounce these practices."
[EP34_EL092 | 02:27.40-02:28.90] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the burned grimoire resting on the green leather surface of the court table.
[EP34_EL093 | 02:28.90-02:31.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Lady Juliana lifting her chin without an ounce of hesitation.
[EP34_EL094 | 02:29.80-02:30.80] **LADY JULIANA (Unyielding):** "No."
[EP34_EL095 | 02:31.20-02:34.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Judge lowering his brow with dark finality.
[EP34_EL096 | 02:31.80-02:33.80] **JUDGE (Ominous, Warning):** "Think carefully."
[EP34_EL097 | 02:34.80-02:36.80] **CAMERA:** Low-angle close-up of Lady Juliana looking skyward through the arched court windows.
[EP34_EL098 | 02:35.20-02:36.40] **LADY JULIANA (Firm, Resolute):** "I have."
[EP34_EL099 | 02:36.80-02:42.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched finger across the bench, his tone hardening into lethal severity.
[EP34_EL100 | 02:37.00-02:41.80] **JUDGE (Severe, Imposing):** "You understand that refusal may be treated as proof that you knowingly practiced witchcraft?"
[EP34_EL101 | 02:42.00-02:43.60] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Lady Juliana unflinchingly accepting her fate.
[EP34_EL102 | 02:42.10-02:43.50] **LADY JULIANA (Proud, Fearless):** "Then let it be."
[EP34_EL103 | 02:43.60-02:46.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Prudence breaking into shattered sobs, pressing her apron to her face to muffle her tears.
[EP34_EL104 | 02:44.00-02:46.80] **ACTION:** Prudence buries her face in her stained white apron, shuddering with grief.
[EP34_EL105 | 02:46.80-02:54.40] **CAMERA:** Medium shot pushing into Lady Juliana's face as she speaks directly across the hall with compassionate, unwavering authority.
[EP34_EL106 | 02:47.00-02:53.60] **LADY JULIANA (Passionate, Defiant):** "Do not be afraid. I will not call healing evil just because powerful people have decided to fear it."
[EP34_EL107 | 02:54.40-02:56.50] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up profile of the Lord, his smirk instantly freezing into an irritated, malevolent scowl.
[EP34_EL108 | 02:56.50-02:58.20] **ACTION:** The Judge furiously smashes his gavel down upon the sound block with a deafening crack.
[EP34_EL109 | 02:56.50-02:58.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the Judge slamming the wooden gavel down.
[EP34_EL110 | 02:56.60-02:57.60] **SOUND FX:** [Violent, resonant smash of the wooden gavel]
[EP34_EL111 | 02:57.80-02:59.40] **JUDGE (Thunderous):** "Enough!"
[EP34_EL112 | 02:59.50-03:04.50] **ACTION:** The Judge rises to his full height behind the bench, towering over the silent court.
[EP34_EL113 | 02:59.50-03:04.50] **CAMERA:** Low-angle medium shot looking up at the imposing Judge as he stands formally to deliver the judgment.
[EP34_EL114 | 03:01.00-03:04.20] **JUDGE (Booming, Solemn):** "Lady Juliana Ashcroft..."

[EP34_EL115 | 03:04.50-03:10.00] **CAMERA:** Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Lady Juliana in the prisoner's dock looking toward the Judge, who solemnly raises his right hand to pronounce the final sentence as the heavy silence hangs over the courtroom.

[EP34_EL116 | 03:05.00-03:10.00] **ACTION:** The Judge extends his raised hand high in judgment over Lady Juliana as the scene holds on her standing still and unbroken before fading to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: Alexander's mother escapes through a secret tunnel and finds Alexander alive in a secluded cabin, where he reveals that the rulers of Ashwood orchestrated the ambush on his regiment.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP35_EL015 | 00:27.50-00:30.80] **CAMERA:** Panning shot from the open doorway revealing the warm, dimly lit cabin interior, settling on Alexander standing over a rustic wooden table by lantern light.

[EP35_EL016 | 00:28.50-00:30.80] **ACTION:** Alexander, wearing a rugged trench coat, his scarred face framed by long dark hair, stands studying an unfolded tactical map before snapping his head up in alarm.
[EP35_EL017 | 00:30.80-00:33.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Alexander's mother stepping across the threshold, holding up her burning lantern, her eyes wide with shock.
[EP35_EL018 | 00:33.80-00:36.50] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up on Alexander's scarred left cheek and wide, disbelieving blue eyes.
[EP35_EL019 | 00:36.50-00:40.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up on his mother's tear-streaked face as her chin trembles and tears spill down her cheeks.
[EP35_EL020 | 00:37.00-00:40.00] **ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Sobbing, Stunned):** "Alexander!"
[EP35_EL021 | 00:40.50-00:44.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Alexander as his hard expression crumbles into utter astonishment.
[EP35_EL022 | 00:42.50-00:44.20] **ALEXANDER (Breathless, In Disbelief):** "Mother?"
[EP35_EL023 | 00:44.20-00:47.50] **ACTION:** She drops her walking staff and rushes forward, throwing her arms around Alexander's neck. He pulls her tightly into his chest.
[EP35_EL024 | 00:45.50-00:48.00] **ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Weeping, Overwhelmed):** "You're alive."
[EP35_EL025 | 00:48.00-00:49.80] **ALEXANDER (Gentle, Choked Up):** "Mother."
[EP35_EL026 | 00:50.00-00:55.50] **ACTION:** She leans back slightly, her frail hand reaching up to gently cup his bearded, scarred cheek, staring into his eyes in disbelief.
[EP35_EL027 | 00:52.50-00:55.00] **ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Tearful, Heartbroken):** "I buried you."
[EP35_EL028 | 00:56.50-00:58.00] **ALEXANDER (Soft, Somber):** "I know."
[EP35_EL029 | 00:59.50-01:06.00] **ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Anguished, Accusing):** "They told me you died. They told me your entire regiment was destroyed."
[EP35_EL030 | 01:06.50-01:11.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Alexander's hardened, shadowed profile, his jaw tight with grim memories.
[EP35_EL031 | 01:08.50-01:10.80] **ALEXANDER (Dark, Resigned):** "Most of them were."
[EP35_EL032 | 01:11.50-01:14.00] **ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Searching, Desperate):** "Then how did you survive?"
[EP35_EL033 | 01:14.20-01:18.00] **CAMERA:** Side profile of Alexander as his eyes look into the distance, haunted by the past.
[EP35_EL034 | 01:15.00-01:17.50] **ALEXANDER (Grim, Quiet):** "I wasn't supposed to."
[EP35_EL035 | 01:18.00-01:22.50] **ACTION:** Alexander steps over to the wooden table, looking down at the parchment map spread out under the lantern.
[EP35_EL036 | 01:19.00-01:23.00] **ALEXANDER (Solemn):** "Three years ago, I was sent to the Iberian front."
[EP35_EL037 | 01:23.00-01:27.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Alexander's weathered face looking down pensively as he recounts the mission.
[EP35_EL038 | 01:23.00-01:29.00] **ALEXANDER (Steady, Focused):** "It was a classified Crown mission. We were investigating a British officer selling military secrets to French spies."
[EP35_EL039 | 01:27.00-01:29.80] **ACTION:** Alexander's scarred finger points to a red-circled location on the parchment map marked near Madrid.
[EP35_EL040 | 01:29.80-01:32.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up on his mother, gasping with wide, horrified eyes.
[EP35_EL041 | 01:29.80-01:31.50] **ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Shocked):** "A traitor?"
[EP35_EL043 | 01:33.50-01:37.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot framing both of them across the wooden table bathed in amber lantern glow.
[EP35_EL044 | 01:34.50-01:37.00] **ALEXANDER (Grave):** "We were close to finding him."
[EP35_EL045 | 01:38.50-01:41.00] **ALEXANDER (Hardened):** "Then came the ambush."
[EP35_EL046 | 01:41.20-01:44.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Alexander's scarred hand clenching into a fist, furiously crumbling the parchment map beneath his knuckles.
[EP35_EL047 | 01:41.50-01:44.20] **ALEXANDER (Bitter, Painful):** "My men were slaughtered."
[EP35_EL048 | 01:44.20-01:46.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of his mother clutching at her throat, tears glistening in her eyes.
[EP35_EL049 | 01:44.50-01:46.00] **ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Trembling, Anxious):** "And you?"
[EP35_EL050 | 01:47.00-01:50.00] **ALEXANDER (Hollow):** "I was shot. Left for dead."
[EP35_EL051 | 01:50.00-01:53.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of his mother placing both hands on the table, leaning forward in disbelief.
[EP35_EL052 | 01:51.00-01:53.00] **ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Pleading, Astonished):** "How did you escape?"
[EP35_EL053 | 01:53.50-01:58.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Alexander, his eyes dark with the harrowing memory.
[EP35_EL054 | 01:54.00-01:58.00] **ALEXANDER (Somber, Low):** "I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone."
[EP35_EL055 | 01:58.20-02:02.00] **ALEXANDER (Continuing):** "I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead."
[EP35_EL056 | 02:02.00-02:05.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up on his mother as her expression shifts to profound bewilderment and outrage.
[EP35_EL057 | 02:02.00-02:05.50] **ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Aghast, Stunned):** "Then why did they never tell us?"
[EP35_EL058 | 02:05.50-02:09.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Alexander's intense, piercing gaze.
[EP35_EL059 | 02:06.00-02:09.50] **ALEXANDER (Ominous, Deliberate):** "Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead."
[EP35_EL060 | 02:09.50-02:10.50] **ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Breathless):** "Who?"
[EP35_EL061 | 02:10.50-02:14.00] **ACTION:** Alexander turns away toward the frosted window, staring out into the dark raging blizzard outside.
[EP35_EL062 | 02:11.00-02:14.00] **ALEXANDER (Brooding):** "I spent three years trying to find out."
[EP35_EL063 | 02:14.00-02:16.80] **ACTION:** Alexander abruptly pushes away from the window, storming back toward the table with burning rage.
[EP35_EL064 | 02:14.00-02:17.00] **ALEXANDER (Fierce, Resolute):** "The ambush was not an accident."
[EP35_EL065 | 02:17.00-02:24.00] **ACTION:** He leans heavily over the wooden table, looming close as his fury boils over.
[EP35_EL066 | 02:17.00-02:20.50] **ALEXANDER (Vehement, Enraged):** "Someone ordered my men to die."
[EP35_EL067 | 02:21.00-02:24.00] **ALEXANDER (Darkly Intimating):** "Someone wanted me erased."
[EP35_EL068 | 02:24.00-02:25.00] **ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Gasping, Terrified):** "Who?"
[EP35_EL069 | 02:25.00-02:30.50] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, grim visage, his voice dropping to a deadly chill.
[EP35_EL070 | 02:25.50-02:30.00] **ALEXANDER (Deadly, Chilling):** "The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now."

[EP35_EL071 | 02:30.50-02:37.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up on his mother's face as the horrifying realization hits her, her mouth open in a soundless gasp of sheer dread as the scene holds and slowly fades.

[EP35_EL072 | 02:30.80-02:37.50] **SOUND FX:** A sudden, ominous orchestral crescendo swells dramatically into silence.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: Alexander vows that before Rupert and Catherine's wedding begins, their dead Duke is coming home.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP36_EL113 | 03:02.00-03:03.50] **ALEXANDER (Calm, Chilling):** "Two days."

[EP36_EL114 | 03:04.00-03:08.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot from inside the cabin, showing his mother clutching her chest, looking after Alexander's imposing silhouette standing at the threshold of the blizzard.
[EP36_EL115 | 03:04.50-03:07.80] **ALEXANDER (Vow of Vengeance):** "Then they have two days to celebrate."
[EP36_EL116 | 03:08.00-03:12.50] **CAMERA:** Side profile close-up on Alexander as his breath fogs into the icy winter night air, his jaw clenched tight.
[EP36_EL117 | 03:09.50-03:12.20] **ALEXANDER (Low, Menacing Promise):** "Because before that wedding begins..."
[EP36_EL118 | 03:12.50-03:20.75] **CAMERA:** Tight side profile close-up of Alexander's battle-scarred cheek and burning gaze as he makes his final declaration.
[EP36_EL119 | 03:13.00-03:16.80] **ALEXANDER (Cold, Thunderous Finale):** "...their dead Duke is coming home."
[EP36_EL120 | 03:17.00-03:20.75] **ACTION:** Alexander stares resolutely ahead into the dark, snowy woods as the camera holds on his grim, determined expression before cutting to black.

[EP36_EL121 | 03:17.00-03:20.75] **SOUND FX:** A heavy, ominous orchestral swell builds to a thunderous cliffhanger sting and reverberates into silence.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: The noble families receive lavish wedding invitations bearing an attached official decree for Juliana's public execution.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP37_EL031 | 00:53.00-00:56.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot as Clarissa unfolds the second page attached to the invitation, her expression shifting to intrigue.
[EP37_EL032 | 00:54.00-00:56.20] **LADY CLARISSA (Intrigued):** "And after the ceremony..."
[EP37_EL034 | 00:56.80-00:58.50] **ACTION:** Clarissa hands the letter upward to him. He takes it and looks down at the bold heading.
[EP37_EL035 | 00:58.50-01:02.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the nobleman reading, his eyes widening in shock before breaking into a grin.
[EP37_EL036 | 00:58.80-01:01.80] **NOBLEMAN (Reading in Awe):** "The sentencing of the condemned."
[EP37_EL037 | 01:02.00-01:05.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Clarissa turning back to the fire, laughing softly with dark delight.
[EP37_EL038 | 01:02.80-01:05.50] **LADY CLARISSA (Gloating, Mocking):** "They want the families to witness it."
[EP37_EL039 | 01:05.50-01:09.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the nobleman holding the invitation, chuckling at the audacity.
[EP37_EL040 | 01:06.50-01:08.80] **NOBLEMAN (Fascinated):** "A public execution after a wedding."
[EP37_EL041 | 01:09.00-01:12.50] **CAMERA:** Medium profile shot of Clarissa gazing back at him over her shoulder.
[EP37_EL042 | 01:09.50-01:12.20] **LADY CLARISSA (Chilling, Sharp):** "Not just an execution. A warning."
[EP37_EL043 | 01:12.50-01:15.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the nobleman's stern face, leaning down.
[EP37_EL044 | 01:13.00-01:14.20] **NOBLEMAN (Curious):** "To whom?"
[EP37_EL045 | 01:15.50-01:22.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Clarissa taking the letter back into her gloved fingers, her eyes gleaming with aristocratic cruelty.
[EP37_EL046 | 01:17.00-01:21.80] **LADY CLARISSA (Contemptuous, Scornful):** "To every woman who thinks she can rise above the place she was given."
[EP37_EL047 | 01:22.50-01:28.00] **CAMERA:** Wide shot of the parlor as Clarissa tosses the invitation dismissively onto the side table and looks directly toward the viewer.
[EP37_EL048 | 01:23.00-01:27.50] **LADY CLARISSA (Smug Triumph):** "Juliana's ruin will be a lesson. And we will be there to watch."

narrative_moments.summary: Starved and chained in the subterranean dungeon, Juliana pulls herself upright and vows that fear and hunger will never break who she is.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP37_EL049 | 01:28.00-01:32.00] **CAMERA:** Wide, dim shot of the subterranean stone dungeon. Juliana sits slumped against a weeping stone wall on the wet floor, dressed in a tattered prison smock, illuminated only by faint overhead moonlight piercing a ceiling grate.
[EP37_EL050 | 01:28.50-01:32.00] **SOUND FX:** Rhythmic water drips splashing onto stagnant dungeon puddles and a low, mournful ambient drone.

[EP37_EL051 | 01:32.00-01:35.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Juliana's bruised hand, locked in a heavy iron shackle chained to the wall, trembling as she hesitates inches away from a dirty earthen bowl filled with murky liquid.
[EP37_EL052 | 01:33.50-01:35.50] **ACTION:** Juliana curls her fingers back, pulling away from the foul sustenance in defiance.
[EP37_EL053 | 01:35.50-01:40.50] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of Juliana's dirty, tear-stained face. Her eyes squeeze shut as tears stream down her cheeks from overwhelming physical agony and hunger.
[EP37_EL054 | 01:36.00-01:39.50] **JULIANA (Weak, Whispering through Tears):** "They think hunger will make me surrender."
[EP37_EL055 | 01:40.50-01:43.50] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Juliana's blue eyes snapping open, blazing with unyielding defiance.
[EP37_EL056 | 01:40.80-01:43.20] **JULIANA (Fierce Resolve):** "They think fear will make me beg."
[EP37_EL057 | 01:43.50-01:48.50] **CAMERA:** Full shot of Juliana using her bare hands against the slimy stone floor to drag herself upright to her knees, chains rattling loudly.
[EP37_EL058 | 01:44.00-01:47.00] **SOUND FX:** The harsh scrape and clatter of heavy iron chains dragging across wet stone.
[EP37_EL059 | 01:45.50-01:47.80] **JULIANA (Straining, Defiant Gasps):** "I will not!"
[EP37_EL060 | 01:48.50-01:53.50] **CAMERA:** Low-angle shot looking up at Juliana as she thrusts her chin high toward the iron ceiling grate, bathed in cold shafts of light.
[EP37_EL061 | 01:49.00-01:52.50] **JULIANA (Passionate Defiance):** "They can take my name. They can take my home."

[EP37_EL062 | 01:53.50-01:56.50] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of Juliana's iron-shackled hand reaching out and gripping the massive iron ring anchored into the dungeon pillar with crushing determination.
[EP37_EL063 | 01:53.60-01:56.20] **JULIANA (Indomitable Spirit):** "They cannot take who I am!"

narrative_moments.summary: As cathedral bells toll for the wedding and her execution, Juliana refuses to give up her husband's secrets and smiles with faith in Alexander.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP38_EL036 | 00:55.50-01:00.50] **CAMERA:** Frontal medium shot of Juliana kneeling upright, her right hand pressed firmly over her heart, her posture transforming into quiet dignity.
[EP38_EL037 | 00:55.50-00:57.00] **JULIANA (Determined):** "Let him live."
[EP38_EL038 | 00:57.50-01:00.50] **JULIANA (Steely):** "And if I have only one thing left to give..."
[EP38_EL039 | 01:00.50-01:04.00] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up of Juliana turning toward the cell wall, her blue eyes flashing with fierce loyalty.
[EP38_EL040 | 01:00.80-01:02.50] **JULIANA (Defiant, Unshakable):** "I will not give them my husband."
[EP38_EL041 | 01:02.80-01:04.20] **JULIANA (Resolute):** "I will not betray him."
[EP38_EL042 | 01:04.00-01:07.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Juliana's closed eyelids as she takes a sharp, startled breath.
[EP38_EL043 | 01:04.50-01:06.50] **ACTION:** Juliana's eyes snap wide open in sudden realization as a deep resonant toll reverberates from above.
[EP38_EL044 | 01:04.80-01:27.00] **SOUND FX:** Solemn, resonant church bells begin tolling rhythmically from the cathedral above, echoing deep into the stone dungeon.
[EP38_EL045 | 01:07.00-01:10.50] **CAMERA:** Low-angle shot looking up past Juliana kneeling on the wet floor toward the barred iron skylight above her cell.
[EP38_EL046 | 01:09.00-01:10.30] **JULIANA (Startled Whisper):** "Bells."
[EP38_EL047 | 01:10.50-01:12.50] **CAMERA:** Wide tracking shot as Juliana scrambles to her feet, chains clinking loudly against her skirts.
[EP38_EL048 | 01:11.00-01:13.50] **ACTION:** Juliana rushes toward the front of the cell, clutching the iron bars with both hands.
[EP38_EL049 | 01:12.50-01:18.50] **CAMERA:** Medium profile shot of Juliana gripping the heavy iron bars, gazing down the corridor toward the source of the sound.
[EP38_EL050 | 01:12.80-01:14.20] **JULIANA (Realizing):** "The wedding."
[EP38_EL051 | 01:14.50-01:15.80] **JULIANA (Grim):** "It's beginning."
[EP38_EL052 | 01:16.00-01:18.50] **JULIANA (Somber, Steely):** "Then I suppose I'm next."

[EP38_EL053 | 01:18.50-01:24.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up between the vertical iron bars framed directly on Juliana's face. The terror in her eyes softens into an unexpected, brave smile of enduring faith.
[EP38_EL054 | 01:21.00-01:24.00] **ACTION:** Juliana grips the bars tightly, her lips curving into a warm, defiant smile as she whispers her husband's name.
[EP38_EL055 | 01:22.50-01:24.00] **JULIANA (Hopeful, Tender):** "Alexander..."

narrative_moments.summary: Alexander's undercover loyalists stage a firewood delivery ambush, incapacitating the royal sentries outside the cathedral.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP39_EL018 | 00:29.60-00:32.40] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot of the royal sentry stepping forward and extending a white-gloved hand to halt the cart.
[EP39_EL019 | 00:29.80-00:30.60] **ROYAL SENTRY (Commanding):** "Stop!"
[EP39_EL020 | 00:30.80-00:32.40] **CART DRIVER (Meek, Deferential):** "Firewood for the kitchens, sir."
[EP39_EL021 | 00:32.40-00:36.50] **CAMERA:** Fast dynamic medium shot as the cart driver suddenly lunges off the wooden bench.
[EP39_EL022 | 00:32.80-00:36.50] **ACTION:** The driver leaps off the cart, striking the sentry across the chest, seizing his neck, and tackling him violently against the wooden carriage wheel.
[EP39_EL023 | 00:33.10-00:36.00] **SOUND FX:** Dull physical thuds and scuffling boots on wet stone as the guard groans in surprise.
[EP39_EL024 | 00:36.50-00:42.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up as a second loyalist emerges from behind the doorway, wrapping his arms around the remaining royal guard's throat from behind.
[EP39_EL025 | 00:37.00-00:42.50] **ACTION:** The loyalist locks the sentry into a tight sleeper hold, clamping a hand firmly over his mouth until his eyes roll back and he goes limp.
[EP39_EL026 | 00:41.00-00:42.20] **LOYALIST FIGHTER (Whispering, Cold):** "Sleep."

[EP39_EL027 | 00:42.80-00:46.80] **CAMERA:** Wide high-angle shot overlooking the stone cathedral steps where both royal guards lie unconscious on the fallen autumn leaves while more men slip inside the opened doors.
[EP39_EL028 | 00:46.80-00:50.00] **CAMERA:** Medium low-angle shot of the two loyalist fighters looking up into the overcast sky outside the stone sanctuary.
[EP39_EL029 | 00:47.00-00:48.10] **CART DRIVER (Relieved, Firm):** "The road is clear."
[EP39_EL030 | 00:48.20-00:49.20] **LOYALIST FIGHTER (Resolute):** "Tell the Duke."

narrative_moments.summary: Alexander shaves his exile beard, puts on his gold-embroidered ducal coat, and is reverently hailed as 'Your Grace' by his soldier.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP39_EL038 | 01:01.20-01:06.60] **CAMERA:** Medium shot framed in the mirror of Alexander now handsomely groomed, his trimmed beard framing his fierce, scarred features.
[EP39_EL039 | 01:02.00-01:06.60] **ACTION:** Alexander lightly traces the jagged combat scar across his cheek, eyes burning with reclaimed power.
[EP39_EL040 | 01:02.00-01:02.80] **ALEXANDER (Deep, Steely Resolve):** "Enough hiding."
[EP39_EL041 | 01:03.00-01:05.50] **ALEXANDER (Dark, Unforgiving):** "They buried Alexander Ashwin three years ago."
[EP39_EL042 | 01:05.60-01:06.90] **ALEXANDER (Fierce, Commanding):** "Today, he comes home."
[EP39_EL043 | 01:06.60-01:08.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Alexander lifting his royal navy-blue embroidered ducal coat from the wooden bench.
[EP39_EL044 | 01:08.50-01:11.80] **CAMERA:** Wide tracking shot through double wooden barn doors opening outward onto a vast, snow-covered landscape as Alexander steps forward into the light.

[EP39_EL045 | 01:08.50-01:11.80] **ACTION:** Alexander emerges in full ducal splendor—dressed in an immaculate navy tailcoat lined with gold embroidery, double-breasted brass buttons, and a crisp white cravat.
[EP39_EL046 | 01:11.80-01:14.80] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Alexander's hand adjusting the ornate golden lion crest pinned at his cravat.
[EP39_EL047 | 01:14.80-01:17.80] **CAMERA:** Medium low-angle shot as a loyalist soldier drops down onto one knee before him in the snow.
[EP39_EL048 | 01:15.80-01:17.20] **LOYALIST (Reverent, Submissive):** "Your Grace."
[EP39_EL049 | 01:17.80-01:22.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up profile of Alexander, his breath pluming in the winter cold, his eyes hardened like steel.
[EP39_EL050 | 01:20.50-01:22.20] **ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Command):** "Secure the chapel."
[EP39_EL051 | 01:22.50-01:25.20] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of the soldier rising and snapping a crisp military salute.
[EP39_EL052 | 01:23.80-01:25.20] **LOYALIST (Resolute):** "Yes, Your Grace."

narrative_moments.summary: The elder conspirator nobleman confirms all cathedral exits are locked down, anticipating a new Duke and the death of their 'witch'.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP40_EL029 | 00:55.80-00:58.20] **CAMERA:** Medium shot up on the stone balcony overlooking the nave, where an elder conspirator nobleman in black gloves stands gripping a cane.

[EP40_EL030 | 00:58.20-01:03.80] **CAMERA:** High-angle wide shot looking down from the balcony across the entire cathedral filled with guests, candles lining the central aisle, and royal guards standing at attention.
[EP40_EL031 | 01:03.80-01:09.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot on the balcony as a Royal Guard in red uniform and tall bearskin hat steps up and bows respectfully to the elder nobleman.
[EP40_EL032 | 01:05.00-01:06.80] **ELDER NOBLEMAN (Stern, Scheming):** "All entrances are covered?"
[EP40_EL033 | 01:06.90-01:08.20] **ROYAL GUARD (Obedient, Firm):** "Every one, my Lord."
[EP40_EL034 | 01:08.30-01:09.30] **ELDER NOBLEMAN (Calculating):** "Good."

[EP40_EL035 | 01:09.50-01:14.50] **CAMERA:** Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the elder nobleman, his gloved hand resting on the stone balustrade, looking down upon the altar and seated aristocrats.
[EP40_EL036 | 01:09.80-01:14.20] **ELDER NOBLEMAN (Ruthless, Victorious):** "By sunset, Ashburgh will have its new Duke and Duchess."
[EP40_EL037 | 01:14.50-01:18.50] **CAMERA:** Tight, menacing close-up on the elder nobleman's face as a cold, sinister smile spreads across his lips.
[EP40_EL038 | 01:14.80-01:17.40] **ELDER NOBLEMAN (Deadly, Uncompromising):** "And its witch will be dead."

narrative_moments.summary: Juliana is dragged into the cathedral in heavy chains and prison robes to be humiliated before high society, remaining completely unbowed.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP41_EL013 | 00:17.50-00:20.00] **ACTION:** Juliana, dressed in a coarse drab prison dress with a numbered identification badge, is marched forward by two armed constables holding her by the arms.
[EP41_EL014 | 00:20.00-00:22.80] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up of Juliana's scarred, dirtied wrists bound tight in heavy iron shackles.
[EP41_EL015 | 00:22.80-00:26.00] **CAMERA:** Intense close-up of Juliana's bruised, dirt-streaked face. Her piercing blue eyes burn with fierce dignity despite her captive state.
[EP41_EL016 | 00:26.00-00:28.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Catherine standing beside the altar, watching Juliana's entrance with gloating satisfaction.
[EP41_EL017 | 00:26.80-00:28.40] **CATHERINE (Smug, Taunting):** "There she is."
[EP41_EL018 | 00:28.80-00:30.00] **CAMERA:** Medium tracking shot of Juliana marching between the stern constables down the central aisle toward the altar.
[EP41_EL019 | 00:30.00-00:34.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of a seated aristocratic couple in the pews, whispering and sneering behind an ivory lace fan.
[EP41_EL020 | 00:30.50-00:31.60] **NOBLEWOMAN (Gleeful, Whispering):** "Look at her."
[EP41_EL021 | 00:31.70-00:33.80] **NOBLEMAN (Mocking, Chuckling):** "She actually came back to the chapel."
[EP41_EL022 | 00:34.00-00:36.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the noblewoman giggling with hand over mouth, glancing spitefully at the disgraced bride.
[EP41_EL023 | 00:34.80-00:36.80] **NOBLEWOMAN (Scornful, Smug):** "Not as a bride this time."
[EP41_EL024 | 00:36.80-00:39.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of two senior aristocrats in the carved choir stalls, resting on their canes and nodding in smug agreement.
[EP41_EL025 | 00:39.80-00:43.80] **CAMERA:** Close profile of Juliana as she halts in the center aisle, lifting her chin proudly to face the sneering onlookers.
[EP41_EL026 | 00:41.00-00:44.20] **CATHERINE (O.S.) (Derisive, Projecting):** "Lady Juliana Ashcroft. Look around."
[EP41_EL027 | 00:43.80-00:48.50] **CAMERA:** High-angle wide shot showing Juliana flanked by guards in the center of the lavishly decorated nave, dwarfed by the grand cathedral.
[EP41_EL028 | 00:45.00-00:48.00] **CATHERINE (V.O.) (Mocking, Resonant):** "This is the world you thought you belonged to."
[EP41_EL029 | 00:48.50-00:52.80] **CAMERA:** Low-angle medium shot of Catherine gesturing broadly from the altar steps, looking down upon Juliana like an empress.
[EP41_EL030 | 00:48.60-00:52.40] **CATHERINE (Spiteful, Boastful):** "And now they can all see what you truly are."
[EP41_EL031 | 00:52.80-00:57.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Juliana standing firmly between the guards, calmly meeting Catherine's venomous gaze.
[EP41_EL032 | 00:54.80-00:57.50] **ACTION:** Juliana looks around the cathedral at the sea of pompous faces, then raises her eyes straight back to Catherine with utter disdain.
[EP41_EL033 | 00:57.80-01:00.80] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up on Juliana's bruised, unshaken face.
[EP41_EL034 | 00:58.00-01:00.50] **JULIANA (Defiant, Unbowed):** "You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?"
[EP41_EL035 | 01:00.80-01:04.00] **CAMERA:** Dramatic low-angle full shot looking up at Juliana, her posture straight, imposing, and regal despite the heavy chains.
[EP41_EL036 | 01:01.00-01:03.50] **CATHERINE (O.S.) (Murmured, Cold):** "Still arrogant. Still standing."

narrative_moments.summary: An explosive breach blasts the cathedral doors apart as Alexander's strike force invades Rupert and Catherine's wedding.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP41_EL047 | 01:21.00-01:25.50] **SOUND FX:** Ear-splitting detonation, shattering stone, wood splintering violently into kindling, followed by terrified screams of the congregation.

[EP41_EL048 | 01:21.80-01:24.00] **ACTION:** A violent fireball bursts inward as the entire cathedral entrance explodes, blasting the massive double doors and masonry into flying shrapnel and billowing smoke.
[EP41_EL049 | 01:21.80-01:24.50] **CAMERA:** Rapid series of panic shots: aristocratic guests ducking behind pews, covering their heads in terror, women shrieking as plaster rains down.

[EP41_EL050 | 01:24.50-01:28.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Catherine and Rupert at the altar. Catherine gasps in horror, clutching her veil as debris rains over her bridal gown while Rupert spins around in shock.
[EP41_EL051 | 01:28.50-01:32.00] **CAMERA:** Medium wide shot of Juliana standing motionless in the middle of the aisle while thick smoke and dust billow from the demolished archway behind her.
[EP41_EL052 | 01:29.00-01:33.50] **ACTION:** Silhouetted armed figures emerge through the smoke and rubble of the breached doorway. Juliana slowly turns her head, glancing back toward the light.

[EP41_EL053 | 01:32.00-01:36.09] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up pushing in on Juliana's bruised face. Her expression shifts from grim resolve into awe, breathless realization, and blooming hope as the orchestral score swells into an abrupt cliffhanger.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: Alexander emerges through the smoke in full ducal regalia, claims the loyalty of the Royal Guards, and is affirmed by his weeping mother.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP42_EL001 | 00:00.00-00:10.50] **CAMERA:** Low-angle shot through drifting smoke and rubble across the stone floor, tilting up as polished boots step over splintered wood, revealing an imposing nobleman in a gold-embroidered navy coat.

[EP42_EL002 | 00:01.00-00:10.50] **ACTION:** Alexander strides deliberately through the pulverized cathedral doorway. Dressed in the regal ducal coat with gold braided cuffs and a lion crest, his scarred face is set with cold, unyielding authority.
[EP42_EL003 | 00:11.20-00:12.60] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Shocked, Trembling):** "Who are you?"
[EP42_EL004 | 00:12.80-00:14.60] **ALEXANDER (Low, Resonant):** "You already know."
[EP42_EL005 | 00:14.60-00:16.60] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Juliana, her manacled hands clutching at her smock as tears well in her eyes.
[EP42_EL006 | 00:15.00-00:16.40] **JULIANA (Breathless, Tearful Whisper):** "Alexander..."
[EP42_EL007 | 00:16.60-00:17.90] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Alexander, his gaze softening momentarily toward her.
[EP42_EL008 | 00:16.80-00:17.90] **ALEXANDER (Gentle, Reassuring):** "Juliana."
[EP42_EL009 | 00:17.90-00:21.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Rupert descending the altar steps, furiously pointing toward Alexander.
[EP42_EL010 | 00:18.00-00:21.20] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Furious, Hysterical):** "Guards! Arrest this imposter!"
[EP42_EL011 | 00:21.50-00:23.40] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the royal guardsman standing rigidly in red uniform and bearskin cap, resting his white-gloved hand on his sabre.
[EP42_EL012 | 00:22.00-00:23.40] **ROYAL GUARD (Stoic, Defiant):** "We will not."
[EP42_EL013 | 00:23.40-00:26.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Rupert, veins bulging in his neck as his composure shatters.
[EP42_EL014 | 00:23.50-00:25.20] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Screaming, Outraged):** "I said arrest him!"
[EP42_EL015 | 00:25.50-00:26.50] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Unhinged):** "Why?!"
[EP42_EL016 | 00:26.50-00:28.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up on the Royal Guard holding his upright blade with unwavering conviction.
[EP42_EL017 | 00:26.70-00:28.80] **ROYAL GUARD (Firm, Reverent):** "Because we know who he is."
[EP42_EL018 | 00:28.80-00:30.40] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Catherine clutching her father's arm, her bridal bouquet drooping as panic seizes her face.
[EP42_EL019 | 00:29.00-00:30.30] **CATHERINE (Trembling, Apprehensive):** "Rupert..."
[EP42_EL020 | 00:30.40-00:33.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Rupert gripping the edge of a pew for balance, his eyes wild with terror.
[EP42_EL021 | 00:30.50-00:33.80] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Denial, Shaken):** "You cannot be him. Alexander died!"
[EP42_EL022 | 00:33.80-00:39.90] **CAMERA:** Wide tracking shot behind Alexander as he advances down the center aisle, silhouetted against the ruins of the cathedral nave.
[EP42_EL023 | 00:34.00-00:39.80] **ALEXANDER (Cold, Commanding):** "And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon."
[EP42_EL024 | 00:39.90-00:44.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of an elderly silver-haired woman in simple ivory robes stepping into the aisle, her hands outstretched in trembling awe.
[EP42_EL025 | 00:40.20-00:42.50] **ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Choked with Tears):** "Alexander..."
[EP42_EL026 | 00:44.80-00:48.00] **ACTION:** Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.
[EP42_EL027 | 00:48.00-00:49.00] **ALEXANDER (Soft, Reverent):** "Mother."
[EP42_EL028 | 00:49.00-00:54.00] **ACTION:** His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.
[EP42_EL029 | 00:49.20-00:53.80] **ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Overcome, Loving):** "Look at you... my beautiful boy."
[EP42_EL030 | 00:54.00-01:03.50] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot framed down the ruined nave between Alexander and his mother.
[EP42_EL031 | 00:54.00-01:01.80] **ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Tearful, Proud):** "I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be."
[EP42_EL032 | 01:02.00-01:04.00] **ALEXANDER (Tender, Resolute):** "I have come home, Mother."
[EP42_EL033 | 01:04.00-01:12.50] **ACTION:** Alexander's mother turns toward the gathered nobility and guards, raising her chin and pointing proudly toward Alexander.
[EP42_EL034 | 01:04.20-01:12.40] **ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Ringing, Authoritative):** "Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!"
[EP42_EL035 | 01:12.50-01:13.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Rupert cowering on the altar steps beside Catherine and her father, utterly defeated.
[EP42_EL036 | 01:13.80-01:17.80] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up on Alexander, his hand resting on the hilt of his sabre as his eyes burn with fierce, cold retribution.

[EP42_EL037 | 01:13.80-01:17.50] **ALEXANDER (Grim, Vengeful):** "And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole."

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: Alexander produces sealed Crown War Office documents exposing Rupert and Lord Sterling for betraying his unit in Spain.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP43_EL026 | 00:28.00-00:30.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Alexander's hands holding an official War Office document bundle sealed with red wax and ribbon.
[EP43_EL027 | 00:28.20-00:30.00] **ACTION:** Alexander brings forth the dossier stamped "WAR OFFICE - TOP SECRET" with the royal crest.
[EP43_EL028 | 00:30.00-00:33.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Alexander holding up the sealed parcel before the room.
[EP43_EL029 | 00:30.00-00:33.40] **ALEXANDER (Grave, Powerful):** "These were delivered to me under the seal of the Crown."
[EP43_EL030 | 00:33.50-00:34.50] **ALEXANDER (Commanding):** "Read the first."
[EP43_EL031 | 00:33.80-00:35.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Lord Sterling looking sideways, his face pale with rising dread.
[EP43_EL032 | 00:35.00-00:37.00] **CAMERA:** Two-shot of Alexander handing the dossier to a Crown Military Magistrate wearing white gloves and a high-collared black uniform.
[EP43_EL033 | 00:35.20-00:37.00] **ACTION:** The Crown Official receives the dossier solemnly with both hands.
[EP43_EL034 | 00:37.00-00:42.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up on the Crown Official opening the binder and reading aloud.
[EP43_EL035 | 00:37.20-00:38.60] **SOUND FX:** Crisp sound of parchment turning.
[EP43_EL036 | 00:37.80-00:42.50] **CROWN OFFICIAL (Clear, Formal):** "Military Intelligence Report, Iberian front, three years ago."
[EP43_EL037 | 00:42.80-00:43.90] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Rupert staring wide-eyed, completely petrified.
[EP43_EL038 | 00:43.90-00:47.80] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up on the Crown Official continuing the official reading.
[EP43_EL039 | 00:44.00-00:47.40] **CROWN OFFICIAL (Solemn, Objective):** "Duke Alexander Ashburn's unit was ambushed after his location was compromised."
[EP43_EL040 | 00:47.80-00:50.80] **CAMERA:** Frontal medium shot of the Crown Official turning a page as the congregation listens in breathless silence.
[EP43_EL041 | 00:47.80-00:50.80] **CROWN OFFICIAL (Accusing, Measured):** "The report identifies the leak as deliberate."
[EP43_EL042 | 00:50.80-00:54.80] **CAMERA:** Wide shot across the rubble of the cathedral floor showing Rupert crumbling in fear against the choir railing.
[EP43_EL043 | 00:51.00-00:54.40] **CROWN OFFICIAL (Voice Continuing):** "Information regarding the Duke's position was transmitted through British channels."
[EP43_EL044 | 00:51.80-00:54.80] **ACTION:** Rupert staggers backward, his knees buckling as he leans his weight heavily on the stone balustrade.
[EP43_EL045 | 00:54.80-00:57.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Rupert clinging to the stone pillar, his breath shallow and terrified.
[EP43_EL046 | 00:55.00-00:56.50] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Whispering, Terrified):** "No..."
[EP43_EL047 | 00:57.00-01:00.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot on Alexander stepping forward, thrusting the secondary dossier forward.
[EP43_EL048 | 00:58.50-01:00.00] **ALEXANDER (Cold, Implacable):** "Read the names."
[EP43_EL049 | 01:00.00-01:03.00] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up on the Crown Official reading the concluding section.
[EP43_EL050 | 01:00.60-01:02.50] **CROWN OFFICIAL (Deliberate, Damning):** "Lord Henry Sterling."
[EP43_EL051 | 01:03.00-01:04.50] **CAMERA:** Quick pan to Lord Sterling stiffening in his pew, then the Crown Official.
[EP43_EL052 | 01:03.10-01:04.20] **CROWN OFFICIAL (Continuing):** "Rupert Ashburn."
[EP43_EL053 | 01:04.50-01:06.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up on Rupert's horrified eyes darting in sheer terror.
[EP43_EL054 | 01:06.00-01:08.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up on the Dowager Duchess covering her mouth in agonizing disbelief.
[EP43_EL055 | 01:06.50-01:08.00] **DOWAGER DUCHESS (Shaken, Devastated):** "My God..."
[EP43_EL056 | 01:08.80-01:11.20] **CAMERA:** Low-angle shot on Alexander towering over the fallen Rupert.
[EP43_EL057 | 01:09.00-01:11.30] **ALEXANDER (Furious, Thunderous):** "You sold my men to the enemy."
[EP43_EL058 | 01:11.20-01:12.70] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Rupert waving his hands defensively, hyperventilating.
[EP43_EL059 | 01:11.40-01:12.70] **BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Denying):** "I didn't!"
[EP43_EL060 | 01:12.70-01:14.80] **CAMERA:** Low-angle tracking push-in on Alexander raising the red-ribboned war document toward the cathedral arches.
[EP43_EL061 | 01:12.80-01:15.20] **ALEXANDER (Resonant, Accusatory):** "And when you believed I was dead..."
[EP43_EL062 | 01:14.80-01:16.00] **CAMERA:** Quick reaction shot on Rupert gasping on the steps.
[EP43_EL063 | 01:16.00-01:17.80] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, furious face.
[EP43_EL064 | 01:16.10-01:17.60] **ALEXANDER (Venomous):** "You took my title."
[EP43_EL065 | 01:17.80-01:21.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up on the Crown Official's gloved thumb cracking the red wax seal open.
[EP43_EL066 | 01:18.00-01:19.40] **SOUND FX:** Brittle snap of breaking sealing wax.
[EP43_EL067 | 01:21.00-01:25.00] **CAMERA:** Full shot of the Crown Official standing amidst church debris reading the death register.
[EP43_EL068 | 01:21.50-01:25.80] **CROWN OFFICIAL (Grave, Official):** "Official death confirmation was filed three months after the ambush."
[EP43_EL069 | 01:25.00-01:28.00] **CAMERA:** Two-shot of the Crown Official in the background and Alexander's dark silhouette in the foreground.
[EP43_EL070 | 01:26.00-01:28.50] **CROWN OFFICIAL (Continuing):** "Duke Alexander Ashburn was declared dead."
[EP43_EL071 | 01:28.00-01:33.20] **CAMERA:** Wide majestic shot capturing the entire nave, the rows of horrified guests, and the ruined cathedral windows.
[EP43_EL072 | 01:28.60-01:33.00] **CROWN OFFICIAL (Loud, Authoritative):** "His estate and title were subsequently transferred under false authority."

narrative_moments.summary: Alexander coldly rejects Catherine's desperate pleas of love and turns his back on her to approach Juliana.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP44_EL026 | 00:34.20-00:38.80] **CATHERINE (Heartbroken):** "For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea."
[EP44_EL027 | 00:35.80-00:38.80] **CAMERA:** Tracking two-shot over Alexander's shoulder as Catherine approaches him pleadingly.
[EP44_EL028 | 00:38.80-00:41.20] **CAMERA:** Close profile two-shot as Catherine gently reaches her gloved hand up to Alexander's bearded cheek.
[EP44_EL029 | 00:38.90-00:41.20] **CATHERINE (Whispering, Longing):** "I never stopped loving you."
[EP44_EL030 | 00:41.20-00:42.80] **ACTION:** Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.
[EP44_EL031 | 00:41.20-00:42.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Catherine's empty gloved hand trembling in the empty space between them.
[EP44_EL032 | 00:42.80-00:46.40] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Catherine lowering her hand, stunned and deeply hurt by his rejection.
[EP44_EL033 | 00:44.20-00:46.40] **CATHERINE (Breathless, Hurt):** "You don't remember?"
[EP44_EL034 | 00:46.40-00:49.00] **CAMERA:** High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in the foreground, with Rupert held under guard in the background.
[EP44_EL035 | 00:46.60-00:48.80] **CATHERINE (Desperate, Demanding):** "I was supposed to be your Duchess!"
[EP44_EL036 | 00:49.00-00:51.00] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot of Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.
[EP44_EL037 | 00:49.20-00:51.00] **ALEXANDER (Cold, Implacable):** "You were never my Duchess."
[EP44_EL038 | 00:51.00-00:53.00] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.
[EP44_EL039 | 00:51.10-00:52.80] **CATHERINE (Sobbing, Pleading):** "But I loved you!"
[EP44_EL040 | 00:53.00-00:55.60] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up on Alexander, his scarred jaw set firm.
[EP44_EL041 | 00:53.00-00:55.50] **ALEXANDER (Scornful, Biting):** "You loved the Duke you thought you would marry."
[EP44_EL042 | 00:55.60-00:59.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Catherine, gasping in protest.
[EP44_EL043 | 00:56.20-00:58.20] **CATHERINE (Defiant, Pained):** "No!"
[EP44_EL044 | 00:59.00-01:02.40] **CAMERA:** Medium shot as Catherine clutches her chest, pouring her heart out.
[EP44_EL045 | 00:59.80-01:02.40] **CATHERINE (Passionate, Crying):** "I loved you before all this!"
[EP44_EL046 | 01:02.40-01:03.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Alexander tilting his head slightly, his gaze piercing through her.
[EP44_EL047 | 01:02.50-01:03.40] **ALEXANDER (Skeptical, Cutting):** "Did you?"
[EP44_EL048 | 01:03.80-01:05.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Catherine, rendered speechless by his doubt.
[EP44_EL049 | 01:05.00-01:07.80] **CAMERA:** Tilt-up shot starting from heavy iron chains resting on the wooden floor up to the shackled wrists of Juliana dressed in her rustic grey gown.

[EP44_EL050 | 01:07.80-01:09.60] **CAMERA:** Wide shot from behind Catherine as Alexander turns his back on her and walks resolutely down the rubble-strewn aisle toward Juliana standing in chains at the doorway.
[EP44_EL051 | 01:08.00-01:09.60] **ACTION:** Alexander walks away from Catherine toward Juliana, who waits solemnly by the cathedral entrance.
[EP44_EL052 | 01:09.60-01:10.10] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, lifting her gaze gently.
[EP44_EL053 | 01:10.10-01:10.50] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up on Catherine's horrified, bewildered expression as she realizes who Alexander chose.

[EP44_EL054 | 01:10.10-01:10.40] **CATHERINE (Gasping, Incredulous):** "Her?!"

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: Alexander kneels before Juliana, unlocks her chains, drapes his ducal cloak around her, and reaffirms their mutual devotion.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP45_EL005 | 00:05.00-00:08.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot as Alexander stops in front of Juliana and sinks onto one knee before her.
[EP45_EL006 | 00:05.20-00:07.80] **ACTION:** Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, looking up at her with profound devotion.
[EP45_EL007 | 00:07.40-00:08.90] **ALEXANDER (Gentle, Reassuring):** "Look at me."
[EP45_EL008 | 00:08.80-00:09.90] **CAMERA:** Low angle close-up of Juliana looking down into Alexander's eyes with rising disbelief.
[EP45_EL009 | 00:09.90-00:12.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Alexander's hands as he unfastens the heavy iron lock and releases the chains from Juliana's bruised wrists.
[EP45_EL010 | 00:10.20-00:11.80] **SOUND FX:** Heavy iron clanking as the shackles fall away.
[EP45_EL011 | 00:12.20-00:15.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she stares intently into his eyes.
[EP45_EL012 | 00:12.50-00:14.30] **JULIANA (Breathless, Overcome):** "Your eyes..."
[EP45_EL013 | 00:15.00-00:21.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up profile of Alexander as Juliana reaches out her trembling hand to touch his bearded cheek and jawline.
[EP45_EL014 | 00:15.20-00:18.50] **ACTION:** Juliana places her palm against Alexander's beard, feeling his scarred face as recognition dawns.
[EP45_EL015 | 00:17.10-00:18.70] **JULIANA (Emotional, Realizing):** "It's you."
[EP45_EL016 | 00:19.40-00:21.50] **ALEXANDER (Solemn, Loving):** "It was always me."
[EP45_EL017 | 00:21.80-00:24.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot as Alexander stands up and drapes a heavy crimson ducal mantle lined with ermine over Juliana's shoulders.
[EP45_EL018 | 00:21.90-00:24.20] **ACTION:** Alexander places the ducal cloak over Juliana's rustic gown, adjusting it gently over her shoulders.
[EP45_EL019 | 00:22.90-00:24.40] **JULIANA (Shocked, Wondering):** "You're the Duke?"
[EP45_EL020 | 00:24.50-00:27.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Alexander looking intensely into her eyes.
[EP45_EL021 | 00:24.60-00:27.40] **ALEXANDER (Firm, Resonant):** "Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton."
[EP45_EL022 | 00:27.20-00:29.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Juliana, tears of awe spilling over her cheeks.
[EP45_EL023 | 00:27.60-00:29.60] **JULIANA (Incredulous, Moved):** "All this time?"
[EP45_EL024 | 00:29.80-00:35.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up two-shot as Alexander tenderly cradles Juliana's cheek in his gloved hand.
[EP45_EL025 | 00:30.20-00:33.00] **ALEXANDER (Tender, Deep):** "You chose me when you believed I was nobody."
[EP45_EL026 | 00:33.20-00:34.90] **JULIANA (Sincere, Loving):** "I chose you because you were kind."
[EP45_EL027 | 00:35.10-00:36.80] **ALEXANDER (Low, Passionate):** "You chose me when I had nothing."
[EP45_EL028 | 00:35.80-00:38.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot framed between them as Alexander holds her face with both hands, the crowd watching in stunned silence.
[EP45_EL029 | 00:37.00-00:38.70] **JULIANA (Resolute, Warm):** "I chose you because you had honor."
[EP45_EL030 | 00:38.50-00:42.00] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up on Alexander looking deep into Juliana's blue eyes.
[EP45_EL031 | 00:38.80-00:41.80] **ALEXANDER (Earnest, Devoted):** "And I chose you because you saw the man before the title."
[EP45_EL032 | 00:42.00-00:48.90] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up as Alexander and Juliana rest their foreheads and noses together in an intimate embrace.
[EP45_EL033 | 00:42.20-00:48.50] **ACTION:** Alexander and Juliana close their eyes, breathing together with their foreheads pressed gently against one another.
[EP45_EL034 | 00:43.80-00:46.00] **JULIANA (Soft, Heartfelt):** "I loved you before I ever knew who you were."
[EP45_EL035 | 00:46.10-00:48.80] **ALEXANDER (Soft, Vowing):** "And I loved you before I ever dared to tell you."

narrative_moments.summary: A High Priest enters the cathedral with an armed Crown officer and proclaims Alexander and Juliana's marriage legally null and void.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP45_EL057 | 01:26.50-01:30.50] **CAMERA:** Wide tracking shot down the cathedral aisle as the massive wooden entrance doors slam open, framed by blinding daylight and mist.
[EP45_EL058 | 01:26.50-01:28.20] **SOUND FX:** Loud, echoing thud of cathedral doors swinging open violently.
[EP45_EL059 | 01:27.50-01:31.00] **ACTION:** A Catholic Bishop in dark vestments steps through the cathedral doors accompanied by an armed Crown officer.
[EP45_EL060 | 01:28.40-01:30.80] **HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Stern):** "No one will bow yet!"
[EP45_EL061 | 01:30.80-01:33.00] **CAMERA:** Low-angle shot on Alexander and Juliana turning in alarm toward the rear of the cathedral.
[EP45_EL062 | 01:33.00-01:41.20] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the High Priest striding down the aisle, holding up an official royal parchment bearing red wax seals.
[EP45_EL063 | 01:33.20-01:41.00] **ACTION:** The Priest holds up the sealed royal proclamation, holding his rosary beads as he marches forward.
[EP45_EL064 | 01:33.20-01:41.10] **HIGH PRIEST (Commanding, Severe):** "This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union."
[EP45_EL065 | 01:41.20-01:45.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up on the High Priest unfolding the document, reading aloud to the congregation.
[EP45_EL066 | 01:41.50-01:45.50] **HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Official):** "These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register."
[EP45_EL067 | 01:45.80-01:48.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Alexander shielding Juliana behind him as the Crown officer approaches with drawn sword.
[EP45_EL068 | 01:46.20-01:48.80] **HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Harsh, Resolute):** "Before the Crown, you are not Duchess of Ashburton."
[EP45_EL069 | 01:48.80-01:53.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the High Priest scowling directly at Juliana with unyielding authority.
[EP45_EL070 | 01:49.00-01:53.00] **HIGH PRIEST (Unyielding, Condemning):** "You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife."
[EP45_EL071 | 01:53.20-01:57.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up two-shot of Juliana gasping in terror, clutching Alexander's hand tightly as Alexander glares at the Priest.
[EP45_EL072 | 01:53.50-01:57.20] **ACTION:** Juliana looks up at Alexander in sudden panic, her fingers gripping his leather-gloved hand.
[EP45_EL073 | 01:57.50-02:01.75] **CAMERA:** Slow push-in close-up on Catherine beneath her veil, her initial despair morphing into a cold, venomous, triumphant smile as the episode cuts.

[EP45_EL074 | 01:58.00-02:01.75] **ACTION:** Catherine raises her chin, a vindictive smirk spreading across her lips as she realizes her rival's claim has just been torn to pieces.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: The High Priest tears open the crimson wax seal of the royal War Office document to seize the sanctuary.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP46_EL007 | 00:11.00-00:13.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the High Priest holding up a wax-sealed document before his chest, flanked by two armed guards.
[EP46_EL008 | 00:11.50-00:16.80] **HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Authoritative):** "By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown scesion."
[EP46_EL009 | 00:13.80-00:17.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of the High Priest's fingers breaking the crimson wax seal and string on the war office envelope.
[EP46_EL010 | 00:15.00-00:16.80] **SOUND FX:** Crisp tear of wax and parchment string snapping open.
[EP46_EL011 | 00:17.20-00:20.50] **CAMERA:** Low-angle medium shot of the High Priest opening the yellowed War Office document.
[EP46_EL012 | 00:17.30-00:20.40] **HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Commanding):** "None shall leave until every witness is accounted for."

narrative_moments.summary: Alexander forces the guards to lower their halberds and secures a ten-day ecclesiastical trial to prove his marriage.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP46_EL057 | 01:41.80-01:46.80] **CAMERA:** Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.
[EP46_EL058 | 01:41.80-01:46.50] **ALEXANDER (Cold, Resolute):** "A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal."
[EP46_EL059 | 01:46.80-01:51.80] **CAMERA:** Low-angle two-shot of the High Priest staring up into Alexander's imposing frame.
[EP46_EL060 | 01:47.00-01:51.50] **HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Unflinching):** "The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours."
[EP46_EL061 | 01:51.80-01:58.50] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Alexander glaring with icy authority.
[EP46_EL062 | 01:52.00-01:58.20] **ALEXANDER (Defiant, Commanding):** "Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel."
[EP46_EL063 | 01:58.50-02:04.00] **CAMERA:** Wide profile two-shot of the High Priest and Alexander locked in an intense standoff before the altar.
[EP46_EL064 | 01:58.80-02:03.60] **HIGH PRIEST (Chilling, Victorious):** "Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice."
[EP46_EL065 | 02:04.00-02:06.50] **ALEXANDER (Steely, Unfazed):** "I'll take that wager over your decree."
[EP46_EL066 | 02:06.50-02:07.20] **CAMERA:** Quick reaction shot of the elderly woman in the pew gripping her beads in distress.
[EP46_EL067 | 02:07.20-02:13.50] **CAMERA:** Wide shot from behind the guards as they surround Alexander and Juliana, halberds and swords pointed inches from Alexander's chest.
[EP46_EL068 | 02:07.20-02:13.20] **ALEXANDER (Thunderous, Imposing):** "Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!"
[EP46_EL069 | 02:13.50-02:18.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the High Priest extending his hand toward the guards, commanding them to stand down.
[EP46_EL070 | 02:14.00-02:16.00] **ACTION:** The guards slowly lower their weapon points away from the Duke.
[EP46_EL071 | 02:14.20-02:18.50] **HIGH PRIEST (Ominous, Warning):** "Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well."

narrative_moments.summary: Alexander cradles Juliana's cheek and swears that no priest or king can break their sacred marriage.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP47_EL018 | 00:35.80-00:37.80] **ALEXANDER (Gentle, Resolute):** "Look at me, Juliana."
[EP47_EL019 | 00:37.50-00:42.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Alexander raising his scarred hand to tenderly cradle Juliana's cheek.
[EP47_EL020 | 00:38.20-00:42.50] **ALEXANDER (Fierce, Loving):** "You saved my mother's life. You stood by me when I had nothing."
[EP47_EL021 | 00:42.50-00:45.80] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up on Alexander's gaze locking onto Juliana's tearful eyes.
[EP47_EL022 | 00:43.00-00:45.50] **ALEXANDER (Deep, Unwavering):** "You are my wife."
[EP47_EL023 | 00:45.50-00:48.00] **ACTION:** Alexander gently pulls Juliana closer, his hands resting securely on her shoulders.

[EP47_EL024 | 00:45.80-00:54.80] **ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Steadfast):** "You were my wife before that priest ever opened his mouth. And we will stand before the King and God again within ten days. Nothing breaks that."

narrative_moments.summary: Juliana forces the disgraced Catherine to accept a servant's apron and keys to scrub floors as a scullery maid.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP47_EL048 | 01:31.00-01:35.00] **ACTION:** Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.
[EP47_EL049 | 01:31.50-01:35.00] **JULIANA (Steely, Direct):** "If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it."
[EP47_EL050 | 01:35.50-01:38.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine's face turning from despair to offended shock.
[EP47_EL051 | 01:36.00-01:38.80] **CATHERINE (Incredulous, Stunned):** "You want me? As a guest?"
[EP47_EL052 | 01:38.80-01:41.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Juliana staring straight into Catherine's eyes without blinking.
[EP47_EL053 | 01:39.20-01:41.00] **JULIANA (Unflinching, Firm):** "As a scullery maid."
[EP47_EL054 | 01:41.20-01:44.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of Catherine recoiling in disgust, looking around at the gathered estate retainers.
[EP47_EL055 | 01:41.50-01:44.50] **CATHERINE (Outraged, Venomous):** "You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?"
[EP47_EL056 | 01:44.80-01:48.50] **CAMERA:** Dramatic profile two-shot of Juliana standing inches away from Catherine, dominating the confrontation.
[EP47_EL057 | 01:45.20-01:48.50] **JULIANA (Measured, Commanding):** "You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor."
[EP47_EL058 | 01:48.50-01:51.50] **CAMERA:** Juliana extends the ring of iron keys outward in her fist.
[EP47_EL059 | 01:48.80-01:51.50] **JULIANA (Stern, Demanding):** "You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn."
[EP47_EL060 | 01:51.50-01:54.50] **CAMERA:** Close profile two-shot of the two women locked in an intense psychological battle.
[EP47_EL061 | 01:51.80-01:54.50] **JULIANA (Unforgiving):** "You will scour the kitchen grease until midnight."
[EP47_EL062 | 01:54.50-01:58.50] **CAMERA:** Juliana presents the rough hemp apron and heavy keys right to Catherine's face.
[EP47_EL063 | 01:54.80-01:58.50] **JULIANA (Stern, Final):** "One complaint from the housekeeper, and you are cast out with nothing."
[EP47_EL064 | 01:58.50-02:01.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine's trembling lips, humiliated tears spilling down her heavily made-up cheeks.
[EP47_EL065 | 01:59.20-02:01.60] **CATHERINE (Choked, Humiliated):** "You humiliate me."
[EP47_EL066 | 02:01.80-02:07.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of both women standing beneath the cathedral vaulting of the hall.
[EP47_EL067 | 02:02.20-02:07.20] **JULIANA (Calm, Sovereign):** "I offer you bread and honest labor. Take the apron, or leave the county."

[EP47_EL068 | 02:07.50-02:11.50] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up on Catherine's trembling hands as she reaches out, taking the coarse apron and clattering iron keys, pressing them desperately against her chest.
[EP47_EL069 | 02:08.50-02:11.20] **CATHERINE (Broken, Defeated):** "I accept, Your Grace."

[EP47_EL070 | 02:11.50-02:14.00] **CAMERA:** Wide shot down the vaulted stone hall as Catherine prostrates herself entirely upon the floor before Alexander, Juliana, and Lady Ashbourne, humbled to the stone as the scene cuts to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: Catherine bribes Agnes with a heavy pouch of gold coins to smuggle Father Thomas into the manor at night.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP48_EL038 | 01:06.90-01:13.50] **CAMERA:** Medium shot as Catherine picks up a heavy velvet coin purse and places it firmly into Agnes's awaiting open palms.
[EP48_EL039 | 01:07.50-01:09.00] **SOUND FX:** Dull clinking of heavy gold coins inside a leather pouch.
[EP48_EL040 | 01:07.80-01:10.50] **CATHERINE (Hushed, Commanding):** "Send for the priest. Tonight."
[EP48_EL041 | 01:10.80-01:13.40] **CATHERINE (Firm, Final):** "And make sure no one sees him arrive."
[EP48_EL042 | 01:13.50-01:16.80] **CAMERA:** Wide shot of Agnes curtsying swiftly, stashing the pouch into her apron, and hurrying out through the heavy wooden door into the darkness.

narrative_moments.summary: In an abandoned wing, Catherine and Father Thomas seal a treasonous pact to stall the ecclesiastical council.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP49_EL034 | 01:17.00-01:24.00] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up of Catherine raising one hand slightly, emphasizing her terms.
[EP49_EL035 | 01:17.20-01:23.80] **CATHERINE (Calculating, Determined):** "First, the hearing stays unresolved as long as possible. Every extension, every delay, every excuse to reconvene."
[EP49_EL036 | 01:24.00-01:31.40] **CAMERA:** Frontal close-up of Catherine raising two fingers in the candlelight, her eyes burning with ruthless intent.

[EP49_EL037 | 01:24.20-01:31.20] **CATHERINE (Fierce, Uncompromising):** "Second, I want to know what the council knows before it decides anything. Every argument, every witness, every whisper against her."
[EP49_EL038 | 01:31.40-01:34.20] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Father Thomas absorbing the audacity of her demand.
[EP49_EL039 | 01:31.60-01:34.00] **FATHER THOMAS (Skeptical):** "You want eyes inside the council chamber itself?"
[EP49_EL040 | 01:34.20-01:38.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up low angle on Catherine, tilting her chin up in defiant pride.
[EP49_EL041 | 01:34.40-01:37.80] **CATHERINE (Haughty, Imperious):** "I want eyes and ears everywhere that decides my future."
[EP49_EL042 | 01:38.00-01:43.80] **CAMERA:** Full two-shot of Catherine and Father Thomas facing off across the small table in the cavernous hallway.
[EP49_EL043 | 01:38.20-01:42.50] **ACTION:** Father Thomas clasps his hands behind his back, turning slightly away to ponder the gravity of her words.
[EP49_EL044 | 01:38.30-01:43.20] **CATHERINE (Bitterly Resolute):** "Is that so unreasonable coming from a woman the church itself just humiliated back into relevance?"
[EP49_EL045 | 01:43.80-01:53.00] **CAMERA:** Medium shot on Father Thomas turning back around to face her, his countenance etched with genuine concern.

[EP49_EL046 | 01:44.20-01:52.80] **FATHER THOMAS (Wary, Grave):** "If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?"
[EP49_EL047 | 01:53.00-01:58.00] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot tracking closer as Catherine steps closer toward him.
[EP49_EL048 | 01:53.20-01:57.80] **CATHERINE (Seductive, Reassuring):** "Then make certain he doesn't find out. You're careful. I've seen how careful."
[EP49_EL049 | 01:58.00-02:04.80] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up on Father Thomas's intense, brooding face.
[EP49_EL050 | 01:58.20-02:04.50] **FATHER THOMAS (Stern, Stark):** "Careful men still hang, my lady, when the crime is treason against a Duke the King himself just restored."
[EP49_EL051 | 02:04.80-02:08.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Catherine, her lips parting into an alluring, promising smile.
[EP49_EL052 | 02:05.00-02:08.50] **CATHERINE (Tempting):** "Careful men who help me also get remembered."
[EP49_EL053 | 02:08.80-02:14.50] **CAMERA:** Split focus close-up between Father Thomas's intense gaze and Catherine leaning in close, whispering with lethal conviction.
[EP49_EL054 | 02:09.20-02:14.20] **CATHERINE (Whispering, Promising):** "A grateful Duchess collects debts differently than a desperate one."
[EP49_EL055 | 02:14.50-02:19.80] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot as Father Thomas extends his open right hand between them.
[EP49_EL056 | 02:15.00-02:19.50] **ACTION:** Father Thomas slowly raises his right hand, palm turned upward in invitation and pact.
[EP49_EL057 | 02:15.20-02:19.50] **FATHER THOMAS (Low, Resigned):** "The rest depends on how well you keep your part of this quiet."
[EP49_EL058 | 02:19.80-02:22.80] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Father Thomas looking down into her eyes.
[EP49_EL059 | 02:20.00-02:22.50] **FATHER THOMAS (Softly):** "Then we understand each other."
[EP49_EL060 | 02:20.50-02:22.80] **ACTION:** Catherine reaches out and places her slender hand firmly into Father Thomas's open palm.
[EP49_EL061 | 02:22.80-02:24.00] **CAMERA:** Close-up of Catherine gazing up at him, her eyes glistening in the candlelight.
[EP49_EL062 | 02:23.00-02:24.00] **CATHERINE (Intimate):** "We always have."

[EP49_EL063 | 02:24.00-02:24.75] **CAMERA:** Extreme close-up as Father Thomas gently raises his other hand and cups Catherine's cheek tenderly, her hand resting against his chest as she leans into his touch before cutting to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---

narrative_moments.summary: Father Thomas extorts complete control over western tax collections from Catherine in exchange for his corrupt silence.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP50_EL010 | 00:15.80-00:18.80] **CAMERA:** Medium two-shot from the side as both sit up in bed, sheets pulled up around their waists.
[EP50_EL011 | 00:16.80-00:18.50] **CATHERINE (Direct, Transactional):** "Name your price."
[EP50_EL012 | 00:18.80-00:26.50] **CAMERA:** Medium profile close-up on Father Thomas sitting up tall and bare-chested, Catherine resting her hand firmly over his heart.
[EP50_EL013 | 00:19.40-00:25.00] **FATHER THOMAS (Calculated, Demanding):** "The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office."
[EP50_EL014 | 00:26.50-00:30.50] **CAMERA:** Slight pull back as Catherine pulls her hand back slightly, staring at him in disbelief.
[EP50_EL015 | 00:27.20-00:30.20] **CATHERINE (Scoffing, Incredulous):** "That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune."
[EP50_EL016 | 00:30.50-00:35.80] **CAMERA:** Two-shot centering on Father Thomas leaning toward her, his expression resolute and uncompromising.
[EP50_EL017 | 00:31.00-00:35.00] **FATHER THOMAS (Steady, Cold):** "Absolution is free. Discretion has a price."
[EP50_EL018 | 00:35.80-00:39.80] **CAMERA:** Tight profile close-up between their faces, golden candlelight illuminating Catherine's jaw as she raises her hand to touch his cheek.
[EP50_EL019 | 00:36.50-00:39.40] **CATHERINE (Soft, Calculating):** "Unsupervised. In your hands alone."
[EP50_EL020 | 00:39.80-00:43.00] **CAMERA:** Tight close-up as Father Thomas reaches up and firmly clasps Catherine's hand at his neck.
[EP50_EL021 | 00:40.40-00:42.50] **FATHER THOMAS (Grave):** "For as long as it holds."
[EP50_EL022 | 00:43.00-00:48.50] **CAMERA:** Medium close-up as Catherine breaks into a knowing, seductive smile and taps his chest with her index finger.
[EP50_EL023 | 00:43.20-00:48.00] **CATHERINE (Softly, Teasing):** "Done. You told yourself this ends when the hearing does."

narrative_moments.summary: Agnes peers through the bedroom door and catches Catherine and the shirtless priest in bed together.

[EP50_EL034 | 01:10.80-01:13.50] **ACTION:** Agnes scans the desolate hallway nervously, her lantern casting elongated shadows against the wall.
[EP50_EL035 | 01:13.50-01:16.50] **CAMERA:** Over-the-shoulder shot behind Agnes as she stops dead in front of an open doorway, peering inside.

[EP50_EL039 | 01:17.20-01:18.60] **SOUND FX:** Sharp, terrified gasp catching in Agnes's throat.

[EP50_EL040 | 01:18.50-01:20.00] **CAMERA:** Frantic backward tracking close-up on Agnes stumbling back into the shadows of the hallway, horrified by the lethal secret she has uncovered before an abrupt cut to black.
