episode_summaries.summary: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral for her wedding only to find her fiancé Gerald holding hands with her sister Clarissa, who has stolen her marriage with her family's blessing.
Cast aside at the altar and ordered to leave, Juliana stands tall and turns her humiliation into a scathing public indictment of Gerald's honor before the entire congregation.
When guards attempt to forcibly remove Juliana from the cathedral, a scarred stranger intervenes with lethal force and drops to one knee with a marriage proposal.
Ignoring the mockery of Gerald and Clarissa, Juliana accepts the warrior's proposal and marries him on the spot, after which she is officially disowned and exiled by her stepmother.
Lord and Lady Ashcroft strip Juliana of her dowry and throw her mother's treasured ledger into the mud, but her husband retrieves it and walks her safely out of the courtyard.
Juliana and Alexander trek through the rainy woods to his modest stone cottage, where Juliana cleans the hearth and finds unexpected safety and comfort in his presence.
Gerald and Clarissa arrive at the cottage to mock Juliana's peasant labor, but Alexander returns from the forest and silently terrifies Gerald into fleeing.
Inside the cottage, Alexander and Juliana bond over her mother's herbal grimoire, discussing war scars and the healing power of wild plants.
Juliana saves a dying peasant boy with her herbal remedies, unwittingly starting village rumors that reach the manor where the Blond Nobleman panics over whispers of the living Duke.
Alexander stumbles into the cottage soaked in blood; while tending his severe lacerations by firelight, Juliana receives his raw confession of devotion.
Gerald and Clarissa arrive at Blackwood cottage with a constable, planting a gold pocket watch in Alexander's coat to frame him for grand theft.
Clarissa offers a cruel ultimatum to dismiss the theft charges if Juliana crawls barehanded into frozen blackthorn briars to recover her emerald signet ring.
Juliana withstands agonizing thorn lacerations under Gerald and Clarissa's mockery, successfully locating and seizing the emerald ring.
Juliana trades the ring for Alexander's release; he carries her home and tenderly bandages her wounds, secretly swearing vengeance.
Hired thugs raid Juliana's medicinal garden and trample her deceased mother's herbs, prompting Alexander to charge into battle.
Alexander dismantles the three attackers using military training and extracts a confession naming Gerald Harrington as the mastermind.
Alexander rebuilds the damaged garden fence and shares a tender, romantic evening with Juliana beside the cottage fireplace.
Arsonists burn Blackwood cottage to the ground; Alexander rescues Juliana and her mother's herbal book by jumping through a window.
Villagers shelter the displaced couple before Alexander meets an operative in the woods, confirming Rupert has usurped Ashbury and imprisoned his mother.
Rupert and Catherine plot to seize the title as the Dowager Duchess sickens, while Juliana prepares remedies in an abandoned barn to treat afflicted villagers.
Juliana overcomes despair to heal Toby with coltsfoot, learning from Prudence that the Dowager Duchess is dying inside Ashbury Manor.
Disguised as a scullery maid, Juliana infiltrates the manor's forbidden West Wing and finds the Duchess dying of an unnatural fever.
Examining the Duchess's dark nails, Juliana confirms arsenic poisoning and prepares a charcoal antidote as an intruder arrives.
Catherine discovers Juliana, strikes her with a riding crop, and condemns her to scrub the hearth, while Juliana secretly conceals the remedy.
In the misty forest, Alexander sees Catherine's whip laceration on Juliana and reacts with furious devotion upon learning of the arsenic plot.
Juliana administers the antidote to the Duchess at night, but the Duchess gasps in shock upon recognizing the Ashbourne signet ring on her hand.
The Duchess reveals the ring belonged to her lost son, but Rupert and Catherine storm in and frame Juliana for poisoning Her Grace.
Ignoring the reviving Duchess's defense, Catherine tears away Juliana's locket, reads her identity in the ledger, and sends her to the dungeons.
Catherine threatens to burn Juliana's herbal ledger for witchcraft before throwing her into the flooded wet cells, where Juliana vows to endure.
Conspiring with an Elder Nobleman, Rupert and Catherine plan a corrupt magistrate trial to execute Juliana for witchcraft before rumors spread.
Alexander overpowers three thugs attacking Juliana's medicinal garden and interrogates their leader, discovering Gerald Harrington ordered the assault.
Alexander repairs the damaged garden and vows to safeguard Juliana with his life, leading to an intimate romantic evening by the hearth.
Arsonists burn Blackwood cottage to the ground; Alexander rescues Juliana and her mother's herbal book from collapsing rafters, swearing retribution.
Homeless and sheltered in an old barn, Alexander meets a loyal operative who reveals Rupert has usurped Ashbury and imprisoned Alexander's mother.
In Ashbury Manor, Rupert and Catherine scheme to let the Dowager Duchess die of poisoned wasting, while Juliana heals sick villagers from a freezing barn.
Juliana uses her mother's herbal remedies to cure Toby's fatal chest rattling, learning in return that the Dowager Duchess is wasting away inside Ashbury Manor.
Disguised as a common scullery maid, Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor alongside Prudence and discovers the Dowager Duchess convulsing in the forbidden West Wing.
Juliana matches the Duchess's blackened nails to arsenic poisoning in her mother's ledger and prepares a charcoal antidote just as someone turns the bedroom doorknob.
Lady Catherine whips Juliana with a riding crop and forces her to scrub the hearth, unaware that Juliana hid the antidote and journal to complete the Duchess's cure.
Alexander intercepts an injured Juliana on the forest path, reacting with volatile fury upon seeing her whip wound and hearing that the Duchess is being poisoned with arsenic.
Juliana secretly administers a charcoal antidote to the poisoned Dowager Duchess, who gasps in shock upon recognizing her lost son's signet ring on Juliana's hand.
The Duchess realizes Juliana's husband gave her the Ashbourne crest ring, but Rupert and Catherine interrupt the bedside revelation and frame Juliana for poisoning Her Grace.
Despite the Duchess's defense of Juliana, Rupert and Catherine order Juliana arrested, tearing away her mother's locket and discovering her noble identity in her mother's herbarium.
Dragged to the subterranean wet cells, Juliana endures Catherine's threat to burn her mother's book and frame her for witchcraft before vowing never to lose Alexander.
Spurred by an intimidating Elder Nobleman to silence cellar gossip, Rupert and Catherine orchestrate a fabricated witchcraft indictment against Juliana to hang her by state decree.
Catherine torments Juliana in the wet dungeon with a glowing branding iron, scorching her late mother's botanical volume before threatening Juliana directly.
Juliana dismantles Catherine's fragile ego with uncompromising dignity and devotion to Alexander, provoking Catherine into thrusting the brand at her eyes.
An aristocratic lord coerces the young maid Prudence into delivering false testimony framing Juliana for witchcraft by threatening her young brother.
Juliana stands proud in the prisoner dock during her witchcraft trial, defending medicinal healing before facing the judge's final verdict.
Alexander's mother flees through a tunnel to a remote blizzard cabin, reuniting with Alexander who reveals the Ashwood rulers ordered the ambush that nearly killed him.
Alexander learns from his mother that Rupert and Catherine condemned Juliana to death right after their wedding, leading Alexander to vow that the dead Duke will return.
Rupert and Catherine distribute wedding invitations that double as Juliana's public execution decrees, while Juliana remains unbowed in the dungeon.
A kind guard secretly gives bread to Juliana in the dungeon, and she resolves never to betray Alexander as cathedral wedding bells begin to toll.
Alexander's men neutralize the cathedral guards while Alexander shaves his beard, dons his ducal uniform, and marches out to reclaim his house and save his wife.
High society attends the grand cathedral ceremony for Rupert and Catherine, where conspirators seal every entrance to ensure Juliana's death.
Catherine pauses her lavish wedding to parade a shackled Juliana before high society, only for Alexander's forces to detonate the cathedral entrance.
Alexander strides through the cathedral rubble in ducal uniform; the royal guards switch allegiance to him as his weeping mother proclaims him the true Duke.
Crown war dossiers are read aloud proving Rupert and Lord Sterling orchestrated Alexander's wartime ambush, cutting off Sterling as he flees.
Rupert and Sterling are taken into custody while Alexander ruthlessly rejects Catherine's romantic pleas, walking away to rescue Juliana.
Alexander unchains Juliana and proclaims her Duchess, only for a High Priest to storm the cathedral and declare their marriage legally invalid.
The High Priest seizes the chapel under royal authority and invalidates Alexander's marriage, leading Alexander to demand a ten-day ecclesiastical trial.
Alexander reaffirms his devotion to Juliana, who mercifully allows a destitute Catherine to remain at Ashbourne under the strict condition that she serve as a scullery maid.
Refusing defeat, Catherine schemes inside her chambers and bribes Agnes with gold to secretly bring Father Thomas to her.
Catherine and Father Thomas meet under cover of darkness in an abandoned manor wing, sealing an alliance to delay and manipulate the council's verdict.
Father Thomas leverages their affair to extort western tax revenues from Catherine, but their bedroom liaison is uncovered by Agnes.
